items.title_en: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
items.abstract_en: Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously. We explicitly reformulate the layers as learning residual functions with reference to the layer inputs, instead of learning unreferenced functions. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence showing that these residual networks are easier to optimize, and can gain accuracy from considerably increased depth. On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers---8x deeper than VGG nets but still having lower complexity. An ensemble of these residual nets achieves 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set. This result won the 1st place on the ILSVRC 2015 classification task. We also present analysis on CIFAR-10 with 100 and 1000 layers. The depth of representations is of central importance for many visual recognition tasks. Solely due to our extremely deep representations, we obtain a 28% relative improvement on the COCO object detection dataset. Deep residual nets are foundations of our submissions to ILSVRC & COCO 2015 competitions, where we also won the 1st places on the tasks of ImageNet detection, ImageNet localization, COCO detection, and COCO segmentation.

items.title_zh: 用于图像识别的深度残差学习
items.abstract_zh: 深层神经网络更难训练。我们提出一个残差学习框架，使训练远深于以往的网络变得容易：把网络层显式地重构为学习相对于层输入的残差函数，而不是学习无参照的函数。大量实验证据表明，残差网络更易优化，并能随深度大幅增加而提升精度。在 ImageNet 上我们评测了深达 152 层的残差网络——比 VGG 深 8 倍而复杂度更低；其集成在测试集上取得 3.57% 的错误率，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名。我们还在 CIFAR-10 上分析了 100 层与 1000 层的网络。表示的深度对许多视觉识别任务至关重要，仅凭极深的表示即在 COCO 目标检测上获得 28% 的相对提升。该网络是我们参加 ILSVRC 与 COCO 2015 竞赛并多项夺冠的基础。
items.highlight_zh: 残差连接让 152 层网络更易训练，并夺得 ILSVRC 2015 冠军
items.digest_zh:
一、研究的问题：按常理，网络越深表达能力越强，但实验发现把网络一味加深后，训练误差反而变大——这并非过拟合，而是“退化”：深层网络难以优化。作者要解决的是“怎样让很深的网络也能顺利训练”。

二、方法：提出残差块。普通层直接学目标映射 H(x)，残差块改为学残差 F(x)=H(x)−x，再把输入 x 通过一条“捷径连接”（shortcut）原样加回输出，即 F(x)+x。这样若最优解接近恒等映射，网络只需把残差压到零，优化难度大大降低；捷径不引入额外参数，梯度也能更顺畅地回传。

三、结果：在 ImageNet 上训练到 152 层，比 VGG 深 8 倍但计算复杂度更低；多个残差网络集成后在测试集上取得 3.57% 的错误率，拿下 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一。在 CIFAR-10 上进一步验证到 100 层和 1000 层仍可训练。把这种极深的表示迁移到 COCO 目标检测，带来 28% 的相对提升；该骨干网络也支撑了团队在 ImageNet 检测、定位与 COCO 检测、分割任务上的夺冠。

四、为何重要：它说明“深度”本身是视觉识别的关键资源，而残差/捷径结构提供了一种廉价可扩展的加深方式。此后几乎所有的深层卷积网络与后来的 Transformer 都沿用了类似的残差连接思想。

items.title_en: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
items.abstract_en: Abstract Proteins are essential to life, and understanding their structure can facilitate a mechanistic understanding of their function. Through an enormous experimental effort 1–4 , the structures of around 100,000 unique proteins have been determined 5 , but this represents a small fraction of the billions of known protein sequences 6,7 . Structural coverage is bottlenecked by the months to years of painstaking effort required to determine a single protein structure. Accurate computational approaches are needed to address this gap and to enable large-scale structural bioinformatics. Predicting the three-dimensional structure that a protein will adopt based solely on its amino acid sequence—the structure prediction component of the ‘protein folding problem’ 8 —has been an important open research problem for more than 50 years 9 . Despite recent progress 10–14 , existing methods fall far short of atomic accuracy, especially when no homologous structure is available. Here we provide the first computational method that can regularly predict protein structures with atomic accuracy even in cases in which no similar structure is known. We validated an entirely redesigned version of our neural network-based model, AlphaFold, in the challenging 14th Critical Assessment of protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) 15 , demonstrating accuracy competitive with experimental structures in a majority of cases and greatly outperforming other methods. Underpinning the latest version of AlphaFold is a novel machine learning approach that incorporates physical and biological knowledge about protein structure, leveraging multi-sequence alignments, into the design of the deep learning algorithm.

items.title_zh: 用 AlphaFold 实现高精度蛋白质结构预测
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质是生命的基础，理解其结构有助于从机制上理解其功能。经过巨大的实验努力，约 10 万个独特蛋白质的结构已被测定，但这只占已知数十亿条蛋白质序列的很小一部分。确定单个结构往往需要数月到数年的艰苦工作，构成结构覆盖的瓶颈，因此亟需准确的计算方法。仅凭氨基酸序列预测蛋白质将折叠成的三维结构，即“蛋白质折叠问题”中的结构预测部分，是 50 多年来悬而未决的重要问题。尽管近期有进展，现有方法尤其在缺乏同源结构时远达不到原子精度。本文给出首个计算方法，即使在没有已知相似结构的情况下也能经常以原子精度预测结构。我们在第 14 届 CASP14 盲测中验证了完全重新设计的神经网络模型 AlphaFold，多数案例的精度可与实验结构媲美，并大幅优于其他方法。其基础是一种新颖的机器学习思路：把关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物学知识、多序列比对信息融入深度学习算法的设计。
items.highlight_zh: CASP14 上首次在缺少同源结构时达到接近实验的原子精度
items.digest_zh:
一、研究的问题：蛋白质的功能由其三维形状决定，但用冷冻电镜、X 射线晶体学等手段测一个结构往往要数月到数年。已知序列已有数十亿条，实验解析的结构却只有约十万个，缺口巨大。“仅凭氨基酸序列推出三维结构”是困扰学界五十多年的难题，此前方法在没有相似结构可参考时精度很差。

二、方法：作者彻底重做了自己的神经网络模型 AlphaFold。关键不是通用架构的堆叠，而是把生物与物理先验“写进”算法：以多序列比对（MSA）为输入，捕捉不同物种同源序列共同演化的约束；把残基之间的距离与角度等几何关系作为预测对象，再用这些约束去求解最终的三维坐标。可以理解为“先预测残基间的空间约束，再把约束拼成结构”。

三、结果：在第 14 届 CASP14 盲测评估中，AlphaFold 在大多数目标上给出的结构与实验测定结果精度相当，并显著领先其他参赛方法，改变了这一领域此前的精度格局。

四、为何重要：它表明深度学习可以在没有模板的情况下较可靠地给出原子级结构，从而让大规模结构生物信息学成为可能——把结构预测从“个案攻关”变成“批量计算”。这对药物设计、理解突变效应与蛋白质功能研究都有直接价值，也为后续更通用的结构预测模型奠定了基础。

items.title_en: All-Optical Machine Learning Using Diffractive Deep Neural Networks
items.abstract_en: We introduce an all-optical Diffractive Deep Neural Network (D2NN) architecture that can learn to implement various functions after deep learning-based design of passive diffractive layers that work collectively. We experimentally demonstrated the success of this framework by creating 3D-printed D2NNs that learned to implement handwritten digit classification and the function of an imaging lens at terahertz spectrum. With the existing plethora of 3D-printing and other lithographic fabrication methods as well as spatial-light-modulators, this all-optical deep learning framework can perform, at the speed of light, various complex functions that computer-based neural networks can implement, and will find applications in all-optical image analysis, feature detection and object classification, also enabling new camera designs and optical components that can learn to perform unique tasks using D2NNs.

items.title_zh: 基于衍射深度神经网络的全光学机器学习
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种全光学衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）架构：先通过基于深度学习的设计，得到一组协同工作的无源衍射层，之后该器件便能实现多种功能。我们在太赫兹波段用 3D 打印的 D2NN 做了实验验证，使其学会完成手写数字分类以及充当成像透镜。借助现有的丰富 3D 打印与其他光刻制造手段以及空间光调制器，这一全光学深度学习框架能以光速执行计算机神经网络可实现的多种复杂功能，将在全光学图像分析、特征检测与目标分类中得到应用，并催生能够借助 D2NN 学习执行独特任务的新型相机设计与光学元件。
items.highlight_zh: 3D 打印的无源衍射层叠片，以光速完成数字分类与成像
items.digest_zh:
一、研究的问题：主流神经网络由电子芯片逐层计算，速度受限于时钟与数据传输，能耗也高。能否让光本身完成“前向计算”，而无需光电转换与电子运算？

二、方法：作者提出衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）。把若干片被动衍射层沿光轴叠放，每一层对透过它的光波做相位（和/或幅度）调制；光在层间按衍射规律传播，天然完成了一层“线性变换 + 相邻单元互联”。每层的相位分布就是待训练参数，用类似反向传播的算法，在计算机里以衍射传播模型仿真训练，训练好后把各层相位图案刻印到实物上。器件本身不含电源或非线性电子元件，光穿过它即完成推理。

三、结果：团队用 3D 打印制作了工作在太赫兹波段的 D2NN，实验上分别实现了手写数字分类，以及等效于一个成像透镜的功能，验证了框架可行。

四、为何重要：它把“训练在计算机、推理在光学器件”的思路做成了可制造的实物，意味着某些特定任务可以用一块无源薄片、以光速、几乎不耗电地完成，适用于全光图像分析、特征检测与目标分类，也可能带来可学习的新型相机与光学元件。局限在于功能在制造后基本固定、精度与可重构性仍待提升，通常作为专用光学前端而非通用计算替代品。

items.title_en: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
items.abstract_en: Tree boosting is a highly effective and widely used machine learning method. In this paper, we describe a scalable end-to-end tree boosting system called XGBoost, which is used widely by data scientists to achieve state-of-the-art results on many machine learning challenges. We propose a novel sparsity-aware algorithm for sparse data and weighted quantile sketch for approximate tree learning. More importantly, we provide insights on cache access patterns, data compression and sharding to build a scalable tree boosting system. By combining these insights, XGBoost scales beyond billions of examples using far fewer resources than existing systems.

items.title_zh: XGBoost：一个可扩展的树提升系统
items.abstract_zh: 树提升是一种极为有效且被广泛使用的机器学习方法。本文介绍一个可扩展的端到端树提升系统 XGBoost，数据科学家广泛使用它在众多机器学习挑战中取得领先结果。我们提出一种新的、针对稀疏数据的稀疏感知算法，以及用于近似树学习的加权分位数草图。更重要的是，我们给出了关于缓存访问模式、数据压缩与数据分片的洞见，用以构建可扩展的树提升系统。结合这些洞见，XGBoost 能以远少于现有系统的资源扩展到数十亿级样本。
items.highlight_zh: 稀疏感知算法加快分裂查找，以更少资源处理数十亿样本
items.digest_zh:
一、研究的问题：梯度提升树（GBDT）精度好、可解释，是表格类数据的常用方法，但当数据量达到上亿甚至数十亿样本、特征非常稀疏时，传统实现训练慢、内存吃紧。论文要解决的是“如何把树提升做成一个真正可扩展的端到端系统”。

二、方法：算法上，采用带正则项的目标函数，并对损失做二阶近似来决定分裂增益；提出稀疏感知的分裂查找，为缺失值自动学习默认分支方向；用加权分位数草图在分布式环境下高效地提出候选分裂点，而不是枚举所有取值。系统上，作者总结了关键工程要点：按特征预排序并做块结构存储以提升缓存命中、为每个线程提前预取数据、对列做压缩、把数据分片到多台机器，并支持数据量超出内存时的外存计算。

三、结果：这些设计组合起来，使 XGBoost 能用显著少于当时已有系统的资源扩展到数十亿级样本，并支持分布式与核外训练。

四、为何重要：它把“好用的算法”与“扎实的系统工程”结合，让梯度提升树在工业界大规模落地，长期成为结构化/表格数据竞赛与生产环境中的常用工具；文中关于稀疏处理、近似分位数与缓存优化的做法也影响了后续许多机器学习系统。

items.title_en: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
items.abstract_en: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models, BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers. As a result, the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and language inference, without substantial task-specific architecture modifications. BERT is conceptually simple and empirically powerful. It obtains new state-of-the-art results on eleven natural language processing tasks, including pushing the GLUE score to 80.5% (7.7% point absolute improvement), MultiNLI accuracy to 86.7% (4.6% absolute improvement), SQuAD v1.1 question answering Test F1 to 93.2 (1.5 point absolute improvement) and SQuAD v2.0 Test F1 to 83.1 (5.1 point absolute improvement).

items.title_zh: BERT：用于语言理解的深度双向 Transformer 预训练
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的语言表示模型 BERT，即基于 Transformer 的双向编码器表示。与近期语言表示模型不同，BERT 通过在所有层中同时联合左右上下文，从无标注文本中预训练深度双向表示。因此，预训练好的 BERT 只需增加一个输出层进行微调，即可在问答、语言推断等广泛任务上得到当前最优模型，而无需对任务专用架构做大改动。BERT 概念简单而实证有力，在 11 项自然语言处理任务上取得新的最优结果：GLUE 得分提升至 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点），MultiNLI 准确率 86.7%（提升 4.6），SQuAD v1.1 问答测试 F1 达 93.2（提升 1.5），SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 达 83.1（提升 5.1）。
items.highlight_zh: 预训练+微调的双向 Transformer 一举刷新 11 项 NLP 任务
items.digest_zh: 【研究的问题】此前的语言表示模型大多是单向的（只能从左往右读），或只是把两个单向模型浅层拼接，无法在每一层同时利用上下文；而且每做一个下游任务都要重新设计网络结构，复用性差。【方法】作者提出 BERT：主体是多层 Transformer 编码器，先在大量无标注文本上做自监督预训练，让每个词的表征同时融合左右两侧信息（例如随机遮住部分词再让模型根据上下文猜回来）。预训练完成后，针对具体任务只需在顶端加一个很薄的输出层做微调，不必大改架构。【结果】在 11 项自然语言处理任务上刷新纪录：GLUE 达 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 点）、MultiNLI 准确率 86.7%（提升 4.6 点）、SQuAD v1.1 测试 F1 为 93.2、SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 为 83.1。【为何重要】它把“大规模预训练 + 轻量微调”确立为通用范式，证明深度双向表示可以作为一个底座模型服务大量任务，深刻影响了此后自然语言处理与大模型的发展路线。

items.title_en: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents ORB-SLAM3, the first system able to perform visual, visual-inertial and multi-map SLAM with monocular, stereo and RGB-D cameras, using pin-hole and fisheye lens models. The first main novelty is a feature-based tightly-integrated visual-inertial SLAM system that fully relies on Maximum-a-Posteriori (MAP) estimation, even during the IMU initialization phase. The result is a system that operates robustly in real-time, in small and large, indoor and outdoor environments, and is 2 to 5 times more accurate than previous approaches. The second main novelty is a multiple map system that relies on a new place recognition method with improved recall. Thanks to it, ORB-SLAM3 is able to survive to long periods of poor visual information: when it gets lost, it starts a new map that will be seamlessly merged with previous maps when revisiting mapped areas. Compared with visual odometry systems that only use information from the last few seconds, ORB-SLAM3 is the first system able to reuse in all the algorithm stages all previous information. This allows to include in bundle adjustment co-visible keyframes, that provide high parallax observations boosting accuracy, even if they are widely separated in time or if they come from a previous mapping session. Our experiments show that, in all sensor configurations, ORB-SLAM3 is as robust as the best systems available in the literature, and significantly more accurate. Notably, our stereo-inertial SLAM achieves an average accuracy of 3.6 cm on the EuRoC drone and 9 mm under quick hand-held motions in the room of TUM-VI dataset, a setting representative of AR/VR scenarios. For the benefit of the community we make public the source code.

items.title_zh: ORB-SLAM3：面向视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的高精度开源库
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ORB-SLAM3，这是首个能在单目、双目和 RGB-D 相机以及针孔与鱼眼镜头模型下同时完成视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的系统。其首要创新是紧耦合的基于特征视觉惯性 SLAM，即使在 IMU 初始化阶段也完全依赖最大后验（MAP）估计，从而可在室内外大中小场景中实时稳健运行，精度比以往方法高 2 至 5 倍。第二个创新是基于高召回地点识别方法的多地图系统：当长时间缺乏视觉信息而跟丢时，系统会新建地图，并在重访已建图区域时与旧地图无缝合并。与仅利用最近几秒信息的视觉里程计不同，ORB-SLAM3 是首个在所有算法阶段复用全部历史信息的系统，可把时间上相距很远或来自先前建图会话的共视关键帧纳入光束法平差以提高精度。实验表明，在各传感器配置下它都与现有最优系统同样稳健且显著更准：双目惯性在 EuRoC 无人机上平均精度 3.6 cm，在 TUM-VI 快速手持场景中为 9 mm。代码已开源。
items.highlight_zh: 首个统一视觉/视觉惯性/多地图 SLAM 的开源系统，精度提升 2–5 倍
items.digest_zh: 【研究的问题】机器人和 AR/VR 设备需要一边移动一边同时定位与建图（SLAM）。以往系统往往只支持某一种相机或某一种模式：有的只能纯视觉、有的加了 IMU 却初始化不稳，而且一旦跟丢就彻底失效，之前建好的地图也浪费了。【方法】ORB-SLAM3 做了两件关键的事。第一，把相机图像与 IMU 数据紧耦合，从初始化到跟踪全程用最大后验估计统一建模，使系统在小场景、大场景、室内室外都能实时稳健工作。第二，引入高召回率的地点识别，构建“多地图”机制：跟丢时新开一张地图，等再次回到去过的地方就把新旧地图自动缝合；同时把历史上所有共视关键帧都纳入光束法平差，即使这些帧在时间上相隔很久或来自上一次建图会话。【结果】各类传感器配置下稳健性与现有最强系统相当，精度显著更高：双目惯性在 EuRoC 无人机数据上平均误差 3.6 cm，在 TUM-VI 快速手持场景中仅 9 mm。【为何重要】它把“只用最近几秒”的视觉里程计升级为可长期复用全部历史信息的完整 SLAM，对 AR/VR、无人机与移动机器人都有直接价值，且代码开源。

items.title_en: Learning Video Foresight Reasoning from Unlabeled Videos via On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.title_zh: 通过在线策略自蒸馏从无标注视频学习预见推理
items.abstract_en: Video foresight reasoning requires vision-language models to anticipate future events or next actions from currently observed videos. Existing methods fit future captions, rationales, or full visual states, but face two limitations. First, they rely on annotations or external large models for supervision, limiting scalability. We address this with an on-policy self-distillation framework that turns past-future video pairs into a natural self-supervised signal without extra annotations or LLM supervision. Second, they treat the whole future clip as equally valuable, although most of it is irrelevant context information. We address this by defining a foresight score, from which we obtain a contrastive privilege advantage that drives the model to learn the most valuable future information. Since the score is intractable, we optimize a tractable lower-bound surrogate that interpolates this advantage, computed between the true and a random reference future, with a teacher-student distillation advantage; together, they amplify decision-relevant content information and suppress irrelevant context information. We call the resulting framework Future-OPSD. On open-ended prediction and closed-ended planning, Future-OPSD improves base models by up to 14.2 and 15.9 points without compromising general video understanding. Code will be available at https://jingchensun.github.io/future-opsd/
items.abstract_zh: 视频预见推理要求视觉语言模型从当前观测到的视频中预判未来事件或下一步动作。现有方法去拟合未来字幕、推理依据或完整视觉状态，但存在两个局限：一是依赖人工标注或外部大模型提供监督，可扩展性受限；二是把整段未来视频视为同等重要，而其中大部分其实是无关的上下文。为此，我们提出在线策略自蒸馏框架，把“过去—未来”视频对转化为天然的自监督信号，无需额外标注或大模型监督；并定义“预见分数”，由此得到对比式特权优势，驱动模型学习最有价值的未来信息。由于该分数难以直接计算，我们优化一个可计算的下界替代目标，将真实未来与随机参考未来之间计算出的优势与师生蒸馏优势做插值，从而放大与决策相关的内容、抑制无关上下文。所得框架称为 Future-OPSD：在开放式预测与封闭式规划任务上，分别比基础模型提升最多 14.2 与 15.9 个点，且不损害通用视频理解能力。
items.highlight_zh: 把过去—未来视频对变成自监督信号，预测与规划双双大幅提升
items.digest_zh: 【研究的问题】让视觉语言模型“看懂现在、预判未来”，比如看完一段视频判断接下来会发生什么、下一步该做什么动作。已有做法有两个软肋：要么靠人工标注的“未来描述”或调用外部大模型来给监督，成本高、难扩展；要么把整段未来视频一视同仁地学，可其中大部分画面与决策无关，反而带来噪声。【方法】作者提出 Future-OPSD。第一，用“在线策略自蒸馏”：同一段视频的“过去”当题目、“未来”当答案，模型自己出题自己学，不需要任何额外标注或大模型监督。第二，定义“预见分数”来衡量未来片段对决策的价值，据此构造“对比式特权优势”，让模型重点学关键的未来信息。由于该分数算不出来，就优化一个可计算的下界：把“真实未来对比随机未来”得到的优势与师生蒸馏优势做插值，效果是放大与决策相关的内容、压低无关上下文。【结果】在开放式预测和封闭式规划两类任务上，分别比基础模型提升最多 14.2 和 15.9 个点，同时通用视频理解能力没有下降。【为何重要】它把“未来本身”变成了免费的监督信号，为视频预见类模型提供了一条可规模化扩展、不依赖昂贵标注的自监督路线。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Beyond Final Answers: Interpretable Tumor Immune Microenvironment Reasoning from H&E and mIF
items.title_zh: 超越最终答案：基于 H&E 与 mIF 的可解释肿瘤免疫微环境推理
items.abstract_en: Readouts of the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME), such as CD8+ T-cell density, intra-epithelial infiltration and the Ki67 index, combine tissue architecture from H&E with cell phenotypes from multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF). Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) could automate these readouts with an explanation, but two gaps remain. Pathology MLLMs read H&E alone, while these readouts need the cell phenotypes that mIF measures. And their reasoning has no step-level truth to be checked against, so R1-style reinforcement learning rewards only the final answer and leaves the reasoning unverified. Same-section H&E and mIF provide what both gaps lack: mIF measures every cell without manual annotation, which gives cell-level ground truth for each step that clinical guidelines prescribe, from delineating a tissue compartment to counting and normalizing the marker-positive cells within it. We therefore present HERMES (H&E-mIF Reasoning with Multimodal Evidence Supervision), an R1-style MLLM that reasons jointly over paired H&E and mIF in guideline steps and is trained with a process reward that checks every stated quantity against this truth. Across four field-level TIME tasks in colorectal cancer, HERMES (4B) reaches an average accuracy of 84.5%, compared with 74.7% for the strongest of twelve proprietary, general, medical and pathology MLLMs, and a higher share of its intermediate quantities is correct than for the strongest open-weight baseline. Without the process reward, reinforcement learning barely improves on supervised fine-tuning (80.0% vs. 78.8%) and fewer stated quantities are correct; editing a decisive stated quantity changes the answer as implied in all 885 test questions. Without retraining, it keeps the highest average accuracy on an external cohort imaged with CODEX (76.4% vs. 67.3%) and on head and neck cancer, a cancer type absent from training (76.7% vs. 72.5%).
items.abstract_zh: 肿瘤免疫微环境（TIME）的读数，如 CD8+ T 细胞密度、上皮内浸润与 Ki67 指数，需要结合 H&E 提供的组织结构信息与多重免疫荧光（mIF）提供的细胞表型信息。多模态大语言模型（MLLM）有望自动给出这些读数并附带解释，但仍存在两个缺口：病理 MLLM 通常只读 H&E，而这类读数离不开 mIF 测得的细胞表型；其推理过程也缺乏步骤级的真值可供核对，因此 R1 式强化学习只奖励最终答案，推理本身未被验证。同一张切片的 H&E 与 mIF 恰好补上这两点：mIF 无需人工标注即可测量每一个细胞，从而为临床指南规定的每个步骤（从划分组织区域到计数并归一化其中的标志物阳性细胞）提供细胞级真值。据此我们提出 HERMES（H&E-mIF 多模态证据监督推理），一个按指南步骤在配对的 H&E 与 mIF 上联合推理的 R1 式 MLLM，并用过程奖励对照上述真值核查每一个给出的数值。在结直肠癌的四项视野级 TIME 任务上，HERMES（4B）平均准确率达 84.5%，而十二个专有、通用、医学与病理 MLLM 中最强者为 74.7%；其中间数值的正确比例也高于最强的开源权重基线。去掉过程奖励后，强化学习相比监督微调提升甚微（80.0% 对 78.8%），给出的正确数值也更少；修改某个决定性数值会按预期改变全部 885 道测试题的答案。在不重新训练的情况下，它在外部队列上仍保持最高平均准确率。
items.highlight_zh: 用 mIF 细胞级真值做过程奖励，让病理推理每一步可核查
items.digest_zh: 【研究的问题】肿瘤免疫微环境的量化读数（如 CD8+ T 细胞密度、上皮内浸润、Ki67 增殖指数）是免疫治疗评估的重要依据，读这些片子既要看 H&E 染色的组织结构，又要看多重免疫荧光（mIF）标记出的细胞类型。多模态大模型本可自动完成并给出解释，但现有病理模型只读 H&E，缺少细胞表型信息；更麻烦的是，它们的推理链条没有“标准答案”可对照，强化学习只能奖励最后那个数字，中间推理是否正确无从检查。【方法】作者抓住一个巧妙的点：同一张切片的 H&E 与 mIF 是配对的。mIF 不需要人工标注就能测出每个细胞的身份，于是指南规定的每一步（先划分组织区域，再计数区域内的阳性细胞并做归一化）都自动获得细胞级真值。据此构建 HERMES——一个按指南步骤在 H&E 与 mIF 上联合推理的 R1 式多模态大模型，并设计过程奖励，逐步对照真值核查它说出的每个数值。【结果】在结直肠癌的四项视野级任务上，仅 4B 参数的 HERMES 平均准确率 84.5%，高于十二个专有/通用/医学/病理大模型中的最强者（74.7%）；中间数值的正确率也超过最强开源基线。去掉过程奖励后，强化学习相比监督微调几乎没长进（80.0% 对 78.8%）。作者还做了因果检验：改动某个关键数值，全部 885 道题的答案都按预期随之改变。外部数据队列上不重训也保持最高准确率。【为何重要】它把“答案对不对”升级为“每一步算得对不对”，让病理 AI 的推理真正可核查、可解释。

items.title_en: Generating grain boundary structures at a specified energy with a symmetry-constrained diffusion model
items.title_zh: 用对称性约束扩散模型生成具有指定能量的晶界结构
items.abstract_en: Grain boundaries (GBs) govern many properties of polycrystalline materials, and inverse design would make the GB structure itself a design variable. Crystal generative models such as MatterGen operate on periodic cells, which contain two GBs. The cell energy defines a single GB only when the two are equivalent, but existing models do not enforce this equivalence. Building on MatterGen, we developed a symmetry-constrained diffusion model in which the two GBs are related by a symmetry operation: atoms near one GB are generated, and those near the other are reconstructed through a symmetry projection applied at every denoising step. We applied it to the $Σ5(210)[001]$ symmetric tilt GB in Al, conditioning generation on the GB energy from a machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP). All 350 generated structures kept a geometrically equivalent GB pair after relaxation. Given a target GB energy, the model generated structures at that energy: for the three in-range targets with many nearby training structures, 44% to 70% fell within $\pm 0.1$ J/m$^2$ of the target. Tracking weakened at higher energies and failed outside the training range. Of the 91 near-target structures, 90 matched no training structure under the adopted geometric criterion, indicating that the model can propose configurations near the target energy that are distinct from the training structures, a capability that could help identify unknown metastable GB structures observed in experiments. Building GB-pair equivalence into generation thus makes GB properties well-defined design targets, enabling inverse design of GB structures.
items.abstract_zh: 晶界（GB）决定多晶材料的许多性质，逆向设计可让晶界结构本身成为设计变量。MatterGen 等晶体生成模型作用于含两个晶界的周期晶胞，而晶胞能量只有在两个晶界等价时才对应单一晶界的能量，现有模型并未强制这一等价。我们在 MatterGen 基础上构建对称性约束扩散模型：仅生成一个晶界附近的原子，另一晶界附近的原子在每个去噪步骤经对称投影重建。以 Al 中 Σ5(210)[001] 对称倾斜晶界为例，用机器学习原子间势（MLIP）给出的晶界能量作为条件，350 个生成结构弛豫后均保持几何等价的晶界对；对训练数据充足的目标能量，44%–70% 的结构落在目标 ±0.1 J/m² 内，91 个近目标结构中 90 个不匹配任何训练结构。该工作使晶界性质成为良定义的设计目标。
items.highlight_zh: 把晶界对等价性嵌入生成过程，实现按目标能量逆向设计晶界结构
items.digest_zh:
① 研究问题：晶界是多晶材料中晶粒之间的界面，强度、韧性、导电性等很多性质都由它决定。若能“按需”设计晶界结构（逆向设计），材料设计就多一个自由度。但生成模型通常工作在周期性晶胞上，一个晶胞天然包含两个晶界，只有二者几何等价时，晶胞能量才对应“一个”晶界的能量；现有模型不保证这点，于是“目标能量”这一条件就变得含混。
② 方法：作者在晶体生成模型 MatterGen 上加入对称性约束。只让模型生成其中一个晶界附近的原子，另一个晶界附近的原子在扩散模型每个去噪步骤通过预设对称操作“投影”重建，从生成机制上保证两个晶界永远等价。随后以机器学习原子间势（MLIP）算出的晶界能量为条件，针对铝中的 Σ5(210)[001] 对称倾斜晶界做条件生成。
③ 结果：生成的 350 个结构经弛豫后全部保持等价晶界对，说明约束确实生效。给定训练数据覆盖范围内的目标能量时，44%–70% 的生成结构落在目标 ±0.1 J/m² 以内；能量更高时命中率下降，超出训练范围则失效，这是数据驱动的固有限制。更值得注意的是，91 个接近目标的结构中，有 90 个在几何判据下与任何训练结构都不同，说明模型不是“背答案”，而是提出了新构型。
④ 为何重要：这把“晶界能量”变成了定义明确、可优化的设计目标，使晶界结构逆向设计成为可能；模型给出的新候选还有望帮助解释实验中观察到但结构未知的亚稳晶界。

items.title_en: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Learning via Subchunk Rollouts in Latent World Models
items.title_zh: 面向 VLA 的高效强化学习：隐空间世界模型中的子块推演
items.abstract_en: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can improve pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies through imagined experiences. However, existing VLA-MBRL methods primarily rely on large-scale image or video generation world models, incurring large computational overhead. Latent world models offer a more efficient alternative but face two challenges: compounding errors during recursive prediction and incompatibility with VLAs' visual input interfaces. In this work, we propose LS-MBPO, a lightweight residual MBRL framework that leverages latent world models to improve upon pretrained VLAs. LS-MBPO introduces two key techniques: (1) Hierarchical Forcing, which combines dense causal supervision with autoregressive feedback to mitigate compounding prediction errors; and (2) Latent Subchunk Rollouts, which leverage action chunks from a frozen VLA policy and a latent residual policy for successive subchunk refinement, bridging the gap between latent imagination and VLA policy execution. We further introduce a Progress-Conditioned Branch-Start Curriculum that progressively shifts rollout starting points from later to earlier task stages, enabling effective policy learning from short imagined rollouts. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world ALOHA robot show that LS-MBPO achieves superior task performance and training efficiency compared to existing methods.
items.abstract_zh: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）可通过想象经验改进预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，但现有方法多依赖大规模图像或视频生成世界模型，计算开销大。隐空间世界模型更高效，却面临递归预测误差累积、与 VLA 视觉输入接口不兼容两大挑战。我们提出 LS-MBPO：一个轻量残差 MBRL 框架，用隐空间世界模型改进预训练 VLA。其两项关键技术为：(1) 分层强制（Hierarchical Forcing），将稠密因果监督与自回归反馈结合以缓解累积预测误差；(2) 隐空间子块推演（Latent Subchunk Rollouts），利用冻结 VLA 策略的动作块与隐空间残差策略做连续子块细化，弥合隐空间想象与 VLA 执行之间的差距。还提出进度条件的分支起点课程，将推演起点由任务后段逐步前移，使短程想象也能有效学习。在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 及真实 ALOHA 机器人上的实验表明，LS-MBPO 在任务性能与训练效率上均优于现有方法。
items.highlight_zh: 用隐空间世界模型做轻量残差强化学习，训练更省且性能更好
items.digest_zh:
① 研究问题：VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型是当前机器人操作的主流方案，预训练后还可用强化学习继续提升。基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）让策略在“想象”中练习，省去真实交互成本。但现有 VLA-MBRL 大多用图像或视频生成模型充当世界模型，代价极高；隐空间世界模型更轻量，却有两个麻烦：递归预测的误差会累积，且隐空间表示与 VLA 的视觉输入接口对不上。
② 方法：作者提出 LS-MBPO，一个轻量级“残差”式 MBRL 框架，含两项关键技术。其一是分层强制（Hierarchical Forcing）：把稠密的因果监督与自回归反馈结合起来训练隐空间世界模型，抑制多步预测漂移。其二是隐空间子块推演：冻结预训练 VLA，用其输出的动作块作“骨架”，再由一个隐空间残差策略在连续子块上逐步修正，从而把隐空间里的想象与实际策略执行衔接起来。此外还设计了“进度条件的分支起点课程”：推演起点从任务后段逐渐前移到前段，让模型能从很短的想象片段中学到东西。
③ 结果：在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 两个仿真基准和真实 ALOHA 机器人上，LS-MBPO 的任务成功率与训练效率都优于现有方法。
④ 为何重要：它说明不必依赖昂贵的大规模视频生成，也能用世界模型有效提升 VLA；对真实机器人而言，“训练更省、效果更好”直接决定这类方法能否落地。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: What Helps Language-Model Agents Review Violent Video? A Controlled Comparison with a Human Evidence Reference
items.title_zh: 什么有助于语言模型智能体审阅暴力视频？与人类证据参照的受控比较
items.abstract_en: Systems that flag violent video for a human operator can now be built from language models without training, by combining perception models and letting a language model decide. We ask how the observations of the perception models should reach the decision, and which evidence matters. On the XD-Violence test set (799 clips) we fix one set of perception agents (video description, object detection, sound tagging, speech recognition and speech tagging) and one reasoning model, and compare three interfaces: messages between agents, a typed evidence graph explored with tools, and flat text read in one pass; and a single audio-visual model given the raw clip. Two annotators provide a human reference that records the decision, the incident segments and whether they relied on sight, sound or speech. Flat text matches the single model (F1 0.967 against 0.968), while the graph agent and message passing are less accurate; a variant of the graph agent developed on a separate set did not close the gap, and both graph summaries and multi-turn tool use lowered accuracy. These results hold with reworded prompts and with a larger reasoning model, except that the larger model weakens message passing enough for the graph agent to beat it. Sound events improve F1 by +0.012 [+0.004, +0.021], in line with the annotators, who used sound or speech on most violent clips. Citations of stored observations are faithful, changing about half of the decisions when removed, but no more so with the graph than with flat text, and the agent pipeline costs about 3 times the GPU time of the single model. We also report two artefacts of vision-language describers that mislead pipelines built on them.
items.abstract_zh: 无需训练，把感知模型与语言模型组合起来即可构建为人工操作员标记暴力视频的系统。我们研究感知模型的观测应以何种方式进入决策，以及哪类证据更重要。在 XD-Violence 测试集（799 段）上固定一组感知智能体（视频描述、目标检测、声音标注、语音识别与语音标注）和一个推理模型，比较三种接口：智能体间消息传递、借助工具探索的类型化证据图、一次性读入的纯文本，并另设一个直接输入原始视频的音视频模型。两位标注者提供人类参照，记录决策、事件片段及是否依赖视觉、声音或语音。纯文本与单一模型表现相当（F1 0.967 对 0.968），证据图与消息传递更差；在另一数据集上改进的图智能体也未缩小差距，且多轮工具调用会降低准确率。改写提示或换用更大推理模型后结论基本成立（更大模型使消息传递变差，从而被图智能体反超）。声音事件带来 +0.012 的 F1 提升，与标注者大多依赖声音或语音一致。观测引用是忠实的，移除后约半数决策改变；但智能体流水线的 GPU 时间约为单一模型的 3 倍。我们还报告了视觉-语言描述器两类会误导流水线的假象。
items.highlight_zh: 复杂智能体接口未必更好，朴素纯文本输入准确率高且更省 GPU
items.digest_zh:
① 研究问题：为人工审核员标记暴力视频的系统，如今可以完全不训练——把若干现成感知模型（描述画面、检测物体、识别声音、语音转写等）拼起来，再让一个语言模型综合判断即可。但“怎么把观测喂给决策者”这个接口设计问题此前缺少系统比较；哪些证据（画面、声音、语音）真正有用也不清楚。
② 方法：作者在 XD-Violence 测试集（799 段视频）上做受控实验：固定同一组感知智能体和同一个推理模型，只改变接口——智能体之间互相发消息；用工具探索的类型化证据图；一次性读入的纯文本。另加一个直接看原始视频的音视频模型作对照。两位标注者建立人类参照，记录判断结果、事件片段，以及他们依据的是画面、声音还是语音。
③ 结果：纯文本最简单，效果却与单一音视频模型持平（F1 0.967 对 0.968）；证据图智能体和多轮消息传递反而更差，在另一份数据上专门改进的图智能体版本也没能追平；把证据图摘要化、或增加多轮工具调用，都会降低准确率。换措辞、换更强的推理模型后结论基本成立（唯一例外是更强的模型让消息传递退步，反而被图智能体反超）。声音事件带来约 +0.012 的小幅提升，与人类标注者大多依赖声音或语音相符。此外，智能体流水线的 GPU 时间约为单一模型的 3 倍。作者还指出视觉-语言描述器的两类系统性“假象”会误导基于它们搭建的流水线。
④ 为何重要：它提醒工程实践者，这类任务上“更复杂的智能体架构”未必更好——朴素的一次性文本输入，加上可靠的感知与声音证据，可能是性价比最高的方案；同时也量化了多智能体编排的成本与风险。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为检测与跟踪，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对目标尺度、遮挡与实时延迟；公开数据集成绩不能直接等同实际场景效果。 这是综述或观点文献，应与可运行实现区分。

items.title_en: FAST-LIO2: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry
items.abstract_en: This paper presents FAST-LIO2: a fast, robust, and versatile LiDAR-inertial odometry framework. Building on a highly efficient tightly-coupled iterated Kalman filter, FAST-LIO2 has two key novelties that allow fast, robust, and accurate LiDAR navigation (and mapping). The first one is directly registering raw points to the map (and subsequently update the map, i.e., mapping) without extracting features. This enables the exploitation of subtle features in the environment and hence increases the accuracy. The elimination of a hand-engineered feature extraction module also makes it naturally adaptable to emerging LiDARs of different scanning patterns; The second main novelty is maintaining a map by an incremental k-d tree data structure, ikd-Tree, that enables incremental updates (i.e., point insertion, delete) and dynamic re-balancing. Compared with existing dynamic data structures (octree, R*-tree, nanoflann k-d tree), ikd-Tree achieves superior overall performance while naturally supports downsampling on the tree. We conduct an exhaustive benchmark comparison in 19 sequences from a variety of open LiDAR datasets. FAST-LIO2 achieves consistently higher accuracy at a much lower computation load than other state-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial navigation systems. Various real-world experiments on solid-state LiDARs with small FoV are also conducted. Overall, FAST-LIO2 is computationally-efficient (e.g., up to 100 Hz odometry and mapping in large outdoor environments), robust (e.g., reliable pose estimation in cluttered indoor environments with rotation up to 1000 deg/s), versatile (i.e., applicable to both multi-line spinning and solid-state LiDARs, UAV and handheld platforms, and Intel and ARM-based processors), while still achieving higher accuracy than existing methods. Our implementation of the system FAST-LIO2, and the data structure ikd-Tree are both open-sourced on Github.

items.title_zh: FAST-LIO2：快速直接的 LiDAR-惯性里程计
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 FAST-LIO2：一个快速、鲁棒且通用的 LiDAR-惯性里程计框架。它基于高效的紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波，有两个关键创新。其一，直接将原始点云配准到地图（并随之更新地图，即建图），无需提取特征，从而能利用环境中的细微特征提高精度；去掉人工设计的特征提取模块也使其天然适配不同扫描模式的新型 LiDAR。其二，用增量式 k-d 树（ikd-Tree）维护地图，支持增量更新（插入、删除）与动态重平衡；与八叉树、R*-tree、nanoflann k-d 树等动态结构相比，ikd-Tree 综合性能更优，且天然支持在树上降采样。在多个公开 LiDAR 数据集的 19 个序列上进行穷举式基准比较，FAST-LIO2 以更低计算量获得一致更高的精度。还在小视场固态 LiDAR 上开展多项真实实验。总体而言，FAST-LIO2 计算高效（大型室外场景可达 100 Hz 里程计与建图）、鲁棒（杂乱室内环境中旋转达 1000 deg/s 仍可靠估计位姿）、通用（适用于多线旋转与固态 LiDAR、无人机与手持平台、Intel 与 ARM 处理器），且精度高于现有方法。
items.highlight_zh: 直接配准原始点云并用增量 k-d 树建图，又快又准且通用于固态 LiDAR
items.digest_zh:
① 研究问题：LiDAR 与 IMU 融合的里程计是机器人、自动驾驶定位与建图的核心模块。传统方法通常先从点云中提取边缘、平面等特征再做配准；特征提取既依赖人工设计，又会丢掉环境中的细微结构，而且不同扫描模式的 LiDAR（机械旋转式、固态）往往需要重新调参。
② 方法：FAST-LIO2 建立在高效的紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波之上，有两个关键创新。第一，跳过特征提取，把原始点直接配准到地图上，并同步更新地图（即建图）——这样能利用环境中的细微特征提高精度，也天然适配各种新型 LiDAR。第二，用自研的增量式 k-d 树（ikd-Tree）维护地图，支持增量插入、删除与动态重平衡，还能在树上直接做降采样；相比八叉树、R*-tree、nanoflann k-d 树，综合性能更优。
③ 结果：在多个公开 LiDAR 数据集的 19 个序列上做穷举式基准比较，FAST-LIO2 精度一致更高而计算量低得多；在小视场固态 LiDAR、无人机与手持平台、Intel 与 ARM 处理器上都验证可用。它能在大型室外场景达到最高 100 Hz 的里程计与建图，在旋转角速度高达 1000 deg/s 的杂乱室内环境中仍能可靠估计位姿。
④ 为何重要：这项工作同时做到“快”和“准”，并去掉了对特征提取的依赖，使同一系统通用于多线旋转与固态 LiDAR，成为该领域被广泛采用的开源基线。

items.title_en: StereoVLM: Binocular Vision-Language Models for Metric 3D Spatial Reasoning
items.title_zh: StereoVLM：面向度量三维空间推理的双目视觉-语言模型
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong semantic understanding but remain limited in their ability to reason about metric 3D space in the physical world. Existing VLMs typically infer 3D scene structure from one or more images without known camera calibration or cross-view geometric constraints. This makes metric 3D inference inherently ambiguous and leaves it unclear whether their spatial predictions are grounded in visual evidence or driven primarily by semantic priors. In contrast, calibrated stereo provides explicit cross-view geometry that resolves this ambiguity and offers a more reliable foundation for metric 3D perception and geometric generalization. We investigate how VLMs can learn transferable 3D representations directly from calibrated binocular observations. To this end, we introduce StereoVLM, the first geometry-aware binocular VLM for metric 3D spatial reasoning. StereoVLM follows a hierarchical learning paradigm spanning from cross-view correspondence and disparity estimation to calibration-conditioned metric depth perception and semantic spatial reasoning. We further find that disparity supervision generalizes substantially better than direct binocular depth supervision on unseen environments. To evaluate these capabilities, we introduce Stereo3D-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark across three levels, from point-level geometry to object-level spatial reasoning. StereoVLM-8B achieves 95.17% depth accuracy ($δ_1$) and a 66.98 average object-level score on Stereo3D-Bench. Intervention results further indicate that the model's performance on Stereo3D-Bench benefits from valid cross-view geometry and cannot be explained solely by additional visual tokens or semantic priors. Hierarchical geometric supervision also yields average gains of 3.54 points across five spatial benchmarks and 4.3 percentage points in RoboCasa manipulation success.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）语义理解强，但对物理世界中度量三维空间的推理能力有限。现有VLM通常缺少相机标定与跨视角几何约束，度量三维推断本质上存在歧义，也难以判断其空间预测源自视觉证据还是主要受语义先验驱动。标定双目视觉提供显式跨视角几何，可消解歧义。作者提出StereoVLM——首个用于度量三维空间推理的几何感知双目VLM，采用分层学习范式，从跨视角对应与视差估计，递进到标定条件下的度量深度感知与语义空间推理，并发现视差监督在未见环境中的泛化明显优于直接双目深度监督。作者同时发布覆盖点级几何到物体级空间推理的三级基准Stereo3D-Bench。StereoVLM-8B取得95.17%深度准确率（δ1）与66.98物体级平均分；干预实验表明其性能确实依赖有效的跨视角几何，而非仅靠额外视觉token或语义先验。
items.highlight_zh: 首个几何感知双目VLM，用视差监督实现可泛化的度量3D推理
items.digest_zh:
• 研究了什么问题：现在的视觉-语言模型能看图说话，但被问“杯子离我几米”“两个物体谁在前”时，给出的数字往往靠猜。因为它既没有相机内参，也没有左右眼的几何关系，而三维信息在拍照投影时已经丢失，答案容易被语言常识带偏。
• 用了什么方法：作者提出StereoVLM，把“已标定的双目相机”作为输入基础，训练分阶段递进：先学左右图像的对应关系与视差，再学在已知标定下换算成真实尺度的深度，最后做物体级别的空间问答。关键设计是把视差（同一物体在左右图中的像素位置差）作为监督信号。
• 有什么结果：8B参数版本在自建基准Stereo3D-Bench上深度准确率达95.17%（δ1），物体级空间推理平均66.98分。作者还做了干预实验：一旦破坏跨视角几何，性能随之下降，说明模型确实在用几何证据而非仅凭语义先验或更多图像token蒙对答案。此外，在未见过的环境中，用视差监督比直接用深度监督泛化更好。
• 为何重要：机器人、自动驾驶、AR都需要在真实尺度上理解空间。这项工作给出了一条把几何约束“教”进大模型的可行路线，并提供了分级评测标准，便于后续比较。

items.title_en: Confidence-Guided Machine Learning Staging of the Mouse Estrous Cycle from External Anatomical Images Reduces Cytology Burden
items.title_zh: 基于外部解剖图像的置信度引导机器学习小鼠动情周期分期，减轻细胞学负担
items.abstract_en: Although the 2015 National Institutes of Health mandate to consider sex as a biological variable in preclinical studies has increased sex-inclusive study designs, many research groups continue to cite the complexity of monitoring female-specific physiology as a barrier to adoption. Central to this challenge is the murine estrous cycle, a hormonally driven process comprising four stages (proestrus, estrus, metestrus, and diestrus), each associated with distinct hormonal and cytological profiles. Current staging methods rely primarily on vaginal cytology, which requires skilled animal handling, specialized expertise in cytology observation, and considerable time, limiting their routine application outside of reproductive endocrinology. To address these barriers, we developed and evaluated a machine learning framework for estrous cycle staging based on photographs of the mouse external vaginal opening. Using 2,297 photographs from C57BL/6J and BALB/c female mice paired with concurrent cytological assessments and partitioned strictly at the animal level, we trained and evaluated three models of varying granularity: a four-stage model, a three-stage model combining metestrus and diestrus, and a two-stage binary model separating the follicular from the luteal and transitional phases. In a held-out evaluation cohort of 466 photographs from 29 unseen mice, overall classification accuracy was 47.4% (95% CI: 40.7-51.9%) for the four-stage model, 54.5% (47.6-62.9%) for the three-group model, and 69.5% (61.8-75.3%) for the binary two-group model. Misclassifications occurred predominantly between biologically adjacent stages, particularly between proestrus and estrus. Crucially, applying a calibrated confidence threshold to the two-group classifier increased accuracy to 82.8% (95% CI: 71.1-92.1%) among the 43.8% of photographs with confidence [≥] 0.80, and to 92.5% (95% CI: 87.1-96.6%) among the 20.0% of photographs with confidence [≥] 0.90. While external photography does not support standalone four-stage classification, confidence-guided photographic assessment offers an accessible decision-support framework to selectively triage uncertain cases for cytology and reduce the wet-lab burden of estrous monitoring in preclinical research, including cohort assembly for hormone-dependent models of genital tract infection.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管2015年美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）要求将性别作为生物学变量纳入临床前研究，提升了纳入两性的研究设计比例，但许多团队仍以监测雌性特有生理的复杂性为由不予采用。核心难点是小鼠动情周期：它由激素驱动，分为动情前期、动情期、动情后期与间情期四个阶段，各有不同的激素与细胞学特征。现有分期主要依赖阴道细胞学，需要熟练的动物操作、专业的细胞学判读与大量时间，限制了其在生殖内分泌学之外的常规使用。为降低门槛，作者开发并评估了基于小鼠外阴开口照片的机器学习分期框架。使用C57BL/6J与BALB/c雌鼠的2,297张照片（配合同期细胞学评估，并严格按动物划分数据集），训练并评估了三种粒度模型：四阶段模型、合并动情后期与间情期的三阶段模型、区分卵泡期与黄体及过渡期的二分类模型。在由29只未参与训练的雌鼠的466张照片构成的留出队列中，整体准确率分别为47.4%（95% CI 40.7–51.9%）、54.5%（47.6–62.9%）与69.5%（61.8–75.3%）；误分类主要发生在生物学上相邻的阶段之间，尤其是动情前期与动情期。关键在于，对二分类器施加校准后的置信度阈值可将准确率提升至82.8%。
items.highlight_zh: 外阴照片加置信度阈值实现无创分期，大幅减少细胞学负担
items.digest_zh:
• 研究了什么问题：NIH要求临床前研究纳入雌性动物，但很多实验室嫌“追踪动情周期太麻烦”。传统做法是取阴道涂片、染色、在显微镜下判读细胞类型，需要熟练操作与专业知识，还费时间，因此常被跳过。
• 用了什么方法：作者尝试用更简单的外部体征替代细胞学——直接给小鼠外阴开口拍照。他们收集了C57BL/6J和BALB/c两个品系雌鼠的2,297张照片，每张都有同期细胞学结果作为“标准答案”。训练与测试严格按动物划分，避免同一只鼠的照片同时出现在两边。模型分三种粒度：四阶段、三阶段（合并动情后期与间情期）、二分类（卵泡期 vs 黄体及过渡期）。
• 有什么结果：在29只没见过的鼠、466张照片上，四阶段准确率47.4%，三组54.5%，二分类69.5%。错误几乎都发生在生物学上相邻的阶段之间，尤其动情前期与动情期最难区分。给二分类器加上置信度阈值、只对模型有把握的样本给结论后，准确率升到82.8%。
• 为何重要：这并不是要完全取代细胞学，而是把工作量分级——大部分样本用拍照快速筛查，少数不确定的再做涂片确认。这样能显著降低纳入雌性动物的操作门槛，有助于性别作为生物学变量的政策真正落地。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: Ultrasensitive measurement of phase dynamics by time-holographic dark-port readout of a marginally imbalanced interferometer
items.title_zh: 基于微失衡干涉仪时间全息暗端口读出的相位动力学超灵敏测量
items.abstract_en: Resolving displacements and surface irregularities far below a nanometer is now indispensable across fields, from precision manufacturing and biotechnology to nanoscience and fundamental metrology. High-precision optical interferometry reaches this $λ/1{,}000$ regime by reading out optical power, which provides a smooth response over the measurement range. Here we instead read out the complex dark-port field of a marginally imbalanced interferometer, whose phase response to small internal phase deviations $φ_{\textrm{in}}$ near destructive interference becomes extremely steep. For a small arm-amplitude imbalance $μ$, the tangent $T_{\textrm{out}}$ of the dark-port phase reduces to $μ^{-1}φ_{\textrm{in}}$, defining a phase magnification $M=μ^{-1}$. Crucially, this tangent estimator stays linear over a range $|φ_{\textrm{in}}|\lesssim\sqrt{|μ|}$---much larger than the imbalance $|μ|$ itself for $|μ|\ll1$---so that fine temporal substructure is resolved within much larger phase excursions. $T_{\textrm{out}}$ is synthesized from the dark-port complex field by optical time-domain holography and Fourier demodulation---a heterodyne readout that is intrinsically immune to laser relative-intensity noise at any magnification, and gives time-resolved access to phase dynamics. In a proof-of-principle Mach--Zehnder experiment, without optimization or environmental isolation, we demonstrate $|M|>10^3$ and optical-path resolution better than $λ/100{,}000$ ($\approx5~\textrm{pm}$), with a shot-noise floor orders of magnitude below this environment-limited value. The approach is compact, tunable, and compatible with existing interferometric platforms, offering a practical route to enhanced phase sensitivity in metrology, sensing, and optical instrumentation.
items.abstract_zh: 分辨远低于纳米的位移与表面不平整，在精密制造、生物技术、纳米科学与基础计量等领域已不可或缺。高精度光学干涉测量通过读出光功率达到λ/1000量级，在测量范围内响应平滑。本文改为读出微失衡干涉仪的复暗端口场：接近相消干涉时，其相位对微小内部相位偏差φ_in的响应极其陡峭。对小的臂振幅失衡μ，暗端口相位的正切T_out退化为μ^{-1}φ_in，即相位放大倍数M=μ^{-1}。关键在于，该正切估计在|φ_in|≲√|μ|范围内保持线性——当|μ|≪1时远大于失衡本身——因此能在更大的相位偏移内分辨精细的时间子结构。T_out由暗端口复场经光学时域全息与傅里叶解调合成，这种外差读出在任何放大倍数下都天然免疫激光相对强度噪声，并可时间分辨地获取相位动力学。在原理验证的马赫-曾德尔实验中，未经优化与环境隔离，作者演示了|M|>10³、光程分辨率优于λ/100,000（约5 pm），散粒噪声本底比该环境受限值低数个数量级。该方法紧凑、可调，并兼容现有干涉平台。
items.highlight_zh: 读出暗端口相位放大微小位移，光程分辨率约5 pm
items.digest_zh:
• 研究了什么问题：要测出比纳米还小上千倍的位移，光学干涉仪是主力工具。传统做法是测光强，响应在量程内平滑；想更灵敏就得加大功率、加长腔、做隔振，代价很高。
• 用了什么方法：作者转而读取干涉仪的“暗端口”——把工作点调到几乎完全相消。此时输出虽然很暗，但相位对内部微小相位变化的响应极其陡峭：若两臂振幅有很小的失衡μ，暗端口相位正切对相位偏差φ_in的斜率就是1/μ，等于把相位放大了1/μ倍。巧妙之处在于该线性范围是√|μ|，比μ本身大得多，因此既能放大，又能容纳不小的相位起伏。他们用光学时域全息与傅里叶解调从复场中提取这个正切量，属于外差读出，天然不受激光强度噪声影响。
• 有什么结果：在马赫-曾德尔干涉仪上的原理验证中，没有专门优化，也没有环境隔离，就实现了放大倍数大于10³、光程分辨率优于λ/100,000（约5 pm）。实测噪声主要来自环境，散粒噪声极限还低好几个数量级，说明潜力远未用尽。
• 为何重要：方法紧凑、可调，能直接嫁接到现有干涉平台上，为精密制造、生物传感与基础计量提供了一条提升相位灵敏度的实用路径。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: Model Carving: Training Transformers That Optimize Their Own Topology
items.title_zh: Model Carving：训练能够优化自身拓扑的 Transformer
items.abstract_en: Machine learning has largely kept separate the choice of architecture and the process of training. A classic Transformer, for instance, trains a fixed set of attention and MLP sublayers at every layer, in the same order, and optimizes the weights within. This uniformity is a convention rather than a principled design choice, and it is likely suboptimal: the best architecture for a given task may be smaller, more efficient, and far from uniform. We believe that, ideally, training itself should shape the model's topology. To this end, we introduce Model Carving, which learns both a Transformer's weights and its architecture in a single run. By applying learnable, scalar gates to each sublayer, we allow the training loss to remove the model's own components during training -- freeing a smaller heterogeneous network inside. We evaluate Model Carving by pre-training standard Transformers from 140M to 2.7B parameters and looped Transformers from 140M to 1.3B. At equal training compute, carved models reach a lower validation loss than dense models trained with up to 1.7 times more compute. Furthermore, carved models also outperform size-matched models produced by pruning or distillation, suggesting that the best way to obtain small models for edge devices is to carve them during training, not to compress a large one afterwards. This advantage both grows with scale and carries over to downstream tasks such as few-shot evaluation and generation. Because the removed sublayers no longer run, carved models also cost up to 34% fewer FLOPs per token and decode up to 1.6 times faster without cost in quality. Our results show that architecture, like weights, should be learned and not fixed in advance, and that inside every large transformer is a smaller, faster, stronger one waiting to be carved out.
items.abstract_zh: 机器学习中长期将架构选择与训练过程分离。例如经典Transformer在每层以相同顺序训练固定数量的注意力与MLP子层，并只优化其中权重。这种统一性源于惯例而非有原则的设计选择，很可能次优：给定任务的最佳架构可能更小、更高效且远非均匀。作者认为理想情况下训练本身应塑造模型拓扑。为此提出Model Carving，在一次训练中同时学习Transformer的权重与架构：对每个子层施加可学习的标量门，让训练损失在训练过程中移除模型自身组件，从而释放出内部更小的异构网络。作者在140M至2.7B的标准Transformer与140M至1.3B的循环Transformer上进行预训练评估。相同训练算力下，雕刻模型的验证损失低于用多达1.7倍算力训练的稠密模型，也优于剪枝或蒸馏得到的同尺寸模型，说明为边缘设备获得小模型的最佳方式是训练中“雕刻”，而非事后压缩。该优势随规模增大而增强，并延续到少样本评估与生成等下游任务。由于被移除子层不再运行，每token FLOPs最多减少34%，解码速度最多提升至1.6倍而质量无损。
items.highlight_zh: 用可学习门控在训练中雕刻Transformer，更小更快
items.digest_zh:
• 研究了什么问题：如今训练Transformer时，架构是事先定死的：每层都是“注意力+MLP”，顺序一样、数量一样。这其实是历史惯例，并不保证对某个任务最优——也许这层不需要注意力，那层不需要全部MLP。作者主张架构应当像权重一样被学习出来。
• 用了什么方法：Model Carving给每个子层挂一个可学习的标量门，训练时让损失函数自己把部分门压到零，从而“雕刻”掉不必要组件。训练结束后得到一个更小、层间结构不均匀的网络，且整个过程只需一次训练。作者从140M到2.7B的标准Transformer、以及140M到1.3B的循环Transformer上做预训练来验证。
• 有什么结果：同等训练算力下，雕刻模型的验证损失比用多达1.7倍算力训练的稠密模型还低，也胜过事后剪枝或蒸馏得到的同尺寸模型。优势随规模增大而增强，并延续到少样本评测和文本生成等下游任务。由于被删掉的子层真的不参与计算，每token的FLOPs最多减少34%，解码速度最多快1.6倍而质量不降。
• 为何重要：这提示“架构也应是学出来的，而不是拍脑袋定的”。对手机、边缘设备等需要小模型的场景尤其实际——与其先训大模型再压缩，不如一开始就雕出合适的尺寸。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: SheetAlign: Grounded Interaction and Stage-Isolated Learning for Spreadsheet Agents
items.title_zh: SheetAlign：面向电子表格智能体的接地交互与阶段隔离学习
items.abstract_en: Spreadsheets are widely used for data analysis and supporting decision-making. Automating spreadsheet analysis while protecting sensitive data and controlling deployment costs motivates locally deployed open-weight large language models (LLMs). Meanwhile, complex spreadsheet tasks require both task reasoning and workbook understanding, while predefined operation interfaces impose additional tool-selection and invocation demands. We introduce SheetAlign, a spreadsheet manipulation framework with stage-isolated policy learning, organized around where to operate, what to change, and how to implement transformations. Task-guided inspection and API grounding anchor code generation in workbook observations and available operations, while stage-isolated learning optimizes program generation and review using edit-progress rewards. At inference, execution consistency selects programs through agreement among workbook states. On SpreadsheetBench, our grounded task interface improves Qwen3-4B's accuracy from 13.5% to 29.2% on average without training. With learning and execution consistency, SheetAlign achieves 32.8% accuracy on average on SpreadsheetBench and 30.1% on Domain-Spreadsheet, outperforming comparable baselines. The code will be made publicly available upon publication.
items.abstract_zh: 电子表格广泛用于数据分析与决策。为保护敏感数据并控制部署成本，本地部署的开源大模型成为自动化表格分析的选择。复杂表格任务既需任务推理又需理解工作簿，预定义操作接口还带来工具选择与调用负担。我们提出 SheetAlign 框架，以阶段隔离策略学习围绕“在哪里操作、改什么、如何实现变换”组织流程：任务引导的检查与 API 接地把代码生成锚定在工作簿观察和可用操作上，阶段隔离学习用编辑进度奖励优化程序生成与审查，推理时以工作簿状态间的一致性筛选程序。无需训练，接地任务接口就把 Qwen3-4B 在 SpreadsheetBench 上的平均准确率从 13.5% 提升到 29.2%；加入学习与执行一致性后平均达 32.8%，在 Domain-Spreadsheet 上达 30.1%，优于同类基线。
items.highlight_zh: 阶段隔离学习让 4B 小模型表格操作准确率翻倍
items.digest_zh:
• 问题：让 AI 自动改电子表格（改单元格、写公式、做汇总）很难，模型既要懂任务意图，又要读懂工作簿结构，还得在有限的操作接口里选对工具；出于数据隐私与成本考虑，最好用本地部署的开源小模型，但小模型直接上手准确率很低。
• 方法：SheetAlign 把任务拆成三问——在哪里操作、改什么、怎么改。它先让模型主动检查工作簿，并把真实可用的 API“接地”进提示；再分阶段训练，程序生成与程序审查各自单独优化，奖励来自编辑是否让表格朝目标推进；推理时让模型生成多份程序，按执行后工作簿状态是否一致来挑选。
• 结果：仅靠接地接口、不训练，Qwen3-4B 在 SpreadsheetBench 上就从 13.5% 提升到 29.2%；加上分阶段学习和执行一致性后平均 32.8%，跨领域数据集 30.1%，超过同类基线。
• 意义：说明小模型不必靠蛮力，只要把观察、可用接口和训练目标对齐，也能在真实办公任务上达到可用水平，并可本地部署、保护敏感数据。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models to Stop Safely
items.title_zh: 教视觉-语言-动作模型安全地停下来
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform diverse tasks from visual observations and language instructions. While prior work has explored task suppression and refusal, stopping prohibited behavior once execution is underway and controlling the resulting physical response remain challenging. Our evaluation reveals that policies which suppress a task from its initial state can still complete it when taking over partway through execution. Even when the task remains unfinished, the robot may drop a held object, making non-completion an incomplete measure of safety. To address these challenges, we introduce State-Aware Fallback Imitation (SAFI) for tasks where holding provides an appropriate alternative response. SAFI comprises two stages, (1) fallback target construction, which assigns stationary arm commands and consistent gripper targets throughout prohibited-task demonstrations, and (2) joint policy adaptation, which learns these targets alongside the original actions of retained tasks. This supervision teaches an explicit alternative response at intermediate execution states while maintaining the robot's other skills. Extensive experiments with OpenVLA-OFT across LIBERO and BadLIBERO tasks evaluate prohibited completion, physical incidents, and retained-task performance. On the evaluated LIBERO tasks, SAFI reduces aggregate target success after takeover to 1.3\%, with no recorded physical incidents or action saturation, while preserving high retained-task success.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型使机器人能依据视觉观察和语言指令执行多样任务。已有工作探索了任务抑制与拒绝，但在执行途中停止被禁止的行为并控制由此产生的物理反应仍然困难。我们的评测显示，从初始状态就抑制任务的政策，在接管执行中途时仍可能把任务做完；即便任务未完成，机器人也可能掉落手中物体，使“未完成”成为不完整的安全度量。为此我们提出状态感知回退模仿（SAFI），适用于“保持持握”可作为合适替代响应的任务。SAFI 分两阶段：回退目标构建，在被禁止任务的演示中赋予静止机械臂指令与一致的夹爪目标；联合策略适配，将这些目标与保留任务的原始动作一并学习。在 LIBERO 与 BadLIBERO 任务上用 OpenVLA-OFT 进行实验，评估被禁任务完成率、物理事故与保留任务性能。SAFI 将接管后的目标成功率降至 1.3%，无物理事故与动作饱和，同时保持较高的保留任务成功率。
items.highlight_zh: 接管后违规任务成功率降至 1.3%，且不掉物、无动作饱和
items.digest_zh:
• 问题：机器人用视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）执行任务时，若指令被撤回或发现危险，需要“中途叫停”。但现有安全方法大多只考虑“一开始就拒绝”，论文发现：能在一开始拒绝任务的政策，若在执行到一半时接管，仍可能把任务做完；即使没做完，机器人也可能把手中物体摔掉——所以“没完成任务”并不等于“安全”。
• 方法：作者提出状态感知回退模仿（SAFI），针对“继续握着东西”本身就是安全反应的任务。第一步构造回退目标：在所有被禁止任务的示范里，把机械臂改为保持静止、夹爪维持一致夹持；第二步联合策略适配：把这些回退动作与保留任务的原始动作一起训练，使模型在执行各中间状态都学会一个明确的“备选动作”。
• 结果：在 OpenVLA-OFT 模型、LIBERO 与专门构造的 BadLIBERO 任务上测试，接管后违规目标成功率降至 1.3%，未记录到掉落等物理事故，也无动作饱和，同时保留任务成功率仍很高。
• 意义：把机器人安全从“拒绝开始”推进到“安全中止”，并强调应以物理后果而非任务完成率来衡量安全。

items.title_en: Probing the "Conscious" Mind: Selective Access and Global Workspace in Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 探究“意识”心智：视觉语言模型中的选择性访问与全局工作空间
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual and textual information, but their outputs do not reveal internal concept representations. Global workspace theory (GWT) proposes that information is selected from parallel brain processes, integrated in a shared workspace, and made available to specialised processes. We introduce the Multimodal Concept Lens (MC-Lens), a multimodal Jacobian lens, to study these functions in VLM concept processing. Its vision encoder and language decoder lenses map intermediate states to a shared semantic space defined by the decoder's output vocabulary to compare concept accessibility across modalities. MC-Lens supports internal concept interventions to examine the role of accessed concepts in downstream computation. (i) Accessibility and selective access. Multimodal concept information is readable in intermediate states and selectively accessible as tasks require. We extend "readout carriers" from one name token to a token set to better capture and express concept information and support counterfactual experiments. (ii) Concepts in downstream computation. Counterfactual experiments show that accessed concept information participates in downstream computation and reasoning. (iii) Development of cross-modal alignment and selective access. We develop two J-space metrics tracking the development of cross-modal concept alignment more clearly than hidden state cosine in controlled VLM training. The experiment also shows that reliable selective access develops later than concept accessibility. (iv) Shared functions across models. Across VLM families and sizes, we find shared patterns of concept accessibility, query-dependent selectivity and cross-task intervention effects despite differences in internal organisation. These findings offer an experimental basis to study GWT in multimodal artificial systems and how it can guide cross-modal alignment improvements.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）整合视觉与文本信息，但其输出并不揭示内部概念表征。全局工作空间理论（GWT）提出，信息从并行的脑过程中被选择，在共享工作空间中整合，并可被专门化过程使用。我们引入多模态概念透镜（MC-Lens），一种多模态雅可比透镜，用于研究 VLM 概念处理中的这些功能。其视觉编码器和语言解码器透镜将中间状态映射到由解码器输出词表定义的共享语义空间，以比较跨模态的概念可访问性。MC-Lens 支持内部概念干预，以考察被访问概念在下游计算中的作用。（i）可访问性与选择性访问。多模态概念信息可在中间状态中读取，并可按任务需要被选择性访问。我们将“读出载体”（readout carriers）从一个名称 token 扩展到一个 token 集合，以更好地捕获和表达概念信息，并支持反事实实验。（ii）下游计算中的概念。反事实实验表明，被访问的概念信息参与下游计算与推理。（iii）跨模态对齐与选择性访问的发展。我们开发了两个 J-space 指标，在受控 VLM 训练中比隐藏状态余弦更清晰地追踪跨模态概念对齐的发展。实验还表明，可靠的选择性访问比概念可访问性发展得更晚。（iv）跨模型的共享功能。在不同 VLM 系列和规模中，尽管内部组织存在差异，我们发现概念可访问性、查询依赖的选择性以及跨任务干预效应具有共享模式。这些发现为在多模态人工系统中研究 GWT 以及它如何指导跨模态对齐改进提供了实验基础。

items.title_en: One-Step Self-Assembling Lipopolymer Coatings Enable Direct Longitudinal Biosensing in Native Biological Matrices
items.title_zh: 一步自组装脂质聚合物涂层实现原生生物基质中的直接纵向生物传感
items.abstract_en: Sample-driven cross-reactivity remains a fundamental bottleneck for sensitive and selective biosensing in complex biological environments, particularly in microfluidic systems where high surface-to-volumes ratios amplify non-specific interactions. Here, we address this challenge with a one-step, biomimetic surface functionalization strategy based on engineered lipid-based nanocarriers that self-assemble within minutes into immunoassay-ready, antifouling interfaces that couple pegylated-lipid passivation with biorthogonal, site-specific probe conjugation. This approach enables rapid, tuneable, and reproducible surface functionalization, which suppresses sample-specific cross-reactivity even in undiluted serum, and supports direct, label-free digital biosensing assays directly in native biological environments. When integrated into an optofluidic platform combining digital in-line holography and microfluidics, this approach allows time-resolved quantification of tetraspanin-positive extracellular vesicle secretion dynamics from two-dimensional and three-dimensional lung cancer cell models using 50 μL of sample within 10 min, without isolation or purification. Because the presented surface functionalization proceeds via self-assembly rather than covalent surface modification, this one-step modular-approach is intrinsically decoupled from device fabrication and applies to both glass and PDMS, coating the entire microfluidic channel, thereby establishing a general route for integrating biomimetic nanostructures into robust, high-performance immunoassays, advancing biosensing beyond end-point measurements, and towards rapid and continuous real-time monitoring.
items.abstract_zh: 样本驱动的交叉反应性仍然是复杂生物环境中灵敏且选择性生物传感的基本瓶颈，尤其是在高表面积与体积比会放大非特异性相互作用的微流控系统中。在此，我们通过一种一步、仿生的表面功能化策略应对这一挑战；该策略基于工程化脂质纳米载体，这些载体可在数分钟内自组装成即用型免疫分析、抗污染界面，将聚乙二醇化脂质钝化与生物正交、位点特异性探针偶联相结合。该方法实现快速、可调且可重复的表面功能化，即使在未稀释血清中也能抑制样本特异性交叉反应，并支持直接在原生生物环境中进行直接、无标记的数字生物传感测定。当集成到结合数字同轴全息与微流控的光流控平台中时，该方法可在 10 分钟内使用 50 μL 样本，对二维和三维肺癌细胞模型中的四跨膜蛋白阳性细胞外囊泡分泌动态进行时间分辨定量，无需分离或纯化。由于所提出的表面功能化通过自组装而非共价表面修饰进行，这一一步模块化方法本质上与器件制造解耦，并适用于玻璃和 PDMS，涂覆整个微流控通道，从而为将仿生纳米结构整合到稳健、高性能免疫分析中建立了一条通用路径，推动生物传感超越终点测量，迈向快速、连续的实时监测。

items.title_en: Composite Dielectric-Loaded Metallic Metagratings for Dual-Polarized Transmissive Beam Manipulation
items.title_zh: 用于双极化透射光束调控的复合介质加载金属超光栅
items.abstract_en: We present and experimentally demonstrate a comprehensive analytical suite for the design of transmissive metal-based metagratings (MGs) for dual-polarized anomalous refraction. Considering a composite configuration of perforated metallic slabs with controlled dielectric loading, we develop a rigorous mode-matching formulation tying the various MG degrees of freedom to the various reflected and transmitted Floquet-Bloch modes, enabling efficient beam deflection for both transverse electric (TE) and transverse magnetic (TM) polarizations. Inherently versatile, the analytical framework accurately models single-layer and double-layer constructs with multiple rectangular perforations per unit cell, each potentially loaded with dielectric material. We harness this degree-of-freedom abundance to devise diverse polarization-sensitive transmissive MGs, ranging from all-metallic single-layer and double-layer structures for single-polarized (TM or TE) perfect anomalous refraction, to dielectric-loaded architectures implementing dual-polarized routing of the incident wave. Beyond highlighting concrete paths to address TE-polarized fields in such formations, our results, validated via full-wave simulations and experiments at K band, showcase the great potential of metal-based MGs for manipulating fields in transmission, facilitating effective synthesis of durable dual-polarized beamforming superstrates for environmentally demanding and high power antenna applications.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出并通过实验演示了一套综合分析套件，用于设计面向双极化反常折射的透射式金属基超光栅（MG）。考虑具有受控介质加载的穿孔金属板复合配置，我们开发了一种严格的模式匹配公式，将各种 MG 自由度与各种反射和透射 Floquet-Bloch 模式联系起来，从而实现对横电（TE）和横磁（TM）两种极化的高效光束偏转。该分析框架本质上具有通用性，可准确建模每单元具有多个矩形穿孔、且每个穿孔可加载介质材料的单层和双层结构。我们利用这种丰富的自由度设计了多种极化敏感透射式 MG，从用于单极化（TM 或 TE）完美反常折射的全金属单层和双层结构，到实现入射波双极化路由的介质加载架构。除了强调在此类结构中处理 TE 极化场的具体路径外，我们的结果经 K 波段全波仿真和实验验证，展示了金属基 MG 在透射场调控方面的巨大潜力，有助于为环境要求严苛和高功率天线应用有效合成耐用的双极化波束赋形覆层。

items.title_en: The Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework: Scalable Multimodal UX Attribution in Web Search
items.title_zh: 双层情感框架：网络搜索中可扩展的多模态用户体验归因
items.abstract_en: Sustaining user experience (UX) quality in large-scale web search requires scalable evaluation. Traditional surveys are slow and bottleneck rapid A/B testing, while automated metrics often lack the granularity to diagnose visual-spatial UX anomalies. To address this, we introduce the Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework, a novel industrial architecture for automated UX attribution. Tier 1 (Macro System) acts as a scalable user sentiment regression detector, utilizing a fine-tuned encoder-decoder LLM (based on Gemini XS) on telemetry features. Through multi-task regularization and contextual feature engineering, this tier achieves a +9.8% PR-AUC gain on over 500,000 held-out records, matching baseline recall on all validated regressions with $\sim$20% relative precision gain among the 12 held-out experiments. In production, it reduces measurement latency from weeks to hours and cuts survey overhead by over 40%. Tier 2 (Micro System) provides granular diagnostics by employing a Multimodal LLM (Gemini 3.0 Pro) to natively assess visual renderings and spatial layout of web result blocks, quantifying "User Toil" as the estimated effort required to reach a satisfactory result. Enhanced by RL-based automated prompt optimization and an AI judge for win/loss patterns, the MLLM yields a $>$6.5% F1 score improvement, offering deep insights into content quality and layout friction. Ultimately, this framework enables scalable, accurate, and diagnostic UX attribution, processing O(100k) live experiment queries daily.
items.abstract_zh: 维持大规模网络搜索中的用户体验（UX）质量需要可扩展的评估。传统调查速度慢，会瓶颈化快速 A/B 测试，而自动化指标往往缺乏诊断视觉空间 UX 异常的粒度。为解决此问题，我们引入双层情感框架（Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework），一种用于自动化 UX 归因的新颖工业架构。第 1 层（宏观系统）充当可扩展的用户情感回归检测器，利用基于 Gemini XS 的微调编码器-解码器 LLM 处理遥测特征。通过多任务正则化和上下文特征工程，该层在超过 500,000 条留出记录上实现 +9.8% 的 PR-AUC 增益，在 12 个留出实验中，在匹配所有已验证回归的基线召回率的同时，相对精确率提升约 20%。在生产环境中，它将测量延迟从数周缩短至数小时，并将调查开销降低 40% 以上。第 2 层（微观系统）通过采用多模态 LLM（Gemini 3.0 Pro）原生评估网页结果块的视觉渲染和空间布局，提供细粒度诊断，将“用户辛劳”（User Toil）量化为达到满意结果所需的估计工作量。在基于 RL 的自动提示优化和用于胜/负模式的 AI 评审器增强下，该 MLLM 取得 >6.5% 的 F1 分数提升，提供对内容质量和布局摩擦的深入洞察。最终，该框架实现可扩展、准确且具诊断性的 UX 归因，每天处理 O(100k) 个实时实验查询。

items.title_en: RoSci: Exploring Robustness in Science VLMs
items.title_zh: RoSci：探索科学视觉语言模型的鲁棒性
items.abstract_en: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable significant progress in scientific tasks. However, these models are generally assumed to be presented with complete and accurate information, overlooking the challenges of erroneous/missing information in wild scenarios. To address this gap, we introduce the concept of Scientific Model Robustness, which defines a model's ability to detect anomalies, assess solvability, and perform self-calibration when faced with Information Error (inconsistencies) or Information Loss (insufficiency). Specifically, we present RoSci-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,220 samples using a seed-variant strategy across six degradation types. To address VLM fragility, we further propose RoSci-Agent, a framework that employs a Parse-Verify-Decide pipeline to vet premises before reasoning. The evaluated VLMs sometimes answer questions whose premises are invalid or incomplete. RoSci-Agent achieves a higher Overall Robustness Score than the evaluated standalone VLMs. RoSci-Bench gives the multimodal reasoning community a common test of when models answer, request clarification, or reject a scientific question.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的近期进展使科学任务取得了显著进步。然而，这些模型通常被假设接收的是完整且准确的信息，忽视了野外场景中错误/缺失信息带来的挑战。为弥补这一空白，我们引入科学模型鲁棒性（Scientific Model Robustness）概念，它定义模型在面对信息错误（不一致）或信息丢失（不充分）时检测异常、评估可解性并进行自校准的能力。具体而言，我们提出 RoSci-Bench，一个包含 1,220 个样本的诊断基准，采用种子变体策略覆盖六种退化类型。为解决 VLM 的脆弱性，我们进一步提出 RoSci-Agent，一个采用解析-验证-决策（Parse-Verify-Decide）流水线在推理前审查前提的框架。被评估的 VLM 有时会回答前提无效或不完整的问题。RoSci-Agent 取得比被评估的独立 VLM 更高的总体鲁棒性分数（Overall Robustness Score）。RoSci-Bench 为多模态推理社区提供了一个共同测试，用于判断模型何时回答、请求澄清或拒绝一个科学问题。

items.title_en: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
items.title_zh: AgentRoboCritic：理解前沿智能体在直接机器人控制中的能力
items.abstract_en: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.
items.abstract_zh: 像 GPT-6 Astra 这样的前沿多模态语言智能体已展示出通过低级数值动作直接控制机器人的强大能力，而无需高级原语。然而，现有基准仅报告回合级成功率，既不能显示这些智能体如何成功，也不能显示它们在哪里失败。在本文中，我们对前沿智能体在 12 个操作基准上的直接机器人控制进行系统性的动作级分析。我们引入 AgentRoboCritic，一个以意图为基础的批评框架，其中策略智能体在每次动作旁陈述局部意图，批评器根据该意图评估动作的结果和失败模式。我们的动作级分析展示了前沿智能体在直接机器人控制中的有前景能力，包括从局部执行失败中进行闭环恢复、跨多样场景的可靠语义基础，以及在无任务特定适应情况下的强零样本操作能力。它还识别出它们当前的局限，包括抓取和对齐等与任务相关的物理执行瓶颈，以及跨失败模式的不均衡恢复。最后，我们在一个包含 400 个动作的人工标注基准上验证了我们的批评器，并发布了包含 12,844 个标注动作的数据集，以及一个微调的开源批评器 Muse-Glimmer-30B，其失败模式准确率从 32.58% 提升至 74.24%，从而实现低成本的动作级分析。

items.title_en: One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
items.title_zh: 一个先验，两种动力学：复用视频扩散Transformer进行自监督潜在动作学习
items.abstract_en: Videos reveal how the world changes, but rarely the actions that cause those changes. Latent action learning recovers such supervision from visual transitions, yet often learns the underlying dynamics largely from scratch. We ask whether a pretrained video generator can instead provide the prior for both inverse and forward dynamics. We introduce O$^{2}$LaF, built on a simple principle: one prior, two dynamics. We initialize both models from the same pretrained video DiT and adapt them to their distinct roles: a feed-forward transition encoder with learnable action queries for inverse dynamics, and a causal, action-conditioned video generator for forward dynamics. By controlling information access and optimizing both dynamics end-to-end through a compact bottleneck, O$^{2}$LaF learns transferable actions from unlabeled videos. Across navigation and robotic manipulation, O$^{2}$LaF sets a new state of the art in few-shot action probing and enables stronger zero-shot action transfer across visual contexts and embodiments. Beyond generative video priors, we further extend our framework to predictive representation priors such as V-JEPA2, achieving competitive performance. Our findings suggest a broader paradigm for latent-action learning: repurposing pretrained video models to discover transferable actions and predict their consequences.
items.abstract_zh: 视频揭示世界如何变化，但很少揭示导致这些变化的动作。潜在动作学习从视觉变化中恢复此类监督，但通常仍主要从头学习底层动力学。我们探究预训练视频生成器能否转而同时为逆向动力学和正向动力学提供先验。我们提出O$^{2}$LaF，其基于一个简单原则：一个先验，两种动力学。我们从同一个预训练视频DiT初始化两个模型，并使它们适应各自不同的角色：一个带有可学习动作查询的前馈转移编码器用于逆向动力学，以及一个因果的、以动作为条件的视频生成器用于正向动力学。通过控制信息访问并通过紧凑瓶颈端到端优化两种动力学，O$^{2}$LaF从无标注视频中学习可迁移动作。在导航和机器人操作中，O$^{2}$LaF在少样本动作探测上设定了新的最先进水平，并实现了跨视觉上下文和具身形态更强的零样本动作迁移。除生成式视频先验之外，我们进一步将框架扩展到V-JEPA2等预测式表示先验，取得了有竞争力的性能。我们的发现提示了一种更广泛的潜在动作学习范式：复用预训练视频模型来发现可迁移动作并预测其后果。

items.title_en: Learning effective stochastic predator and prey dynamics across physical and biological systems from limited data
items.title_zh: 从有限数据中学习跨物理和生物系统的有效随机捕食者-猎物动力学
items.abstract_en: Constructing an effective low-dimensional stochastic model from sparse observations requires separating deterministic drift from state-dependent fluctuations when the governing interaction law is unknown. We formulate an adaptive neural stochastic differential equation with topology constraints (TC-AdaNSDE) for two-variable predator--prey dynamics. To regularize the inverse problem when data are scarce, the model combines flexible drift and correlated diffusion fields with density-adaptive local Kramers--Moyal moment estimates and soft phase-space constraints reflecting boundary saddle behavior near extinction and local stability near coexistence. Using a known nonlinear stochastic system, we first show that short-time trajectory error cannot assess diffusion accuracy on its own and must be paired with distributional measures of one-step transitions and long-time phase-space occupancy. We then apply this framework to macroscopic turbulence and zonal flow energies reduced from Hasegawa--Wakatani plasma simulations and to short ecological time series. In the sparse-data regime, TC-AdaNSDE reproduces both short-horizon evolution and long-time invariant energy distributions where deterministic reductions collapse and unconstrained stochastic fits diverge, while recovering physically interpretable drift and fluctuation fields across both physical and biological systems.
items.abstract_zh: 从稀疏观测构建有效的低维随机模型，需要在相互作用规律未知时，将确定性漂移与状态依赖涨落分离。我们提出一种带拓扑约束的自适应神经随机微分方程（TC-AdaNSDE），用于两变量捕食者-猎物动力学。为在数据稀缺时正则化逆问题，该模型将灵活的漂移场和相关扩散场与密度自适应局部Kramers-Moyal矩估计以及软相空间约束相结合，这些约束反映灭绝附近的边界鞍行为与共存附近的局部稳定性。使用一个已知的非线性随机系统，我们首先表明短时轨迹误差本身无法评估扩散精度，必须与一步转移的分布度量和长时间相空间占据度量配合使用。随后我们将该框架应用于从Hasegawa-Wakatani等离子体模拟约化得到的宏观湍流和纬向流能量，以及短生态时间序列。在稀疏数据情形下，TC-AdaNSDE在确定性约化失效、无约束随机拟合发散之处，重现了短时程演化和长时间不变能量分布，同时在物理和生物系统中恢复了具有物理可解释性的漂移场和涨落场。

items.title_en: Probabilistic image generation conditioned on an optical latent code
items.title_zh: 以光学潜在编码为条件的概率图像生成
items.abstract_en: While diffractive optical networks compress images into compact representations, such measurements have predominantly served discriminative inference or deterministic reconstruction. Here we demonstrate probabilistic image generation conditioned solely on a 16_bit binary optical latent code (OLC) formed by a diffractive encoder and binarized camera readout. The intentionally many-to-one mapping makes each OLC specify a class of OLC-compatible images rather than a unique reconstruction target. An OLC_conditioned conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) learns this distribution, while optical re-encoding promotes consistency between generated images and the measured OLC. Numerical characterization and proof-of-concept acquisition with a spatial light modulator_camera system establish the OLC as a physically accessible generative condition. On MNIST, samples generated from a single OLC vary in morphology while preserving class identity, and their optical-recognition accuracy reaches 81.6%, close to the 81.9% obtained from the source OLCs. These results link compact optical sensing to probabilistic synthesis of optically recognizable images.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管衍射光学网络将图像压缩为紧凑表示，此类测量主要服务于判别式推断或确定性重建。在此，我们展示仅以由衍射编码器和二值化相机读出形成的16位二进制光学潜在编码（OLC）为条件的概率图像生成。有意设计的多对一映射使每个OLC指定一类与OLC兼容的图像，而不是唯一的重建目标。一个以OLC为条件的条件变分自编码器（CVAE）学习该分布，而光学重编码促进生成图像与测得OLC之间的一致性。数值表征以及采用空间光调制器-相机系统的概念验证采集确立了OLC作为一种物理上可访问的生成条件。在MNIST上，由单个OLC生成的样本在形态上变化，同时保持类别身份，其光学识别准确率达到81.6%，接近从源OLC获得的81.9%。这些结果将紧凑光学传感与光学可识别图像的概率合成联系起来。

items.title_en: SMSD: A Semantic Misinformation Spreader Detection Approach
items.title_zh: SMSD：一种语义错误信息传播者检测方法
items.abstract_en: Misinformation spreaders on social media significantly amplify false narratives, making early detection critical to mitigate their spread. Existing approaches often overlook evolving user behavior, introduce semantic noise by ignoring user stance, and fail to handle newly emerging users effectively. To address these limitations, we propose a \underline{S}emantic \underline{M}isinformation \underline{S}preader \underline{D}etection approach (SMSD) that models misinformation propagation as a temporal, user-centric, and behavior-driven learning problem. SMSD adopts a multimodal architecture that incorporates three categories of features: user-level, network-level, and conversation propagation. A stance-aware labeling strategy is also introduced to differentiate supportive, opposing, questioning, and neutral users towards misinformation claims. Additionally, a monthly quantile analysis is introduced to simulate realistic, evolving user participation. Initial experimental results on the FibVid COVID-19 benchmark dataset demonstrate that SMSD improves recall by 45.0\%, F1 by 49.5\%, and MCC by 74.6\% under stance-aware labeling and by 17.7\%, 7.4\%, and 11.4\%, respectively, under threshold-based labeling. It consistently outperforms all baselines in both settings.
items.abstract_zh: 社交媒体上的错误信息传播者显著放大虚假叙事，因此早期检测对于缓解其传播至关重要。现有方法常常忽视不断演化的用户行为，因忽略用户立场而引入语义噪声，并且无法有效处理新出现的用户。为解决这些局限，我们提出一种语义错误信息传播者检测方法（SMSD），将错误信息传播建模为一个时间性、以用户为中心且行为驱动的学习问题。SMSD采用多模态架构，融合三类特征：用户级、网络级和对话传播。还引入立场感知标注策略，以区分对错误信息主张持支持、反对、质疑和中立态度的用户。此外，引入月度分位数分析来模拟现实且演化的用户参与。在FibVid COVID-19基准数据集上的初步实验结果表明，在立场感知标注下，SMSD将召回率提高45.0%、F1提高49.5%、MCC提高74.6%；在基于阈值的标注下分别提高17.7%、7.4%和11.4%。在两种设置下，它均持续优于所有基线。

items.title_en: Tasklets: A Unit-Test Benchmark for Language Model Architectures
items.title_zh: Tasklets：面向语言模型架构的单元测试基准
items.abstract_en: We introduce Tasklets, a benchmark of small synthetic tasks for evaluating the computational capabilities of language model sequence-mixing layers. These tasks probe foundational capabilities such as recall, sequence manipulation, and state tracking. Such tasks are widely used in architecture research, but differences in task selection, formulation, and evaluation make comparisons across studies difficult. Tasklets brings these tasks together, organizing them by the capabilities they test and providing a shared setup for evaluating how different architectural layer types learn fundamental computations. We compare a broad range of layer types through controlled experiments with small models. Our task implementations and evaluation code support reproducible, low-cost testing of new architectural proposals: https://github.com/zaydzuhri/flame/tree/tasklets.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出Tasklets，一个由小型合成任务组成的基准，用于评估语言模型序列混合层的计算能力。这些任务探测召回、序列操作和状态跟踪等基础能力。此类任务广泛用于架构研究，但任务选择、表述和评估方面的差异使跨研究比较困难。Tasklets将这些任务汇集在一起，按其所测试的能力组织，并提供共享设置，用于评估不同架构层类型如何学习基本计算。我们通过小模型受控实验比较了广泛的层类型。我们的任务实现和评估代码支持对新架构提议进行可重复、低成本测试：https://github.com/zaydzuhri/flame/tree/tasklets。

items.title_en: Real-time neuromorphic audio and vision perception for autonomous robotic applications: Integration and experimental evaluation on a rover platform
items.title_zh: 面向自主机器人应用的实时神经形态听觉与视觉感知：在漫游车平台上的集成与实验评估
items.abstract_en: Neuromorphic sensing and computing offer a promising alternative to conventional deep learning pipelines for mobile robots, where perception must run continuously under tight latency and energy constraints. However, most neuromorphic solutions are still evaluated offline or on isolated benchmarks, and their integration into complete robotic systems remains largely unexplored. In this technical report, a four-wheel rover platform is presented that combines three real-time perception pipelines: a classical audio tagging pipeline based on Pretrained Audio Neural Networks (PANNs) running on an NVIDIA Jetson GPU, a neuromorphic audio pipeline in which a spiking neural network (SNN) is deployed on the SynSense Xylo Audio~2 chip, and a neuromorphic vision pipeline in which events from an event-based camera are processed by the SpikeYOLO spiking detector for traffic cone detection. On the Xylo chip, the whole processing chain---from the microphone signal to the classification of low- and high-pitched sounds---is performed on-chip, while the host only configures the device and reads the output neurons. All models are deployed as containerised services and integrated through ROS~2, and a configurable action dispatcher maps the detected classes to robot behaviours, closing the loop between perception and actuation. The platform is demonstrated in a proof-of-concept scenario in which the robot reacts to sound classes detected by both audio pipelines and detects traffic cones with the event camera, showing the feasibility of integrating neuromorphic hardware into a multimodal robotic platform operating in real time.
items.abstract_zh: 神经形态感知与计算为移动机器人提供了替代传统深度学习流水线的方案，因为其感知需在严格延迟与能耗约束下持续运行。然而多数神经形态方案仍停留在离线评估或孤立基准上，其在完整机器人系统中的集成尚少探索。本技术报告提出一台四轮漫游车平台，集成三条实时感知流水线：基于预训练音频神经网络（PANNs）、在 NVIDIA Jetson GPU 上运行的经典音频标注流水线；将脉冲神经网络（SNN）部署于 SynSense Xylo Audio 2 芯片的神经形态音频流水线；以及由事件相机事件经 SpikeYOLO 脉冲检测器处理、用于交通锥检测的神经形态视觉流水线。在 Xylo 芯片上，从麦克风信号到高低音分类的全链路均在片内完成，主机仅负责配置设备与读取输出神经元。所有模型以容器化服务部署并经 ROS 2 集成，可配置的动作调度器将检测类别映射为机器人行为，闭合感知与执行回路。平台在概念验证场景中演示了机器人对两套音频流水线识别的声音类别做出反应，并用事件相机检测交通锥。
items.highlight_zh: 把类脑感知芯片与事件相机真正装进机器人实时闭环
items.digest_zh:
• 问题：移动机器人需要持续感知，但传统深度学习流水线耗电高、延迟大。神经形态（类脑）芯片与事件相机有望大幅省电，不过多数研究只在离线数据集上验证，真正装到整台机器人上实时闭环运行的例子很少。
• 方法：作者搭了一台四轮漫游车，同时跑三套实时感知。一是传统音频标注（PANNs）在 NVIDIA Jetson GPU 上运行，作为对照；二是把脉冲神经网络（SNN）部署到 SynSense Xylo Audio 2 芯片上，麦克风信号进、高低音分类出，全在芯片内完成，主机只负责配置与读取结果；三是用事件相机加 SpikeYOLO 脉冲检测器识别交通锥。三者都打包成容器服务，经 ROS 2 连接，再由可配置动作调度器把识别结果映射成机器人动作，形成感知—决策—执行闭环。
• 结果：在概念验证场景中，机器人能对两套音频流水线识别出的声音类别做出反应，也能用事件相机找到交通锥，说明神经形态硬件可实时接入多模态机器人系统。
• 意义：这是一份工程集成报告，价值在于把类脑感知从孤立基准推向整机实时运行，为低功耗机器人感知提供了可复用的集成范式。

items.title_en: Fix Where It Fails: Root-Cause-Guided Agentic Harness Optimization for Scene Graph Generation
items.title_zh: 在失败之处修复：面向场景图生成的根因引导智能体 Harness 优化
items.abstract_en: Scene graph generation (SGG) aims to detect objects in an image and predict the relationships between them. The standard PredCls, SGCls, and SGDet settings show how much performance drops without ground-truth boxes and labels, but not where or why a model fails. Knowing this would allow fixing a model where it fails, without retraining. We propose RoHa-SGG (Root-cause-guided Harness optimization for SGG), which extends agentic harness optimization to SGG. It optimizes the harness, the inference code around a frozen SGG model. RoHa-SGG has two main LLM agents. A root-cause analysis (RCA) agent finds the components where the model fails and diagnoses why, and a proposer agent searches for a harness that fixes these causes. We evaluate RoHa-SGG on Visual Genome and PSG with representative two-stage, one-stage, and multimodal-LLM SGG models. The analysis shows that the components where ground-truth triplets are lost differ across models and datasets. RoHa-SGG improves every metric on all five model-dataset combinations. Graph-constrained R@100 and mR@100 rise by up to 15.8 and 26.4 points for the multimodal LLM and by up to 3.6 and 10.1 points for the two-stage and one-stage models. With root-cause guidance, the harness search reaches the final score of an unguided search up to three times faster.
items.abstract_zh: 场景图生成（SGG）旨在检测图像中的物体并预测它们之间的关系。标准的 PredCls、SGCls 和 SGDet 设置展示了在没有真实框和标签时性能下降多少，但没有展示模型在何处或为何失败。了解这一点将允许在不重新训练的情况下修复模型的失败之处。我们提出 RoHa-SGG（面向 SGG 的根因引导 Harness 优化），将智能体 Harness 优化扩展到 SGG。它优化 Harness，即围绕冻结 SGG 模型的推理代码。RoHa-SGG 有两个主要 LLM 智能体。根因分析（RCA）智能体找出模型失败所在的组件并诊断原因，提议者智能体搜索能够修复这些原因的 Harness。我们在 Visual Genome 和 PSG 上，使用代表性的两阶段、一阶段和多模态 LLM SGG 模型评估 RoHa-SGG。分析表明，真实三元组丢失的组件因模型和数据集而异。RoHa-SGG 在全部五个模型-数据集组合上提升了每一项指标。图约束 R@100 和 mR@100 在多模态 LLM 上分别提升最多 15.8 和 26.4 个百分点，在两阶段和一阶段模型上分别提升最多 3.6 和 10.1 个百分点。在根因引导下，Harness 搜索达到无引导搜索最终分数的速度最多快三倍。

items.title_en: An Explainable and Scalable Hierarchical Tensor Framework for Integrating Multi-Omics and Digital Pathomics
items.title_zh: 一个可解释且可扩展的分层张量框架，用于整合多组学与数字病理组学
items.abstract_en: Background: Precision oncology requires integration of heterogeneous molecular and pathology data, yet many fusion models offer limited biologically grounded interpretability and struggle with missing modalities. Methods: We present Hierarchical Interpretable Tensor Fusion (HIT-Fuse), integrating six modalities: somatic copy number variation, DNA methylation, RNA sequencing, microRNA expression, RPPA protein abundance, and vision transformer-derived pathomics across four TCGA cohorts (glioma, lung adenocarcinoma, breast, and kidney cancer). Modality-specific autoencoders compress high-dimensional inputs, followed by two-stage CP tensor decomposition. Missing latent modalities are reconstructed using clinical covariates and observed omics to expand cohorts and retrain downstream models. A mathematical traceback mechanism enables global and local xAI attributions. Results: HIT-Fuse identifies distinct latent subgroups with significant survival stratification in glioma, breast, and kidney cohorts, both with complete and reconstructed modalities. Cohort expansion yields cohort-specific gains, including a 56.4% relative increase in weighted F1 for glioma. Biological validation against DepMap CRISPR screens, miRTarBase and RPPA annotations supports decoded drivers across all four cohorts. Essential gene rates range from 6.2% in glioma to 7.6% in lung cancer; example drivers include ANAPC11, SNRPD1, PLK1 and RPL14. Of decoded miRNAs, 71-92% have miRTarBase regulatory support, while 77-84% of selected genes are covered in DepMap. Conclusions: HIT-Fuse combines hierarchical tensor fusion, missing-modality reconstruction and traceable attributions to support interpretable multi-omics and digital pathology-based cancer prognosis across heterogeneous cohorts.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：精准肿瘤学需要整合异质性分子和病理数据，但许多融合模型提供的具有生物学依据的可解释性有限，并且在模态缺失时表现困难。方法：我们提出分层可解释张量融合（HIT-Fuse），在四个 TCGA 队列（胶质瘤、肺腺癌、乳腺癌和肾癌）中整合六种模态：体细胞拷贝数变异、DNA 甲基化、RNA 测序、microRNA 表达、RPPA 蛋白丰度以及视觉 Transformer 衍生的病理组学。模态特异性自编码器压缩高维输入，随后进行两阶段 CP 张量分解。利用临床协变量和已观测组学重建缺失的潜在模态，以扩展队列并重新训练下游模型。一种数学回溯机制实现全局和局部 xAI 归因。结果：HIT-Fuse 在胶质瘤、乳腺癌和肾癌队列中识别出具有显著生存分层的不同潜在亚组，无论使用完整模态还是重建模态。队列扩展带来队列特异性增益，包括胶质瘤加权 F1 相对提高 56.4%。基于 DepMap CRISPR 筛选、miRTarBase 和 RPPA 注释的生物学验证支持所有四个队列中解码出的驱动因素。必需基因比例从胶质瘤的 6.2% 到肺癌的 7.6%；示例驱动因素包括 ANAPC11、SNRPD1、PLK1 和 RPL14。在解码的 miRNA 中，71–92% 具有 miRTarBase 调控支持，而所选基因中有 77–84% 被 DepMap 覆盖。结论：HIT-Fuse 结合分层张量融合、缺失模态重建和可追溯归因，以支持跨异质性队列的、基于可解释多组学和数字病理的癌症预后。
