items.title_en: Spatially multiplexed opto-electronic Ising machine with single-shot parallel readout of 100,000 spins
items.title_zh: 具有 100,000 个自旋单次并行读出的空间复用光电伊辛机
items.abstract_en: Ising machines offer a promising route to solving NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems by mapping them onto the ground state of the Ising model. Free-space optical implementations are attractive for their inherent parallelism, scalability, and energy efficiency, yet nearly all rely on individual, sequential spin updates, leaving most of this parallelism unexploited. Here, we reclaim it with a free-space optical analog Ising machine built from off-the-shelf components in which every spin is addressed in parallel and read out in a single camera shot, while letting the system evolve under analog dynamics rather than being written and read one spin at a time. We demonstrate this architecture with over 100,000 spins, the largest spatially multiplexed analog Ising machine reported to date, with a realistic path beyond one million spins limited only by spatial-light-modulator and camera resolution. Across sparse and dense MaxCut and fully connected number-partitioning instances, our machine matches state-of-the-art solution quality. Because every spin updates in parallel, throughput increases with system size, unlike time-multiplexed machines, which slow as problems grow. The same free-space geometry also lets us solve more than 50 problem instances simultaneously, further boosting throughput. Together, these results mark an important step towards a scalable, and energy-efficient Ising machine.
items.abstract_zh: 伊辛机通过将 NP 难组合优化问题映射到伊辛模型的基态，为求解此类问题提供了一条有前景的途径。自由空间光学实现因其固有的并行性、可扩展性和能效而具有吸引力，但几乎所有这些实现都依赖单个、顺序的自旋更新，导致大部分并行性未被利用。在此，我们利用由现成组件构建的自由空间光学模拟伊辛机重新获得这种并行性：其中每个自旋都被并行寻址，并在单次相机拍摄中读出，同时让系统在模拟动力学下演化，而不是一次写入和读取一个自旋。我们以超过 100,000 个自旋演示了该架构，这是迄今报道的最大的空间复用模拟伊辛机，并且具有超过一百万个自旋的现实路径，仅受空间光调制器和相机分辨率限制。在稀疏和稠密 MaxCut 以及全连接数划分实例上，我们的机器达到最先进的解质量。由于每个自旋并行更新，吞吐量随系统规模增加而提高，这与时间复用机器不同，后者会随着问题增大而变慢。相同的自由空间几何结构还使我们能够同时求解 50 多个问题实例，进一步提高吞吐量。总之，这些结果标志着朝着可扩展且高能效的伊辛机迈出了重要一步。

items.title_en: WEIR: Watershed Exploration and Drift-Aware Prefix Shrinkage for Multi-Turn Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: WEIR：面向多轮智能体强化学习的分水岭探索与漂移感知前缀收缩
items.abstract_en: Multi-turn language model agents often receive only a single binary reward at the end of a long interaction trajectory, making it difficult to separate decisive decisions from routine steps or estimate accurate intermediate values. Prefix-tree methods improve sample efficiency by merging trajectories that share action histories, yet two structural flaws remain: naive pooling mixes stale off-policy outcomes into critic targets with fixed weights, and uniform or entropy-driven branching wastes continuations on dead-end states whose outcome is already settled. We introduce WEIR (Watershed Exploration and Intrinsic-Drift Shrinkage), an actor-critic reinforcement learning framework grounded in a Doob turn-variance conservation identity. WEIR maintains a cross-iteration canonical action-prefix tree with exponentially discounted visit counts and trains a prefix-conditioned critic toward a minimax drift-aware shrinkage target that adapts from single-trajectory returns at rare nodes to pooled empirical means at dense nodes. Using the same pre-update critic, WEIR allocates rollout budgets across tasks via Neyman stratification $B_q \propto \sqrt{\hat{p}_q(1-\hat{p}_q)}$ and directs within-task branches to watershed forks where high survival-headroom uncertainty coincides with steep value cliffs. Across four multi-hop QA benchmarks, ALFWorld, and WebShop on Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct, WEIR achieves $32.18\%$ and $37.85\%$ average QA exact match and $84.83\%$ and $87.81\%$ ALFWorld success rates, outperforming CAPO by $1.50$--$3.74$ points while generating $28$--$29\%$ fewer rollout tokens than chain sampling.
items.abstract_zh: 多轮语言模型智能体通常仅在长交互轨迹结束时获得单个二值奖励，这使得难以将决定性决策与常规步骤区分开，也难以估计准确的中间值。前缀树方法通过合并共享动作历史的轨迹来提高样本效率，但仍存在两个结构性缺陷：朴素池化以固定权重将过时的离策略结果混入评论家目标，而均匀或熵驱动的分支会将延续浪费在结果已经确定的死胡同状态上。我们提出 WEIR（分水岭探索与内在漂移收缩），这是一个基于 Doob 轮次方差守恒恒等式的演员-评论家强化学习框架。WEIR 维护一棵跨迭代的规范动作前缀树，其访问计数采用指数折扣，并训练一个以前缀为条件的评论家，使其趋向一个极小极大漂移感知收缩目标；该目标在稀有节点处从单轨迹回报自适应，在稠密节点处过渡到池化经验均值。使用相同的更新前评论家，WEIR 通过 Neyman 分层 $B_q \propto \sqrt{\hat{p}_q(1-\hat{p}_q)}$ 在任务间分配 rollout 预算，并将任务内分支导向这样的分水岭分叉：高生存余量不确定性与陡峭价值悬崖重合。在四个多跳问答基准、ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上，基于 Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct，WEIR 分别达到 32.18% 和 37.85% 的平均问答精确匹配率，以及 84.83% 和 87.81% 的 ALFWorld 成功率，较 CAPO 高出 1.50–3.74 个百分点，同时生成的 rollout token 比链式采样少 28–29%。

items.title_en: Structurally Different, Functionally Persistent: Capability Regions Under Model Optimization
items.title_zh: 结构不同，功能持续：模型优化下的能力区域
items.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) capabilities have been associated with localized parameter regions, enabling targeted model editing and intervention. However, it remains unclear whether a region identified before model optimization remains an effective intervention target afterward. We evaluate the functional persistence and parameter overlap of coding capability regions across three instruction-tuned models under quantization, pruning, and LoRA-based adaptation. Although re-extracted regions exhibit substantial parameter reorganization, ablating the original region after optimization eliminates or nearly eliminates coding performance in almost all conditions, while magnitude-matched controls preserve performance. Partition analysis further shows that the shared subset of the original and re-extracted regions accounts for most of the observed ablation effect in the majority of conditions. These results demonstrate that parameter overlap and functional persistence are distinct: capability regions can remain causally effective intervention targets even when their parameter realization changes substantially.
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的能力已与局部参数区域相关联，从而支持有针对性的模型编辑和干预。然而，尚不清楚在模型优化之前识别出的区域在优化之后是否仍是有效的干预目标。我们在量化、剪枝和基于 LoRA 的自适应下，评估三个指令微调模型中编码能力区域的功能持续性和参数重叠。尽管重新提取的区域表现出显著的参数重组，但在优化后消融原始区域在几乎所有条件下都会消除或几乎消除编码性能，而幅度匹配的对照则保持性能。分区分析进一步表明，在大多数条件下，原始区域和重新提取区域的共享子集解释了大部分观察到的消融效应。这些结果表明，参数重叠和功能持续性是不同的：即使能力区域的参数实现发生显著变化，它们仍可作为因果有效的干预目标。

items.title_en: Embodied-Harness: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: Embodied-Harness：迈向机器人操作的递归自我改进
items.abstract_en: Vision-language model (VLM)-based agents offer a promising approach to robotic manipulation, yet remain limited by inadequate memory organization, uncertain failure attribution, and limited reuse of execution experience. We propose Embodied-Harness, a dual-agent framework that improves manipulation by refining the execution harness without updating model parameters. The Actor interacts with the environment through a robot-control interface, while the Reflector converts execution evidence into reusable operational guidance. Hierarchical Memory Architecture maintains short-term execution context and long-term experiential knowledge to support execution and reflection. Evidence-based Experience Reflection grounds failure diagnosis in observed interactions, while Recursive Harness Self-Improvement refines operational guidance across successive attempts. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RoboSPA, and RMBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Embodied-Harness in generalization under environmental variations, spatial reasoning, long-horizon planning, and memory-dependent manipulation. Our method achieves success rates of 82.4%, 76.7%, and 94.4% on the three benchmarks, respectively. Real-world evaluation further yields an average success rate of 96.7% across three manipulation tasks. These results highlight the potential of Embodied-Harness to improve robotic manipulation through experience-driven harness self-improvement.
items.abstract_zh: 基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的智能体为机器人操作提供了一种有前景的方法，但仍受限于记忆组织不足、故障归因不确定以及执行经验复用有限。我们提出 Embodied-Harness，一个双智能体框架，通过改进执行 Harness 而不更新模型参数来提升操作能力。Actor 通过机器人控制接口与环境交互，而 Reflector 将执行证据转化为可复用的操作指导。分层记忆架构维护短期执行上下文和长期经验知识，以支持执行和反思。基于证据的经验反思将故障诊断建立在观察到的交互上，而递归 Harness 自我改进在连续尝试中细化操作指导。在 RoboTwin 2.0、RoboSPA 和 RMBench 上的实验证明了 Embodied-Harness 在环境变化下的泛化、空间推理、长时程规划和依赖记忆的操作中的有效性。我们的方法在三个基准上分别达到 82.4%、76.7% 和 94.4% 的成功率。真实世界评估进一步在三个操作任务上取得 96.7% 的平均成功率。这些结果凸显了 Embodied-Harness 通过经验驱动的 Harness 自我改进来提升机器人操作的潜力。

items.title_en: Ego2Ego: Generative Visual Perspective Taking Across Collaborators
items.title_zh: Ego2Ego：跨协作者的生成式视觉视角采择
items.abstract_en: Visual perspective taking, the ability to infer what another person sees from their position, is fundamental to human collaboration. However, prior works reduced perspective taking to state estimation, geometric reconstruction, or discrete question answering, whereas existing cross-view video generation methods either inferred the target view from the input video alone or required an external camera that observes the target person. We introduce generative visual perspective taking: Given an ego person's egocentric video, a scene point cloud, and a collaborator's camera trajectory, the task is to generate the continuous egocentric video from the collaborator's perspective. This task is challenging given extreme viewpoint shifts, dynamic occlusions, and sparse visual overlap. We address these challenges with Ego2Ego -- a set of backbone-agnostic geometric modules that provide a pretrained video diffusion model with the 3D scene geometry shared by both interactants. Ego2Ego renders dense, temporally consistent scene coordinate maps into every view as a shared spatial reference, aligns cross-view tokens in 3D ray space through relative geometric attention, and recovers regions outside the ego person's current view from the ego person's visual memory. Experiments on the CoMind dataset across three video diffusion backbones show that Ego2Ego consistently improves visual quality, Level-2 scene layout accuracy, and collaborator motion, outperforming state-of-the-art cross-view video generation baselines on every backbone. By generating the collaborator's egocentric video more accurately, Ego2Ego brings visual perspective taking to human-robot collaboration, where it can help infer what a human collaborator sees and does, and can turn single-person recordings into synchronised multi-perspective videos for robot learning.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉视角采择，即推断另一个人从其位置看到什么的能力，是人类协作的基础。然而，先前的工作将视角采择简化为状态估计、几何重建或离散问答，而现有的跨视角视频生成方法要么仅从输入视频推断目标视角，要么需要一台观察目标人物的外部相机。我们提出生成式视觉视角采择：给定一个自我中心人物的自我中心视频、一个场景点云以及一个协作者的相机轨迹，任务是从协作者的视角生成连续的自我中心视频。由于极端的视角偏移、动态遮挡和稀疏的视觉重叠，该任务具有挑战性。我们通过 Ego2Ego 应对这些挑战——Ego2Ego 是一组与骨干无关的几何模块，为预训练视频扩散模型提供两个交互者共享的 3D 场景几何。Ego2Ego 将稠密、时间一致的场景坐标图渲染到每个视角中作为共享空间参考，通过相对几何注意力在 3D 射线空间中与跨视角 token 对齐，并从自我中心人物的视觉记忆中恢复其当前视角之外的区域。在 CoMind 数据集上跨三个视频扩散骨干的实验表明，Ego2Ego 持续提升视觉质量、Level-2 场景布局准确性和协作者运动，并在每个骨干上优于最先进的跨视角视频生成基线。通过更准确地生成协作者的自我中心视频，Ego2Ego 将视觉视角采择带入人-机器人协作，在其中它可以帮助推断人类协作者看到什么和做什么，并可以将单人记录转换为用于机器人学习的同步多视角视频。

items.title_en: Cognitive Load modulates the exploration-exploitation trade-off Through Reconfiguration of an IPS-Centered Decision Network
items.title_zh: 认知负荷通过重构以 IPS 为中心的决策网络来调节探索-利用权衡
items.abstract_en: In dynamic environments where rewards continuously change, adaptive decision-making requires ongoing updates of option-value and uncertainty estimates to balance exploration and exploitation. This process depends on cognitive resources and involves coordinated interactions among multiple brain regions; however, how cognitive load affects directed exploration in such dynamic environments, and whether these effects are accompanied by changes in interactions among exploration-related brain regions, remains unclear. We embedded a working-memory load manipulation within a dynamic four-armed bandit task. Experiment 1 compared computational models and quantified load-related changes in exploration; Experiment 2 examined these behavioral effects in an independent sample and investigated their neural correlates using fMRI. Across both experiments, high load reduced the uncertainty bonus parameter ({varphi}), indicating weaker directed exploration. Experiment 2 additionally showed lower inverse temperature ({beta}) under high load, indicating more stochastic choices. Directed exploration relative to exploitation more activated the frontopolar cortex (FP), intraparietal sulcus (IPS), anterior insula (aIns), and dorsal anterior cingulate cortex (dACC). Psychophysiological interaction (PPI) analyses indicated stronger functional coupling between the right aIns and IPS under low load. Guided by the candidate connections identified by PPI, dynamic causal modeling (DCM) focused on a three-region subnetwork. Bayesian model selection favored the model with directed-exploration-related input to the IPS, while condition-specific comparisons suggested stronger aIns-to-IPS effective connectivity under low load. Together, these findings link cognitive resource demands to reduced uncertainty-guided directed exploration in a dynamic environment and suggest that this behavioral change is accompanied by selective reconfiguration of interactions within an IPS-centered decision subnetwork.
items.abstract_zh: 在奖励不断变化的动态环境中，自适应决策需要对选项价值和不确定性估计进行持续更新，以平衡探索与利用。这一过程依赖认知资源，并涉及多个脑区之间的协调交互；然而，认知负荷如何影响此类动态环境中的定向探索，以及这些影响是否伴随探索相关脑区之间交互的变化，仍不清楚。我们在动态四臂老虎机任务中嵌入了一个工作记忆负荷操纵。实验1比较了计算模型，并量化了与负荷相关的探索变化；实验2在一个独立样本中检验了这些行为效应，并使用 fMRI 研究了其神经关联。在两个实验中，高负荷降低了不确定性奖励参数（{varphi}），表明定向探索减弱。实验2还显示，高负荷下逆温度（{beta}）更低，表明选择更具随机性。相对于利用，定向探索更多地激活了额极皮层（FP）、顶内沟（IPS）、前岛叶（aIns）和背侧前扣带皮层（dACC）。心理生理交互（PPI）分析表明，在低负荷下右侧 aIns 与 IPS 之间的功能耦合更强。在 PPI 识别出的候选连接的指导下，动态因果建模（DCM）聚焦于一个三区域子网络。贝叶斯模型选择更支持带有与定向探索相关输入到 IPS 的模型，而条件特异性比较表明，在低负荷下 aIns 到 IPS 的有效连接更强。总之，这些发现将认知资源需求与动态环境中不确定性引导的定向探索减少联系起来，并表明这种行为变化伴随着以 IPS 为中心的决策子网络内交互的选择性重构。

items.title_en: Coherence Lengths of Laser Pointers
items.title_zh: 激光笔的相干长度
items.abstract_en: We report on the coherence lengths of low-cost green laser pointers in the midst of multimodal behavior using an optical interferometer based on noncollinear beam geometries and a CMOS detector array. Examined devices include three diode lasers and a frequency-doubled neodymium-emission diode-pumped solid state (DPSS) laser. Coherence length measurements are variable among devices, but values can nevertheless regularly exceed 10 cm. The work serves as a template for an advanced undergraduate physics laboratory experiment and may inspire new kinds of laser pointer devices utilizing interference effects as operative principles.
items.abstract_zh: 我们报告了低成本绿色激光笔在多模态行为中的相干长度，使用基于非共线光束几何和 CMOS 探测器阵列的光学干涉仪。所检查的器件包括三台二极管激光器和一台倍频钕发射二极管泵浦固态（DPSS）激光器。相干长度测量值在不同器件之间存在差异，但其数值仍可经常超过 10 cm。这项工作可作为高级本科物理实验室实验的模板，并可能启发利用干涉效应作为工作原理的新型激光笔器件。

items.title_en: Turnout: Adaptive Attention Switching for Efficient Reasoning
items.title_zh: Turnout：用于高效推理的自适应注意力切换
items.abstract_en: Post-hoc transformer linearization replaces the key-value cache of full attention, which grows linearly with generation length, with a fixed size state. This change reduces memory consumption but often hurts accuracy. In reasoning tasks, which require long generations, this effect is especially pronounced. In this work we introduce Turnout, a method that mitigates accuracy loss as a result of linearization, while maintaining its memory-reduction benefits. We apply post-hoc linearization to a pretrained full-attention model, training a linear path through distillation while leaving the original full-attention path unchanged. During response generation, the resulting hybrid model retains both paths and uses a learned policy to control when each layer switches from full to linear attention. We train the policy with reinforcement learning using a reward that balances answer correctness and memory use. Empirical evaluation of our method shows that the learned adaptive policy achieves a better accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier on reasoning tasks compared to fixed switching and static hybrid baselines.
items.abstract_zh: 事后 Transformer 线性化用固定大小的状态替换全注意力的键值缓存，而后者随生成长度线性增长。这一变化降低了内存消耗，但通常会损害准确率。在需要长生成的推理任务中，这种影响尤其明显。在本工作中，我们引入 Turnout，一种在保持线性化内存收益的同时缓解其导致的准确率损失的方法。我们对预训练的全注意力模型应用事后线性化，通过蒸馏训练一条线性路径，同时保持原始全注意力路径不变。在响应生成过程中，所得的混合模型保留两条路径，并使用学习到的策略控制每一层何时从全注意力切换到线性注意力。我们使用强化学习训练该策略，奖励平衡答案正确性和内存使用。对我们方法的实证评估表明，在推理任务上，学习到的自适应策略相比固定切换和静态混合基线，取得了更好的准确率-效率帕累托前沿。

items.title_en: Breaking the Long Horizon: Short-Horizon Process Supervision for Long-Form Generation in LLMs
items.title_zh: 打破长时程：面向 LLM 长文本生成的短时程过程监督
items.abstract_en: Long-form generation is increasingly important for agentic LLM systems, yet current reinforcement learning methods typically optimize an entire document with a single outcome-level reward. This delayed and coarse-grained supervision makes it difficult to localize errors and assign credit across semantically distinct parts of the output. To address this, we propose a short-horizon framework that reformulates long-form generation through semantic decomposition into segment-level decisions. Each segment is generated with prefix-conditioned context, allowing cross-segment coherence to be preserved while keeping supervision local. The generated segments are then scored with rubric-based rewards for adherence, coherence, and relevance, enabling explicit local supervision at the segment level. These local rewards are used to compute step-wise advantages, yielding localized policy updates. To isolate the effect of supervision granularity, we instantiate both outcome-level supervision and our short-horizon process reward method (SH-PRM) under the same GRPO framework. Across multiple LLMs and two long-form generation benchmarks, SH-PRM consistently outperforms outcome-level supervision and strong inference-time baselines under the same optimizer and comparable budgets. Further analyses suggest that these gains primarily arise from improved credit assignment. Overall, our results suggest that aligning supervision granularity with the semantic structure of long-form generation is an effective design principle for long-form LLM training.
items.abstract_zh: 长文本生成对智能体 LLM 系统日益重要，然而当前的强化学习方法通常使用单一的结果级奖励来优化整篇文档。这种延迟且粗粒度的监督使得难以定位错误并在输出中语义不同的部分之间分配信用。为解决这一问题，我们提出一个短时程框架，通过语义分解将长文本生成重构为片段级决策。每个片段在以前缀为条件的上下文中生成，从而在保持监督局部化的同时保留跨片段连贯性。然后，生成的片段使用基于评分标准的奖励进行评分，评分标准包括遵循性、连贯性和相关性，从而在片段级别实现显式的局部监督。这些局部奖励用于计算逐步优势，产生局部化的策略更新。为隔离监督粒度的影响，我们在相同的 GRPO 框架下实例化结果级监督和我们的短时程过程奖励方法（SH-PRM）。在多个 LLM 和两个长文本生成基准上，在相同优化器和可比预算下，SH-PRM 始终优于结果级监督和强推理时基线。进一步分析表明，这些收益主要源于改进的信用分配。总体而言，我们的结果表明，将监督粒度与长文本生成的语义结构对齐是长文本 LLM 训练的有效设计原则。

items.title_en: SOAR: Training-Free Rank-Consistent Rollout Compression for Latent World Model Planning
items.title_zh: SOAR：用于潜在世界模型规划的训练无关、排序一致的推演压缩
items.abstract_en: Latent world models plan by rolling out hundreds of candidate action sequences through a transformer predictor, so a single decision can take tens of seconds. Existing accelerations prune spatial tokens as in vision-language models, yet a sampling-based planner uses predicted costs only to rank candidates, so a rollout can be compressed freely as long as the ranking survives. We propose SOAR, a training-free method that adapts rollout compression to each planning decision. At every decision, SOAR probes a few candidates under several token budgets and keeps the smallest budget that preserves their ranking, so it compresses as far as the current decision allows, without task labels. A closed-loop study of more than 80,000 episodes fixes the rest of the rollout: the first step, which alone reads a real observation, stays exact, and the context frame is cached rather than recomputed. On seven navigation and manipulation tasks with frozen checkpoints, SOAR matches dense-level planning success at 2.3x speedup and retains 98% at 2.5x. Our code is available at https://github.com/starrywiki/SOAR.
items.abstract_zh: 潜在世界模型通过 transformer 预测器推演数百个候选动作序列来进行规划，因此单次决策可能需要数十秒。现有加速方法像在视觉-语言模型中那样剪枝空间 token，然而基于采样的规划器仅使用预测成本对候选进行排序，因此只要排序得以保留，推演就可以自由压缩。我们提出 SOAR，一种训练无关的方法，它将推演压缩适配到每个规划决策。在每个决策处，SOAR 在若干 token 预算下探测少量候选，并保留能保持其排序的最小预算，因此它在当前决策允许的范围内尽可能压缩，且无需任务标签。一项超过 80,000 个回合的闭环研究固定了推演的其余部分：第一步单独读取真实观测，保持精确，上下文帧被缓存而不是重新计算。在七个导航和操作任务上，使用冻结的检查点，SOAR 在 2.3 倍加速下匹配稠密级规划成功率，并在 2.5 倍加速下保持 98%。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/starrywiki/SOAR 获取。

items.title_en: EgoSurgHands: An Egocentric 3D Hand Pose Dataset & Benchmark for Open Surgery Training
items.title_zh: EgoSurgHands：用于开放手术训练的自我中心3D手部姿态数据集与基准
items.abstract_en: Surgical skill assessment, AR guidance, and robot learning from demonstration all benefit from 3D tracking of the surgeon's hands, yet no surgical dataset offers real egocentric articulated 3D hand pose. We introduce EgoSurgHands, a benchmark for real-captured egocentric hand pose estimation in open surgery training on synthetic pads. Captured with multi-sensor glasses, it contains 41,909 training hand-instance rows across 55 procedure recordings and 9,476 human-validated evaluation rows across 13 held-out recordings, spanning 13 tasks, 3 glove colors, and 4 trainees from first-year medical student to third-year resident. Each frame carries a multi-sensor stack: intrinsics, hand landmarks with per-hand confidence, timestamps, and eye gaze, plus SLAM extrinsics where SLAM succeeded. Evaluation labels combine sensor-fused pseudo-ground truth, human cross-review of every frame, surgeon adjudication of flagged cases, and an independent multi-view triangulated reference. Alongside the within-corpus, procedure-disjoint split, a leave-one-wearer-out protocol tested unseen trainees. Across eight methods evaluated zero-shot, from MANO-based reconstructors to the two-hand IntagHand and the keypoint-only MediaPipe Hands, egocentric pretraining was associated with stronger transfer on every held-out wearer. WildHands and JointTransformer had 18\% and 40\% lower PA-MPJPE, respectively, than the non-egocentric HaMeR. JointTransformer was the best performing model with an error of 14.95 mm. A substantial surgical domain gap remains, and the widely deployed MediaPipe Hands detected a hand in only 24.1\% of evaluation rows. As a baseline, a 58K-parameter residual corrector (JRN) on frozen backbones reached 10.96-14.85 mm PA-MPJPE on held-out wearers for the two ego-pretrained backbones. We release the dataset and benchmark code at https://egosurghands.github.io
items.abstract_zh: 手术技能评估、AR引导以及从演示中进行机器人学习，都受益于对术者手部的3D跟踪，但目前尚无手术数据集提供真实的自我中心关节式3D手部姿态。我们提出EgoSurgHands，一个用于在合成垫上进行开放手术训练中真实采集的自我中心手部姿态估计基准。该数据集使用多传感器眼镜采集，包含来自55段手术过程录像的41,909行训练用手部实例，以及来自13段留出录像、经人工验证的9,476行评估数据，涵盖13项任务、3种手套颜色和4名受训者（从一年级医学生到三年级住院医师）。每帧带有多传感器数据栈：内参、带每只手置信度的手部关键点、时间戳和眼动注视，并在SLAM成功的帧中提供SLAM外参。评估标签结合了传感器融合的伪真值、对每一帧的人工交叉复核、外科医生对标记病例的裁定，以及独立的多视角三角化参考。除语料内、按手术过程不重叠的划分外，还采用留一佩戴者协议测试未见过的受训者。在对八种方法进行零样本评估时，从基于MANO的重建器到双手的IntagHand和仅关键点的MediaPipe Hands，自我中心预训练在每一个留出佩戴者上都与更强的迁移相关。WildHands和JointTransformer的PA-MPJPE分别比非自我中心的HaMeR低18%和40%。JointTransformer是表现最好的模型，误差为14.95 mm。手术领域仍存在显著差距，广泛部署的MediaPipe Hands仅在24.1%的评估行中检测到手。作为基线，在冻结骨干上使用58K参数残差校正器（JRN），对于两个自我中心预训练骨干，在留出佩戴者上达到10.96–14.85 mm PA-MPJPE。我们在https://egosurghands.github.io发布数据集和基准代码。

items.title_en: Individualized Atypicality of Structure-Function Configuration Marks Subthreshold Depression in Adolescents
items.title_zh: 结构-功能配置的个体化非典型性标记青少年阈下抑郁
items.abstract_en: Background: Subthreshold depression (StD) in adolescence represents a critical state preceding major depressive disorder, yet its neurobiological substrates remain poorly characterized. Conventional structure-function coupling rely on DTI tractography, which produces non-isomorphic matrices and unstable single-subject estimates, limiting their clinical utility. We developed a novel isomorphic and multi-omics framework to quantify individualized structure-function configurations and tested whether adolescents with StD show reproducible deviations from a group-mean reference in a validation sample. Methods: We integrated five structural (cortical thickness, mean curvature, sulcal depth, fractional anisotropy, mean diffusivity) and five functional (ReHo, ALFF, CBF, local and global connectivity strength) features to construct regional SIND-FIND configurations using symmetric KL divergence in a discovery-validation design (N = 131). Individual typicality scores were defined as the correspondence between each participant's regional configuration profile and HC reference (Leave one out). The score has undergone parallel validations using conventional SC-FC coupling, molecular alignment (PET/AHBA), and behavioral correlations. Results: Group-mean configuration maps were spatially correlated across samples ({rho} = .93, pspin < .001). StD participants showed lower typicality than HC (F(1,94) = 8.73, p = .004); the conventional SC-FC comparison was not significant (F(1,92) = 3.31, p = .072). Regional differences involved frontoparietal and salience regions and aligned with PET (r = .55, pspin < .001) and AHBA (r = .47, pspin = .003) maps. After covariate adjustment, typicality correlated with SCL-90 ({rho} = -.262, q = .013), SDS ({rho} = -.234, q = .022), ISI ({rho} = -.296, q = .012) and PSQI ({rho} = -.288, q = .012; BH-FDR across five scales); coupling tracked depressive but not sleep symptoms (ISI {rho} = -.161, q = .124). Within validation StD participants, SCL-90 remained negatively associated with typicality ({rho} = -.42, p = .023). Conclusion: Our isomorphic, multimodal framework captures coordinated structures-function deviation in adolescent StD with greater group-effect sensitivity than conventional SC-FC coupling, together with regional specificity, molecular spatial alignment, and behavioral relevance. Configuration typicality, defined relative to an HC group-mean reference, may serve as an individual-level marker of organizational deviation during adolescence, pending larger, demographic stratified samples.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：青少年阈下抑郁（StD）是重性抑郁障碍之前的关键状态，但其神经生物学基础仍表征不足。传统结构-功能耦合依赖DTI纤维束追踪，会产生非同构矩阵和不稳定的单被试估计，限制其临床效用。我们开发了一种新的同构、多组学框架来量化个体化结构-功能配置，并在验证样本中检验StD青少年是否表现出相对于组均值参考的可重复偏差。方法：我们整合五个结构特征（皮质厚度、平均曲率、沟深、各向异性分数、平均扩散率）和五个功能特征（ReHo、ALFF、CBF、局部和全局连接强度），在发现-验证设计（N=131）中使用对称KL散度构建区域SIND-FIND配置。个体典型性得分定义为每名参与者的区域配置轮廓与健康对照（HC）参考之间的对应关系（留一法）。该得分已使用传统SC-FC耦合、分子空间对齐（PET/AHBA）和行为相关进行平行验证。结果：组均值配置图在样本间空间相关（ρ=.93，pspin<.001）。StD参与者的典型性低于HC（F(1,94)=8.73，p=.004）；传统SC-FC比较不显著（F(1,92)=3.31，p=.072）。区域差异涉及额顶和突显区域，并与PET（r=.55，pspin<.001）和AHBA（r=.47，pspin=.003）图谱对齐。协变量调整后，典型性与SCL-90（ρ=-.262，q=.013）、SDS（ρ=-.234，q=.022）、ISI（ρ=-.296，q=.012）和PSQI（ρ=-.288，q=.012；五个量表采用BH-FDR）相关；耦合跟踪抑郁症状而非睡眠症状（ISI ρ=-.161，q=.124）。在验证集StD参与者中，SCL-90仍与典型性负相关（ρ=-.42，p=.023）。结论：我们的同构多模态框架捕捉了青少年StD中协调的结构-功能偏差，比传统SC-FC耦合具有更高的组效应敏感性，并具有区域特异性、分子空间对齐和行为相关性。相对于HC组均值参考定义的配置典型性，可能作为青少年组织偏差的个体水平标志物，尚待更大规模、按人口学分层的样本验证。

items.title_en: Dephasing-free plasma acceleration with millijoule picosecond lasers
items.title_zh: 毫焦级皮秒激光实现无退相等离子体加速
items.abstract_en: Laser-plasma accelerators reach gradients a thousand times above radio-frequency cavities, but need joule-class femtosecond lasers firing about once per second, and electrons outrun the wave. A comb of laser lines spaced by the plasma frequency, each in its own mode of a matched channel, drives a wake moving at the speed of light. In particle-in-cell simulations a 175\,mJ, 0.5\,ps drive holds 21\,GV/m over 10\,mm with a 0.15\,rad phase drift; a test electron gains 208\,MeV, 2.6 times more than in one mode. Because the wave builds up resonantly, the required energy falls steeply with density: a 29\,mJ drive sustains 20\,GV/m, and a 10\,mJ drive, within reach of kilohertz industrial lasers, gives a test electron 170\,MeV over 30\,mm. A simulated stage transfers 5\,\% of the laser energy to the wake; the Manley--Rowe limit is about 18\,\% for five lines.
items.abstract_zh: 激光等离子体加速器可达到比射频腔高一千倍的梯度，但需要焦耳级飞秒激光器以约每秒一次的频率发射，而且电子会跑出波前。由等离子体频率间隔的激光频率梳，每条谱线处于匹配通道的各自模式中，驱动一个以光速移动的尾波。在粒子网格（PIC）模拟中，175 mJ、0.5 ps的驱动在10 mm上维持21 GV/m，相位漂移为0.15 rad；一个测试电子获得208 MeV，比单一模式中多2.6倍。由于波是共振建立的，所需能量随密度陡峭下降：29 mJ驱动可维持20 GV/m，而10 mJ驱动（千赫兹工业激光器可达到）使测试电子在30 mm上获得170 MeV。一个模拟加速级将5%的激光能量转移给尾波；五条谱线的Manley-Rowe极限约为18%。

items.title_en: Ruby: State-of-the-Art Potency Prediction across Discovery Regimes Using Learned Structural Representations
items.title_zh: Ruby：使用学习到的结构表示在发现阶段实现最先进的效力预测
items.abstract_en: Small-molecule drug discovery proceeds through repeated design-make-test-analyze cycles. The goal is often to maximize potency while keeping other properties within the ranges required for a viable therapeutic candidate. Compound prioritization places different demands on computational methods as drug discovery progresses from hit identification through hit-to-lead and lead optimization, with changing computational budgets and increasing amounts of on-target experimental data. We introduce Ruby, a Robust Universal Binding affinitY predictor that uses intermediate representations from the structural foundation model Pearl without requiring an explicit binding pose for every compound. Ruby is trained on proprietary data plus GenesisPotency-2026, an audited public-source potency training dataset released for academic and commercial use under a CC BY-SA 4.0 license with row-level provenance and audit annotations. Ruby achieves the highest aggregate early enrichment across seven public hit-identification targets among evaluated methods, with adjustable inference effort trading off enrichment and computational cost over more than two orders of magnitude. Ruby achieves the highest average correlations across four public benchmarks: OpenFE, CASP16, FEP+ 4, and OpenBind. Ruby significantly outperforms other methods in zero-shot prediction across eight biochemical and cellular assays from five ongoing Genesis-Incyte programs, widening its performance advantage relative to the public benchmarks. Ruby continues to improve more than other methods when all are given the opportunity to recalibrate using earlier assay measurements. Together, these contributions provide an annotated training resource for the field and a state-of-the-art potency predictor for broad screening, prioritization within related chemical series, and assay-specific prediction as experimental measurements accumulate.
items.abstract_zh: 小分子药物发现通过反复的设计-合成-测试-分析循环推进。目标通常是最大化效力，同时使其他性质保持在可行治疗候选物所需范围内。随着药物发现从命中发现推进到从命中到先导和先导优化，化合物优先级排序对计算方法提出不同要求，计算预算不断变化，靶点实验数据不断增加。我们提出Ruby，一种稳健通用结合亲和力预测器，它使用结构基础模型Pearl的中间表示，而不需要每个化合物都有明确的结合姿态。Ruby在专有数据加GenesisPotency-2026上训练；GenesisPotency-2026是一个经审计的公共来源效力训练数据集，以CC BY-SA 4.0许可发布用于学术和商业用途，并带有行级来源和审计注释。在评估方法中，Ruby在七个公共命中发现靶标上取得最高的总体早期富集，并可在超过两个数量级的范围内调节推理投入，以权衡富集和计算成本。Ruby在四个公共基准上取得最高平均相关性：OpenFE、CASP16、FEP+ 4和OpenBind。在来自五个正在进行的Genesis-Incyte项目的八个生化和细胞实验中，Ruby在零样本预测上显著优于其他方法，相对公共基准扩大了性能优势。当所有方法都有机会使用更早的实验测量重新校准时，Ruby继续比其他方法提升更多。总之，这些贡献为该领域提供了带注释的训练资源，以及一个最先进的效力预测器，用于广泛筛选、相关化学系列内的优先级排序，以及随着实验测量积累而进行的实验特异性预测。

items.title_en: Your Judge Inherits Your Prompt: In-Context Label Bias in an LLM-as-Judge Is Directional, Not Symmetric
items.title_zh: 你的评判器继承你的提示：LLM作为评判器中的上下文标签偏差是方向性的，而非对称的
items.abstract_en: LLM-as-judge has become a standard way to score open-ended model outputs, yet the judge is itself a frozen language model steered by a few in-context examples, and such models are known to absorb the label balance of their demonstrations rather than treat them as neutral illustrations. We ask whether this label bias reaches an LLM judge used inside a multimodal (video question answering) evaluation pipeline, and what form it takes. Using a fully frozen generator-judge pipeline, we hold the generated answers fixed and vary only the Yes/No balance of the judge's few-shot examples across four demonstration sets. Each verdict is validated against a two-annotator human consensus on 200 examples per dataset. The judge's acceptance rate stays close to human consensus when its examples are balanced or skewed toward rejection, but jumps sharply (by about 30 points on NExT-QA and 20 on MSVD-QA, with a strongly one-sided error profile) when the examples are skewed toward acceptance; the opposite skew produces no matching drop. The bias is therefore one-directional within the tested range of label ratios. A separate five-draw analysis shows that results from a single example draw are unreliable, varying by up to 18 points, more than any difference between prompting conditions. We conclude that demonstration label bias in an LLM judge is a directional, inflation-only failure mode that can fabricate apparent benchmark gains but not losses, and that it is cheaply avoided by balancing the judge's examples and reporting results averaged over several draws.
items.abstract_zh: LLM作为评判器已成为对开放式模型输出打分的一种标准方式，但评判器本身是一个由少量上下文示例引导的冻结语言模型，而这类模型已知会吸收其演示中的标签平衡，而不是把它们当作中性的示例说明。我们追问这种标签偏差是否会影响到多模态（视频问答）评估流程中使用的LLM评判器，以及它表现为何种形式。使用完全冻结的生成器-评判器流程，我们保持生成答案固定，仅改变评判器少样本示例的Yes/No平衡，覆盖四组演示集。每个判定都对照每个数据集200个示例上的两名标注者人工共识进行验证。当评判器的示例平衡或偏向拒绝时，其接受率接近人工共识；但当示例偏向接受时，接受率急剧上升（在NExT-QA上约30个百分点，在MSVD-QA上约20个百分点，且误差分布强烈偏向一侧）；相反的偏斜没有产生匹配的下降。因此，在测试的标签比例范围内，该偏差是单向的。另一项五次抽取分析显示，单次示例抽取的结果不可靠，变化可达18个百分点，超过任何提示条件之间的差异。我们得出结论：LLM评判器中的演示标签偏差是一种方向性的、仅导致膨胀的失败模式，可以制造出表面上的基准提升，但不会制造损失；通过平衡评判器示例并报告多次抽取的平均结果，可以低成本地避免它。

items.title_en: RoboCap-10k: A Metrically Accurate Egocentric Dataset for Robot Learning
items.title_zh: RoboCap-10k：用于机器人学习的度量准确自我中心数据集
items.abstract_en: Egocentric video is the most scalable source of manipulation data for robot learning, but its difficulty lies in producing high-quality supervision. Existing large corpora lack metric 3D labels or rely on heterogeneous devices, motion-capture labs, or a headset's built-in real-time tracker, whose accuracy is not reported for the released data. We introduce RoboCap-10k: 10,000 curated hours of unscripted manipulation recorded during workers' paid shifts in 11 countries, spanning 18 task families, 200 task types, and 2,000 tasks. Every hour is captured on one device, the RoboCap, a 250 g hat with six synchronized global-shutter cameras and dual IMUs. Online calibration brings every device below 1 px of epipolar error, visual-inertial SLAM yields gravity-aligned 6-DoF head trajectories, and a multi-view hand tracker yields metric cm-precise hand poses. Each episode is annotated with task and sub-task language captions. Project page: https://robocap10k.com
items.abstract_zh: 自我中心视频是机器人学习中最可扩展的操作数据来源，但其困难在于产生高质量监督。现有大型语料库缺乏度量3D标签，或依赖异构设备、动作捕捉实验室，或头显内置实时追踪器，而这些追踪器在发布数据上的精度未被报告。我们提出RoboCap-10k：10,000个精选小时的无脚本操作数据，记录于11个国家工人的带薪班次期间，涵盖18个任务族、200种任务类型和2,000项任务。每个小时都由同一设备RoboCap采集，这是一顶250 g的帽子，配有六个同步全局快门相机和双IMU。在线校准使每台设备的对极误差低于1 px，视觉-惯性SLAM给出重力对齐的6自由度头部轨迹，多视角手部追踪器给出度量级厘米精度的手部姿态。每个片段都标注了任务和子任务的语言描述。项目页面：https://robocap10k.com

items.title_en: 3D Open-Vocabulary Detection via Visual Alignment and Generative Captions
items.title_zh: 通过视觉对齐与生成式描述进行3D开放词汇检测
items.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D object detection remains a significant challenge for outdoor scenes, with existing methods often struggling to effectively transfer the rich semantic knowledge from powerful 2D Vision-Language Models (VLMs) into a 3D context. We propose a novel, two-part framework for this task. First, we introduce a direct, object-level distillation method. We generate class-agnostic 3D proposals to source regions from the entire scene, without relying on any manual labels. We leverage a spatially-aware VLM to extract a semantic embedding from each proposal's projected 2D bounding box and supervise our 3D model to predict this embedding on a per-instance basis. Second, to enhance zero-shot capability and inject domain-specific information, we employ a powerful Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) as an image captioner to generate rich textual captions for each of these proposals. These captions are integrated into the training objective to directly align the 3D features with these rich semantics, creating a composite loss that combines direct feature distillation with caption-based semantic enrichment. Our experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach, establishing a new state of the art in 3D open-vocabulary detection on the Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes.
items.abstract_zh: 开放词汇3D目标检测仍是户外场景中的一项重大挑战，现有方法往往难以将强大的2D视觉-语言模型（VLM）中丰富的语义知识有效迁移到3D语境中。我们为此任务提出一种新颖的两部分框架。首先，我们引入一种直接的对象级蒸馏方法。我们生成类别无关的3D提议，以从整个场景中获取区域，而不依赖任何人工标签。我们利用具有空间感知能力的VLM，从每个提议投影后的2D边界框中提取语义嵌入，并监督我们的3D模型以逐实例方式预测该嵌入。其次，为增强零样本能力并注入领域特定信息，我们采用强大的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）作为图像描述器，为每个提议生成丰富的文本描述。这些描述被整合到训练目标中，以使3D特征与这些丰富语义直接对齐，形成一种将直接特征蒸馏与基于描述的语义增强相结合的组合损失。我们的实验验证了该方法的有效性，在Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes上确立了3D开放词汇检测的新最先进水平。

items.title_en: Novel selective CDK4 inhibitor ALK-13743: Functional determinants of response in ER+ breast cancer models
items.title_zh: 新型选择性CDK4抑制剂ALK-13743：ER+乳腺癌模型中反应的功能决定因素
items.abstract_en: Cyclin-dependent kinase 4 (CDK4) and CDK6 are central drivers of cell cycle progression in estrogen receptor-positive (ER+) breast cancer, and pharmacological inhibition of this pair has become a standard-of-care therapeutic strategy. However, currently approved CDK4/6 inhibitors palbociclib, ribociclib, and abemaciclib carry associated toxicities, including myelosuppression and other adverse effects which are associated with inhibition of CDK6 that limits tolerability and combinatorial strategies. Here we describe the preclinical characterization of ALK-13743, a novel, highly selective CDK4 inhibitor. ALK-13743 potently inhibited CDK4/Cyclin D1 with an IC50 of 33 nM and displayed selectivity over CDK6/Cyclin D3 (IC50, 99 nM), CDK2/Cyclin E1 (IC50, 1854 nM), and CDK1/Cyclin B1 (IC50, >10000 nM) in biochemical kinase assays. In cellular models, ALK-13743 demonstrated potent antiproliferative activity in CDK4-dependent ER+ breast cancer cells at nanomolar concentrations, while exhibiting limited inhibition in CDK6-dependent cell lines. ALK-13743 exhibited single-agent growth suppression and drug synergy with the selective estrogen receptor degrader giredestrant and PI3K pathway inhibitors but was entirely RB-dependent and blunted by CDK6 overexpression. Single-agent ALK-13743 treatment led to tumor regression in T47D xenografts in vivo. ALK-13743 is a potent, CDK4-selective inhibitor dependent upon RB for its antiproliferative profile in ER+ breast cancer models. Its favorable combinability with multiple clinically relevant targeted agents supports further development, particularly in combination regimens, and positions it as a differentiated CDK4-selective therapy for ER+ breast cancer.
items.abstract_zh: 细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶4（CDK4）和CDK6是雌激素受体阳性（ER+）乳腺癌中细胞周期进程的核心驱动因素，对这一对的药理学抑制已成为标准治疗策略。然而，目前获批的CDK4/6抑制剂palbociclib、ribociclib和abemaciclib伴随相关毒性，包括骨髓抑制以及与CDK6抑制相关的其他不良反应，这限制了耐受性和联合策略。在此，我们描述ALK-13743的临床前表征，这是一种新型、高度选择性的CDK4抑制剂。在生化激酶实验中，ALK-13743强效抑制CDK4/Cyclin D1，IC50为33 nM，并相对于CDK6/Cyclin D3（IC50，99 nM）、CDK2/Cyclin E1（IC50，1854 nM）和CDK1/Cyclin B1（IC50，>10000 nM）表现出选择性。在细胞模型中，ALK-13743在纳摩尔浓度下对CDK4依赖性ER+乳腺癌细胞表现出强效抗增殖活性，而在CDK6依赖性细胞系中表现出有限抑制。ALK-13743表现出单药生长抑制，并与选择性雌激素受体降解剂giredestrant和PI3K通路抑制剂产生药物协同作用，但其作用完全依赖RB，并被CDK6过表达削弱。单药ALK-13743治疗在体内导致T47D异种移植瘤消退。ALK-13743是一种强效、CDK4选择性抑制剂，其在ER+乳腺癌模型中的抗增殖特征依赖于RB。其与多种临床相关靶向药物良好的可联用性支持进一步开发，尤其是在联合方案中，并使其成为ER+乳腺癌的一种差异化CDK4选择性疗法。

items.title_en: Material optimization of optical properties of particulate products by transition matrix method and sequential global programming
items.title_zh: 基于转移矩阵法和序贯全局规划的颗粒产品光学性质材料优化
items.abstract_en: Material optimization of nanoparticle assemblies, such as structurally coloured photonic crystals, attracts increasing interest. We combine the transition matrix method (TMM), which avoids spatial discretization of particles and surrounding medium, with sequential global programming (SGP) to optimize optical properties of particulate products by iteratively assigning predefined catalogue materials to individual particles. We derive exact separable models, reproducing the fully coupled objective under single-particle material changes, and computationally accessible first-order correct approximations for general continuously differentiable objectives. These approximations aim to capture the nonlinear, potentially nonconvex dependence on individual material variables beyond their local first-order behaviour. Within SGP, globally minimizing the particle-wise subproblems can yield substantial improvements in few outer iterations, including steps away from unfavourable stationary points, as previously demonstrated for discrete dipole approximation-based SGP. The construction exploits the decomposition of the TMM system matrix into a material-dependent block-diagonal and a material-independent coupling matrix, while the state and adjoint problems remain fully coupled. Applications include extinction, scattering quantities, and colour objectives. In a 35-particle extinction minimization problem, the objective decreases by 31.0% in 13 iterations. A fine-grid evaluation of the fully coupled objective shows that no tested single-particle material change improves the final design. For a 627-particle photonic crystal, chroma increases by 58.4-122.1% for different particle diameters in 17-42 iterations. The optimized designs favour absorbing material in layers away from the incident light, consistent with experimental findings.
items.abstract_zh: 纳米颗粒组装体（例如结构色光子晶体）的材料优化正吸引越来越多关注。我们将转移矩阵法（TMM）与序贯全局规划（SGP）相结合，前者避免对颗粒及周围介质进行空间离散化，后者通过迭代地为单个颗粒分配预定义目录材料来优化颗粒产品的光学性质。我们推导了精确的可分离模型，可重现单颗粒材料变化下的完全耦合目标，并为一般连续可微目标推导了计算上可处理的一阶正确近似。这些近似旨在捕捉对单个材料变量的非线性、可能非凸的依赖关系，而不仅限于其局部一阶行为。在SGP中，全局最小化逐颗粒子问题可在少量外迭代中带来显著改进，包括远离不利驻点的步骤，正如先前针对基于离散偶极近似的SGP所证明的那样。该构造利用TMM系统矩阵分解为材料相关的块对角矩阵和材料无关的耦合矩阵，同时状态问题和伴随问题仍保持完全耦合。应用包括消光、散射量和颜色目标。在一个35颗粒消光最小化问题中，目标在13次迭代内下降31.0%。对完全耦合目标的细网格评估表明，所测试的任何单颗粒材料变化均未改善最终设计。对于627颗粒光子晶体，不同颗粒直径下彩度在17–42次迭代内提高58.4–122.1%。优化设计倾向于在远离入射光的层中使用吸收材料，这与实验发现一致。

items.title_en: DNN-Assisted Deterministic Policy Learning for Adaptive IRS-NOMA-OWC Networks
items.title_zh: 面向自适应IRS-NOMA-OWC网络的DNN辅助确定性策略学习
items.abstract_en: Intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) has been considered a promising technology in optical wireless communication (OWC) networks due to its potential to overcome the line-of-sight (LoS) blockage issue and enhance coverage. In this paper, a dynamic IRS-assisted indoor non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA)-OWC network is modeled, and an optimization problem is formulated to maximize the sum rate subject to the quality-of-service (QoS) requirements of multiple mobile users, by jointly optimizing the power allocation and the IRS mirror orientations, from which the user's decoding order is induced rather than being fixed. Since the problem is non-convex and the channel conditions vary with user mobility, conventional optimization methods may incur considerable computational overhead. Therefore, a two-stage deep neural network-deep reinforcement learning (DNN-DRL) framework is proposed. In the first stage, the DNN estimates the user's positions and orientations in real time, removing the need for perfect knowledge of the user state. In the second stage, a deterministic policy gradient (DPG)-based DRL algorithm uses these estimates to jointly optimize the power allocation and IRS mirror orientations, with the decoding order updated according to the resulting effective channel gains. The results show that the proposed framework approaches the performance upper bounds and outperforms standard DRL algorithms, conventional optimization methods, and deployments without IRS in terms of sum rate and fairness, while achieving faster convergence. Furthermore, online adaptation of the decoding order maintains higher QoS satisfaction than a fixed decoding order, particularly under high user mobility.
items.abstract_zh: 智能反射面（IRS）因其克服视距（LoS）阻塞问题并增强覆盖的潜力，被视为光无线通信（OWC）网络中的有前景技术。本文对动态IRS辅助的室内非正交多址接入（NOMA）-OWC网络进行建模，并构建优化问题：在多个移动用户的服务质量（QoS）要求约束下，通过联合优化功率分配和IRS镜面朝向最大化总速率，用户解码顺序由该优化导出而非固定。由于该问题非凸且信道条件随用户移动而变化，传统优化方法可能带来相当大的计算开销。因此，提出一种两阶段深度神经网络-深度强化学习（DNN-DRL）框架。第一阶段，DNN实时估计用户的位置和朝向，从而无需对用户状态具有完美知识。第二阶段，基于确定性策略梯度（DPG）的DRL算法利用这些估计联合优化功率分配和IRS镜面朝向，并根据所得有效信道增益更新解码顺序。结果表明，所提框架接近性能上界，并在总速率和公平性方面优于标准DRL算法、传统优化方法以及无IRS部署，同时实现更快的收敛。此外，解码顺序的在线自适应比固定解码顺序保持更高的QoS满意度，尤其在高用户移动性下。

items.title_en: How Long Will My Language Model Run? A Benchmark for Pre-Execution Runtime Prediction
items.title_zh: 我的语言模型将运行多久？面向执行前运行时预测的基准
items.abstract_en: Researchers submitting deep learning jobs to shared GPU clusters need runtime estimates to request time limits, choose hardware, and budget compute. Large language models (LLMs) offer a tempting shortcut: describe the job and ask. We introduce PreRun, a benchmark for predicting deep learning training and inference runtime from information available before execution. PreRun contains 801 training and 1,884 inference records of language and vision models collected on a GPU cluster, paired with workload configurations and explicitly defined timing targets. It also includes 64 text-generation configurations measured under standardized conditions, each in three separate program launches. We compare three LLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, GPT-OSS-120B, and Claude Opus 5.5) with regression baselines and evaluate analytical estimates on a supported forward-pass subset. On 16 held-out generation configurations, the open-weight LLMs underestimate latency by 90-99% on average without examples. Claude's zero-shot mean absolute error is 4.5 times that of a Random Forest fit on 32 configurations. Five labeled examples substantially reduce Claude's generation error, but their benefit varies across timing targets. We will open-source our data and evaluation pipeline upon acceptance.
items.abstract_zh: 向共享GPU集群提交深度学习作业的研究人员需要运行时间估计，以申请时间限制、选择硬件并规划计算预算。大语言模型（LLM）提供了一条诱人的捷径：描述作业并询问。我们提出PreRun，一个根据执行前可获得信息预测深度学习训练和推理运行时间的基准。PreRun包含在GPU集群上收集的801条训练记录和1,884条推理记录，涉及语言模型和视觉模型，并配以工作负载配置和明确定义的计时目标。它还包括在标准化条件下测量的64种文本生成配置，每种配置在三次独立的程序启动中测量。我们将三种LLM（Qwen3.5-9B、GPT-OSS-120B和Claude Opus 5.5）与回归基线进行比较，并在受支持的前向传播子集上评估解析估计。在16种留出生成配置上，开放权重LLM在无示例情况下平均低估延迟90–99%。Claude的零样本平均绝对误差是在32种配置上拟合的随机森林的4.5倍。五个带标签示例显著降低Claude的生成误差，但其收益因计时目标而异。论文被接收后，我们将开源数据和评估流程。

items.title_en: From Sequence to Space: Explicit Spatial Belief with Vision-Language Distillation for Active Geo-Localization
items.title_zh: 从序列到空间：面向主动地理定位的显式空间信念与视觉-语言蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Active geo-localization (AGL) asks an agent to navigate a small aerial search grid and reach a target specified by an aerial image, a ground-level photograph, or text. Existing methods align the goal modalities well, but they keep the navigation state inside a large sequential Transformer and train with a dense distance reward that uses the hidden goal location. This paper proposes EAGLE, an Explicit spatial-belief Agent for Geo-Localization and Exploration. Offline training jointly optimizes a teacher-conditioned Swin branch and a context-free Swin student from the same randomly masked partial mosaics. The teacher branch attends to frozen full-scene context extracted by Qwen2.5-VL-7B, both branches receive masked-cell aerial-feature reconstruction and uncertainty supervision, while the student additionally distills stop-gradient feature predictions from the teacher. After distillation, Qwen, its cached context, and the teacher-attention branch are discarded. The retained student predicts cell-level aerial-feature embeddings and predictive uncertainty from partial observations alone. These predictions are combined with the modality-aligned goal embedding and a trajectory-derived visitation mask to construct the spatial belief tensor. The student is then frozen while a compact CNN actor-critic is optimized with PPO. EAGLE achieves state-of-the-art average success rates of 78.1%, 76.4%, and 76.8% on MASA, xBD zero-shot transfer, and the MM-GAG zero-shot aerial-goal split, respectively, without using a VLM or cached visual tokens at inference. Code will be made publicly available.
items.abstract_zh: 主动地理定位（AGL）要求智能体在小型空中搜索网格中导航，并到达由航拍图像、地面照片或文本指定的目标。现有方法能很好地对齐目标模态，但它们将导航状态保留在大型序列Transformer内部，并使用利用隐藏目标位置的稠密距离奖励进行训练。本文提出EAGLE，一种用于地理定位与探索的显式空间信念智能体。离线训练从相同的随机掩码部分镶嵌图联合优化一个教师条件Swin分支和一个无上下文Swin学生模型。教师分支关注由Qwen2.5-VL-7B提取的冻结全场景上下文；两个分支均接受掩码单元航拍特征重建和不确定性监督，而学生模型还额外蒸馏来自教师的停止梯度特征预测。蒸馏后，Qwen、其缓存上下文以及教师注意力分支被丢弃。保留下来的学生模型仅根据部分观测预测单元级航拍特征嵌入和预测不确定性。这些预测与模态对齐的目标嵌入以及由轨迹导出的访问掩码相结合，以构建空间信念张量。随后冻结学生模型，同时使用PPO优化一个紧凑的CNN actor-critic。EAGLE在MASA、xBD零样本迁移和MM-GAG零样本航拍目标划分上分别取得78.1%、76.4%和76.8%的最先进平均成功率，且在推理时不使用VLM或缓存视觉token。代码将公开提供。

items.title_en: SCATR-ITS: a scalable transformer for large-area individual tree segmentation from LiDAR point clouds
items.title_zh: SCATR-ITS：一种用于从LiDAR点云进行大面积单木分割的可扩展Transformer
items.abstract_en: Individual tree segmentation (ITS) from LiDAR point clouds is one of the most widely studied segmentation tasks in forestry. Although deep learning methods define the state of the art on the majority of ITS benchmarks, their high computational complexity and long runtime currently prevent their adoption in large-scale operational workflows. In this work, we present SCATR-ITS, a scalable transformer model specifically designed for efficient ITS over large geographical areas. Based on the ForestFormer3D framework, SCATR-ITS transitions to superpoint-level processing to accelerate inference, with the superpoints constructed from learned embeddings. The architecture incorporates size-aware superpoint-level postprocessing, a dynamic query count module to handle high variation in forest structure, and a maximal input stride designed to minimize prediction redundancy. SCATR-ITS achieves accuracy on par with the state of the art on the FGI-EMIT and FOR-InstanceV2 datasets with an up to 8.5$\times$ higher inference speed. In addition, SCATR-ITS has a significantly lower GPU VRAM footprint during both training and inference, and exhibits excellent zero-shot generalization across multiple datasets. To demonstrate large-area ITS capabilities, SCATR-ITS is applied to a 142 km$^2$ region of Finnish national laser scanning data where it achieves an average throughput of 13.8 min/km$^2$, $\sim$18.6$\times$ faster than ForestFormer3D and approaching the speed of the unsupervised watershed algorithm, which it vastly outperforms in accuracy and segment quality. Overall, SCATR-ITS delivers state-of-the-art accuracy at speeds where operational-scale adoption becomes viable, paving the way toward countrywide deployment. The source code for SCATR-ITS and pretrained weights are available at https://github.com/ruoppa/scatr_its.
items.abstract_zh: 从LiDAR点云进行单木分割（ITS）是林业中最广泛研究的分割任务之一。尽管深度学习方法在大多数ITS基准上代表了最先进水平，但其高计算复杂度和长运行时间目前阻碍其在大规模实际工作流中的应用。在本工作中，我们提出SCATR-ITS，一种专为在大地理区域内高效进行ITS而设计的可扩展Transformer模型。基于ForestFormer3D框架，SCATR-ITS转向超点级处理以加速推理，超点由学习到的嵌入构建。该架构结合了尺寸感知的超点级后处理、用于处理森林结构高度变化的动态查询数量模块，以及旨在最小化预测冗余的最大输入步幅。SCATR-ITS在FGI-EMIT和FOR-InstanceV2数据集上达到与最先进方法相当的精度，推理速度最高提升8.5倍。此外，SCATR-ITS在训练和推理期间的GPU显存占用显著更低，并在多个数据集上表现出优异的零样本泛化能力。为展示大面积ITS能力，SCATR-ITS被应用于芬兰国家激光扫描数据中142 km²的区域，平均吞吐量为13.8 min/km²，比ForestFormer3D快约18.6倍，接近无监督分水岭算法的速度，并在精度和分割质量上大幅优于后者。总体而言，SCATR-ITS在使实际规模采用变得可行的速度下提供了最先进的精度，为全国范围部署铺平道路。SCATR-ITS的源代码和预训练权重见https://github.com/ruoppa/scatr_its。

items.title_en: Exercise misinformation in fitness content targeted at women on Instagram and TikTok: a cross-sectional content analysis of 6,982 posts
items.title_zh: Instagram和TikTok上针对女性的健身内容中的运动错误信息：对6,982条帖子的横断面内容分析
items.abstract_en: Objectives. To quantify exercise misinformation in female targeted exercise content on Instagram and TikTok, determine whether content textually targeted at women carries higher rates of misinformation, and compare content from creators self identifying as ethnic minority with other content. Methods. Cross sectional content analysis of 6,982 posts collected March to June 2026 by manual browsing, which captured on screen and caption text, and automated collection, which captured captions only. Text was coded for claim accuracy, textual female targeting and creator characteristics, with large language model assisted coding verified against an independent human coder. Effects were estimated by logistic regression using adjustment sets from a pre specified causal diagram, with creator clustered standard errors. Results. Of 6,524 posts, 2,447 made an assessable exercise claim, of which 600 (24.5%, 95% CI 22.8 to 26.2) contained misinformation. Textually female targeted content carried more than twice the odds of misinformation compared with untargeted content (OR 2.06, 95% CI 1.58 to 2.70), particularly wholly inaccurate content. The effect was OR 4.00 (2.41 to 6.66) where on screen text was captured and 1.04 (0.73 to 1.49) where only captions were (interaction p < 0.001). Content from creators self identifying as ethnic minority carried less misinformation (OR 0.69, 95% CI 0.51 to 0.92). Conclusion. 24.5% of fitness posts making a verifiable claim contained misinformation, and content directed at women had higher rates where the full written text could be read. Posts naming a body part were most likely to be inaccurate, giving clinicians and public health communicators a teachable marker of misinformation.
items.abstract_zh: 目的。量化Instagram和TikTok上针对女性的运动内容中的运动错误信息，确定文本上针对女性的内容是否带有更高比例的错误信息，并比较自认少数族裔创作者的内容与其他内容。方法。对2026年3月至6月收集的6,982条帖子进行横断面内容分析，收集方式包括人工浏览（捕获屏幕文字和配文）以及自动化收集（仅捕获配文）。对文本按声明准确性、文本上是否针对女性以及创作者特征进行编码，其中大语言模型辅助编码并对照独立人工编码者进行验证。使用来自预设因果图的调整集，通过逻辑回归估计效应，并采用创作者聚类标准误。结果。在6,524条帖子中，2,447条提出了可评估的运动声明，其中600条（24.5%，95% CI 22.8–26.2）含有错误信息。文本上针对女性的内容含错误信息的优势比是未针对性内容的两倍以上（OR 2.06，95% CI 1.58–2.70），尤其是完全不准的内容。在捕获屏幕文字时，该效应为OR 4.00（2.41–6.66）；在仅捕获配文时为OR 1.04（0.73–1.49）（交互作用p < 0.001）。自认少数族裔创作者的内容含较少错误信息（OR 0.69，95% CI 0.51–0.92）。结论。提出可验证声明的健身帖子中有24.5%含错误信息；在可读取完整书面文本时，针对女性的内容错误率更高。提及身体部位的帖子最可能不准确，为临床医生和公共卫生传播者提供了一个可用于教学的错误信息标志。

items.title_en: MatVerse: A Foundation Model for Materials Science
items.title_zh: MatVerse：材料科学基础模型
items.abstract_en: Materials science involves highly heterogeneous scientific information, including textual knowledge, molecular and crystal structures, experimental characterization data, microscopy images, and structure-property relationships. Developing a general-purpose foundation model capable of understanding and reasoning over these diverse materials representations remains challenging. In this technical report, we introduce MatVerse, a materials foundation model built upon Intern-S2-Preview and further specialized through large-scale materials-domain post-training. We construct a large-scale multimodal training corpus covering materials knowledge, scientific reasoning, quantitative problem solving, structural understanding, and multimodal scientific interpretation. To improve domain adaptation, we develop a unified data construction pipeline combining teacher-guided reasoning distillation, scientific problem synthesis, consistency-based filtering, and retrieval-based multimodal data construction. We evaluate MatVerse on three representative materials-science benchmarks: our human-calibrated OmniMatBench, MatSciBench, and MaCBench. Results demonstrate consistent improvements after materials-specific post-training over the base model on all three benchmarks, alongside improved inference efficiency on calculation-intensive problems. These results show that targeted domain-specific post-training can effectively enhance scientific reasoning, materials knowledge understanding, and multimodal scientific capabilities of foundation models. MatVerse provides a unified language-and-vision interface for materials science and serves as a foundation for future AI-assisted materials research workflows.
items.abstract_zh: 材料科学涉及高度异构的科学信息，包括文本知识、分子和晶体结构、实验表征数据、显微图像以及结构-性能关系。开发能够理解和推理这些多样材料表示的通用基础模型仍然具有挑战性。在本技术报告中，我们介绍MatVerse，一个基于Intern-S2-Preview构建并经过大规模材料领域后训练进一步专门化的材料基础模型。我们构建了一个大规模多模态训练语料库，涵盖材料知识、科学推理、定量问题求解、结构理解以及多模态科学解释。为改善领域适应，我们开发了一个统一的数据构建流水线，结合教师引导的推理蒸馏、科学问题合成、基于一致性的过滤以及基于检索的多模态数据构建。我们在三个代表性材料科学基准上评估MatVerse：我们经人工校准的OmniMatBench、MatSciBench和MaCBench。结果表明，在全部三个基准上，材料特定后训练相较基础模型带来一致提升，同时提高了计算密集型问题的推理效率。这些结果表明，有针对性的领域特定后训练能够有效增强基础模型的科学推理、材料知识理解和多模态科学能力。MatVerse为材料科学提供了统一的语言与视觉接口，并为未来AI辅助材料研究工作流奠定基础。

items.title_en: Efficient and Variation-Tolerant Tree Inference via Compact and Scalable Mapping in Analog CAMs
items.title_zh: 通过模拟CAM中的紧凑且可扩展映射实现高效且耐变化的树推理
items.abstract_en: Tree-based machine learning methods are widely adopted for their interpretability and state-of-the-art accuracy on tabular data. These methods face efficiency challenges on conventional architectures due to irregular memory access patterns during tree traversal. Prior work uses analog CAM to accelerate tree traversal, but inefficient mapping requires exponentially more analog CAM columns as tree depth increases. Accuracy is also degraded by device non-idealities such as programming variations and soft decision boundaries. To address these challenges, we propose ACTIVAR, a compact variation-tolerant tree implementation in a dense analog CAM array via software-hardware codesign. On the software side, we introduce an analog-CAM-aware compact tree model that employs hierarchical subtrees with shared features to maximize hardware utilization. This dense mapping introduces redundancy, improving both model accuracy and hardware defect tolerance. Additionally, we develop Variation-Enhanced Training, which utilizes a fuzzy overlap boundary strategy to build models resilient to analog noise. On the hardware side, we design a FeFET-based analog CAM cell with a driver to sharpen decision thresholds and implement a pipelined multi-core architecture to optimize throughput and energy consumption. Across 13 classification and regression datasets, ACTIVAR maintains near-software-level accuracy while reducing hardware overhead by up to 99% compared with prior analog-CAM-based soft-tree designs. Under realistic hardware noise conditions, ACTIVAR limits accuracy degradation to just 3.7% on the MNIST dataset, whereas baseline models suffer a catastrophic 49.6% drop. Furthermore, the ACTIVAR architecture achieves energy efficiency gains ranging from $10^4$ to $10^6$ times over commercial general-purpose processors, establishing it as a highly efficient solution for high-capacity machine learning at the edge.
items.abstract_zh: 基于树的机器学习方法因其可解释性和在表格数据上的最先进精度而被广泛采用。由于树遍历期间的不规则内存访问模式，这些方法在传统架构上面临效率挑战。先前工作使用模拟CAM加速树遍历，但低效映射随着树深度增加需要指数级更多的模拟CAM列。精度还会因编程变异和软决策边界等器件非理想性而下降。为应对这些挑战，我们提出ACTIVAR，一种通过软硬件协同设计在密集模拟CAM阵列中实现的紧凑且耐变化的树实现。在软件方面，我们引入一种模拟CAM感知的紧凑树模型，采用具有共享特征的分层子树以最大化硬件利用率。这种密集映射引入了冗余，从而提高模型精度和硬件缺陷容忍度。此外，我们开发了变异增强训练（Variation-Enhanced Training），利用模糊重叠边界策略构建对模拟噪声具有鲁棒性的模型。在硬件方面，我们设计了一种基于FeFET的模拟CAM单元，带有驱动器以锐化决策阈值，并实现流水线多核架构以优化吞吐量和能耗。在13个分类和回归数据集上，ACTIVAR保持接近软件级的精度，同时与先前基于模拟CAM的软树设计相比将硬件开销降低最多99%。在真实硬件噪声条件下，ACTIVAR在MNIST数据集上将精度下降限制在仅3.7%，而基线模型遭受49.6%的灾难性下降。此外，ACTIVAR架构相较商用通用处理器实现10^4至10^6倍的能效提升，使其成为边缘高容量机器学习的高效解决方案。

items.title_en: LLMs Memorize Their Own Hallucinations During Post-Training
items.title_zh: LLM在后训练期间记忆自身的幻觉
items.abstract_en: Reasoning domains have shaped the post-training recipes of frontier models even though they are trained and deployed in domains beyond math and code. In this paper, we study the consequences of directly adopting reasoning-centric training recipes, e.g., the use of outcome-based rewards for reinforcement learning (RL), injection of "cognitive" behaviors such as proposing and backtracking from hypotheses in reasoning chains, etc., for knowledge tasks. We hypothesize that these decisions, while useful for reasoning, inadvertently encourage models to memorize hallucinations they themselves generate in their long reasoning chains when trained on knowledge tasks. To study this, we train models with standard post-training, extract their self-generated hallucinations during RL, and track memorization throughout the rest of training. Our experiments on six open models across two model families and two architectures confirm our hypothesis. We find that models' recall of hallucinations reinforced during training increases by 4.83% on average, compared to just 0.17% for self-hallucinations that receive no training signal. In fact, models even memorize false facts that they immediately retract in their reasoning; a backtracking template inherited from reasoning-centric training that has no benefit for knowledge recall. Furthermore, we find that memorization is strongest on the hardest training questions, and rewarding a hallucination makes the model less likely to abstain from it later (by 7.23% on average). Overall, our work identifies and systematically studies a previously unexamined pathway through which models learn hallucinations during training.
items.abstract_zh: 推理领域塑造了前沿模型的后训练配方，尽管这些模型是在数学和代码之外的领域训练和部署的。在本文中，我们研究将直接采用以推理为中心的训练配方（例如在强化学习（RL）中使用基于结果的奖励、在推理链中注入提出假设并回溯等“认知”行为）用于知识任务的后果。我们假设，这些决策虽然对推理有用，却在知识任务训练时无意中鼓励模型记忆其在长推理链中自身生成的幻觉。为研究这一点，我们使用标准后训练训练模型，在RL期间提取其自生成幻觉，并在其余训练过程中跟踪记忆情况。我们在两个模型家族、两种架构的六个开源模型上的实验证实了我们的假设。我们发现，模型对训练期间被强化的幻觉的回忆平均增加4.83%，而未接受训练信号的自身幻觉仅增加0.17%。事实上，模型甚至会记忆其在推理中立即撤回的虚假事实；这是一种从以推理为中心的训练继承的回溯模板，对知识回忆没有益处。此外，我们发现记忆在最难的训练问题上最强，并且奖励幻觉会使模型之后更不可能对其弃答（平均降低7.23%）。总体而言，我们的工作识别并系统研究了一条此前未被审视的途径，即模型在训练期间学习幻觉的途径。

items.title_en: BRINA: Bottom-Referenced Inertial Navigation with AKAZE, a Sonar SLAM for Autonomous Marine Vehicles
items.title_zh: BRINA：结合AKAZE的底部参考惯性导航，一种面向自主海洋载具的声呐SLAM
items.abstract_en: Forward-looking sonar (FLS) provides reliable underwater perception where optical sensing is limited, but its use for navigation is hindered by the unobserved elevation of each return. As a result, motion estimated directly from sonar images suffers from an unknown metric scale that is commonly resolved using a Doppler velocity log (DVL). We present BRINA (Bottom-Referenced Inertial Navigation with AKAZE), a sonar-inertial SLAM system for marine vehicles that uses the FLS as its only exteroceptive sensor. BRINA estimates the sonar altitude from the first seabed return in each beam and uses it to project matched features onto the seabed, providing metric odometry without a DVL. We further derive a bound relating the remaining scale error to seabed tilt and slope variability. The method is evaluated in simulation with an autonomous underwater vehicle, and in field experiments with uncrewed surface vehicles over ten missions, using two FLS systems under different operating conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 前视声呐（FLS）在光学感知受限时提供可靠的水下感知，但其用于导航受到每个回波高度未被观测的阻碍。因此，直接从声呐图像估计的运动存在未知的度量尺度，通常使用多普勒速度计（DVL）解决。我们提出BRINA（Bottom-Referenced Inertial Navigation with AKAZE），一种面向海洋载具的声呐-惯性SLAM系统，将FLS作为其唯一外部感知传感器。BRINA从每个波束的首个海床回波估计声呐高度，并利用其将匹配特征投影到海床，从而无需DVL提供度量里程计。我们进一步推导了一个界限，将剩余尺度误差与海床倾斜和坡度变化相关联。该方法在自主水下航行器仿真中评估，并在无人水面艇的十次任务现场实验中评估，使用了两套不同运行条件下的FLS系统。

items.title_en: AnyVIO: Feed-Forward Streaming Visual-Inertial Odometry Across Platforms
items.title_zh: AnyVIO：跨平台的前馈流式视觉惯性里程计
items.abstract_en: Geometric foundation models (GFMs) estimate camera mo- tion and scene structure from images without requiring ex- pert parameter tuning, but either lack metric scale or rely on learned priors to infer scale, which is unobservable from monocular images alone. Inertial sensing offers a way to observe metric scale, but existing methods add inertial in- formation through a filter or factor graph, which reintro- duces bespoke parameter tuning and optimization costs that can grow with the trajectory. To bridge this gap, we present AnyVIO, a real-time, feed-forward streaming model for monocular visual-inertial odometry (VIO), which combines a streaming GFM with an inertial foundation model (IFM). Both the GFM and IFM predict the metric motion between consecutive frames, and a lightweight learned fusion head quantifies the reliability of each estimate and blends them in a single forward pass. Across nine datasets recorded from cars, legged and ground robots, and handheld and head- mounted devices, AnyVIO reduces the metric position error of its visual model by 36% while publishing each pose esti- mate 70 ms after an image is received. We further deploy AnyVIO onboard two real vehicles at up to 140 km/h, where it remains accurate in poor lighting and heavy dust.
items.abstract_zh: 几何基础模型（GFM）无需专家参数调优即可从图像中估计相机运动与场景结构，但要么缺乏度量尺度，要么依赖学习到的先验来推断尺度，而仅凭单目图像无法观测尺度。惯性传感提供了观测度量尺度的途径，但现有方法通过滤波器或因子图加入惯性信息，这重新引入了定制参数调优以及可能随轨迹增长的优化成本。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 AnyVIO，一种用于单目视觉惯性里程计（VIO）的实时前馈流式模型，它将流式 GFM 与惯性基础模型（IFM）相结合。GFM 与 IFM 均预测相邻帧之间的度量运动，一个轻量级的学习融合头量化每个估计的可靠性，并在单次前向传播中将二者融合。在由汽车、足式与地面机器人、手持与头戴设备采集的九个数据集上，AnyVIO 将其视觉模型的度量位置误差降低 36%，同时在收到图像后 70 ms 内发布每个位姿估计。我们进一步将 AnyVIO 部署在两辆真实车辆上，速度最高达 140 km/h，在弱光和浓尘环境中仍保持准确。

items.title_en: Machine Learning Prediction of Autism ADOS-2 Calibrated Severity Scores Using Genetic and Behavioral Features
items.title_zh: 使用遗传与行为特征对孤独症 ADOS-2 校准严重程度评分的机器学习预测
items.abstract_en: Background: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a heterogeneous neurodevelopmental condition characterized by social communication difficulties and restricted, repetitive behaviors. While machine learning has been widely applied in autism research, few studies have predicted continuous autism severity measures such as the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule Calibrated Severity Score (ADOS CSS). We evaluated behavioral and genetic predictors of ADOS CSS across ADOS modules. Methods: Participants from the Simons Simplex Collection who completed ADOS Modules 1, 2, or 3 were included. Behavioral questionnaire data and gene-level measures of loss-of-function intolerance (pLI, LOEUF) and brain-expression specificity (pExt) were used to train 12 machine learning models separately for each module. Performance was evaluated using mean absolute error (MAE), Pearson correlation (r), and SHAP analyses. Results: Ensemble-based models achieved the strongest performance across modules. In Module 1, adding genetic predictors improved Random Forest performance (MAE 1.189 to 1.051; r 0.204 to 0.340). Module 2 achieved the highest overall performance, with XGBoost reaching r {approx} 0.49 and MAE = 1.010. SHAP analyses showed that genetic predictors contributed most strongly in Module 1, whereas predictions for Module 3 were driven primarily by verbal, behavioral, and social-cognitive features. Conclusions: Integrating genetic and behavioral features improved ADOS CSS prediction, particularly in children with limited expressive language. Genetic information was most informative in Module 1, while behavioral and social-cognitive measures became increasingly important in later developmental stages, consistent with evidence that genetic burden is more strongly associated with greater developmental impairment.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：孤独症谱系障碍（ASD）是一种异质性神经发育障碍，特征为社交沟通困难以及受限、重复的行为。尽管机器学习已广泛应用于孤独症研究，但很少有研究预测连续的孤独症严重程度指标，例如孤独症诊断观察量表校准严重程度评分（ADOS CSS）。我们评估了跨 ADOS 模块的行为与遗传预测因子对 ADOS CSS 的预测能力。方法：纳入来自 Simons Simplex Collection 且完成了 ADOS 模块 1、2 或 3 的参与者。使用行为问卷数据以及基因水平的功能丧失不耐受性（pLI、LOEUF）和脑表达特异性（pExt）指标，针对每个模块分别训练 12 种机器学习模型。采用平均绝对误差（MAE）、Pearson 相关系数（r）和 SHAP 分析评估性能。结果：基于集成的模型在各模块中表现最强。在模块 1 中，加入遗传预测因子提升了随机森林的性能（MAE 从 1.189 降至 1.051；r 从 0.204 升至 0.340）。模块 2 取得最高的总体性能，XGBoost 的 r 约为 0.49，MAE = 1.010。SHAP 分析显示，遗传预测因子在模块 1 中贡献最强，而模块 3 的预测主要由言语、行为和社会认知特征驱动。结论：整合遗传与行为特征改善了 ADOS CSS 预测，尤其是在表达性语言有限的儿童中。遗传信息在模块 1 中最具信息量，而行为与社会认知测量在较晚发育阶段变得日益重要，这与遗传负荷与更严重发育损伤关联更强的证据一致。

items.title_en: Multi-Illumination Spectral Reflectance Reconstruction: A method for hyperspectral imaging using digital photography
items.title_zh: 多照明光谱反射率重建：一种使用数字摄影的高光谱成像方法
items.abstract_en: Quantitative measurement of complex coloration patterns is essential for many biological studies and practical applications. Although color perception depends on the observer's visual system, an objective characterization is possible by measuring the spectral reflectance across the sample surface. Traditional methods for measuring spectral reflectance are either limited in spatial resolution, as with spectrometer probes, or limited in spectral detail, as with digital cameras. We present a method for reconstructing spatially resolved spectral reflectance of samples from multiple images taken under different illuminants with known spectral irradiance. Using an optimization scheme that minimizes pixel-value error while regularizing for the smoothness of the reflectance spectrum, our method generates high-resolution hyperspectral images. We tested our method using both existing spectral reflectance datasets and original multi-illumination images taken in a custom photo-box, demonstrating high accuracy and simple implementation of the method, as well as the ability to infer how samples are perceived by different visual systems. Our method can be a useful tool for objective quantification of complex visual patterns in color-related biological research and imaging applications.
items.abstract_zh: 对复杂着色模式的定量测量对许多生物学研究和实际应用至关重要。尽管颜色感知依赖于观察者的视觉系统，但通过测量样本表面的光谱反射率可以实现客观表征。传统的光谱反射率测量方法要么空间分辨率受限（如光谱仪探头），要么光谱细节受限（如数码相机）。我们提出一种方法，利用在具有已知光谱辐照度的不同光源下拍摄的多幅图像重建样本的空间分辨光谱反射率。我们的方法采用一种优化方案，在最小化像素值误差的同时对反射率光谱的平滑性进行正则化，从而生成高分辨率高光谱图像。我们使用现有光谱反射率数据集以及在定制摄影箱中拍摄的原始多照明图像测试了该方法，证明了其高准确性和实现的简便性，以及推断样本如何被不同视觉系统感知的能力。我们的方法可成为在颜色相关生物学研究和成像应用中对复杂视觉模式进行客观量化的有用工具。

items.title_en: Depth-Linked Residual Tokens for Multimodal Retrieval and Generation
items.title_zh: 用于多模态检索与生成的深度关联残差词元
items.abstract_en: Iterative architectures such as looped language models improve parameter efficiency and reasoning capacity of transformers, yet their sequential backbone iterations introduce substantial computational latency. Conversely, parallelizable learnable special tokens (such as the register tokens in Vision Transformer) enable efficient single-pass inference, but often suffer from the absence of sequential refinement and exhibit redundant representations across tokens. To address these challenges, we introduce Depth-Linked Residual Tokens (DepThink), an efficient framework designed for multimodal retrieval and generation. Operating within a single pre-filling forward pass, DepThink appends a sequence of K learnable residual tokens whose hidden states are coupled through a lightweight, learnable residual recurrence. This mechanism enables each residual token to progressively capture complementary information missed by preceding tokens. Theoretically, we prove that DepThink provides strictly expanded geometric directional reachability over standard learnable tokens and guarantees a provable one-step descent advantage. We evaluate DepThink across multimodal retrieval and generation tasks. DepThink consistently outperforms learnable-token baselines and matches or exceeds looped architectures across dense (2B, 8B) and sparse mixture-of-experts (30B-A3B) backbones under both LoRA and full-parameter fine-tuning, while accelerating training by up to 11.9 and inference by 4.3 over looped architectures.
items.abstract_zh: 循环语言模型等迭代架构提升了 Transformer 的参数效率和推理能力，但其顺序主干迭代引入了大量计算延迟。相反，可并行的可学习特殊词元（如视觉 Transformer 中的寄存器词元）支持高效的单次推理，但往往缺乏顺序细化，并在词元之间表现出冗余表示。为应对这些挑战，我们提出深度关联残差词元（DepThink），一个面向多模态检索与生成的高效框架。DepThink 在单次预填充前向传播中运行，追加 K 个可学习残差词元序列，其隐藏状态通过轻量级、可学习的残差递归相互耦合。该机制使每个残差词元能够逐步捕捉先前词元遗漏的互补信息。理论上，我们证明 DepThink 相比标准可学习词元提供了严格扩展的几何方向可达性，并保证可证明的一步下降优势。我们在多模态检索与生成任务上评估 DepThink。在 LoRA 和全参数微调下，DepThink 在稠密（2B、8B）与稀疏混合专家（30B-A3B）主干上均持续优于可学习词元基线，并达到或超过循环架构，同时相比循环架构训练加速最高 11.9 倍、推理加速 4.3 倍。

items.title_en: Weight-Space Programming Writes In-Context Learning and Matches Fine-Tuning in Language Models
items.title_zh: 权重空间编程可写入上下文学习，并在语言模型中达到微调效果
items.abstract_en: Weight-space programming is a frontier language model's recently reported ability to read and rewrite another network's weights without gradient descent. We investigate how examples can provide a weight update so that a weaker language model performs the task with nothing in the prompt, and study what it edits. Our experiments cover six tasks, four frontier editors and three families of weaker language models, without the editors being told anything about in-context learning (ICL). In most runs, the few-shot minus zero-shot residual is measured at the final prompt token, the ICL task vector, and write it into the weights, at its sparsest into near-silent MLP units keyed to the prompt format. Results reach the accuracy of ICL and of fine-tuning on the same examples, LoRA included, usually leaving perplexity untouched, with worse performance under changes of wording. We also qualify the comparison by counting unfinished runs, observing that one editor falls below fine-tuning; held only to the seen examples, without task pairs of their own, only the strongest editor has similar performance. Given a task and unlabelled inputs, that editor writes its own examples and does nearly as well on unseen items as with labels.
items.abstract_zh: 权重空间编程是前沿语言模型近期被报道的一项能力，即无需梯度下降即可读取并重写另一个网络的权重。我们研究示例如何提供权重更新，使较弱语言模型在提示中不含任何内容的情况下执行任务，并研究它编辑了什么。我们的实验涵盖六个任务、四个前沿编辑器以及三个较弱语言模型系列，且未向编辑器告知任何关于上下文学习（ICL）的信息。在大多数运行中，在最终提示词元处测量少样本与零样本的残差，即 ICL 任务向量，并将其写入权重，最稀疏时写入与提示格式对应的近乎静默的 MLP 单元。结果达到 ICL 以及在同一示例上微调（包括 LoRA）的准确率，通常困惑度不受影响，但在措辞变化时性能下降。我们还通过统计未完成的运行来限定这一比较，观察到其中一个编辑器低于微调；在仅给定已见示例、没有自身任务对的情况下，只有最强编辑器具有相似性能。给定一个任务和未标注输入，该编辑器自行编写示例，在未见项目上的表现几乎与有标签时一样好。

items.title_en: Seeing Is Not Steering: Where Verifiable Reasoning Can Enter an End-to-End Driving Planner
items.title_zh: 看见并不等于操控：可验证推理可以在何处进入端到端驾驶规划器
items.abstract_en: Driving models that reason may describe a hazard correctly while choosing their path for other reasons. We study where scene reasoning can enter an end-to-end planner so its influence can be checked. We freeze Drive-JEPA and use a fine-tuned vision-language model to state scene facts. Although fine-tuning improves fact accuracy, the two learned components we test show no detectable benefit from reading them. A rule-based fact check instead rejects or shortens paths that contradict the facts, linking each intervention to a stated fact. On the frozen planner alone, it gains 2.4 EPDMS points on navhard. Its 2.0-point margin over a control that changes the same frames without consulting facts remains statistically uncertain. A diagnostic using exact facts from maps and annotations yields a 3.6-point margin over its corresponding control, with a 95% confidence interval above zero. Separately, a path scorer and plan memory that read no stated facts raise navhard from 41.2 to 51.8. Bounding travel distance using the reasoner's facts adds 0.3 there and reduces navtest by 2.0. The fact check makes each intervention auditable, while the driving value of the reasoner's facts remains unresolved.
items.abstract_zh: 具备推理能力的驾驶模型可能正确描述危险，却因其他原因选择路径。我们研究场景推理可以在何处进入端到端规划器，从而使其影响可被核验。我们冻结 Drive-JEPA，并使用微调的视觉-语言模型陈述场景事实。尽管微调提升了事实准确性，我们测试的两个学习组件在读取这些事实后未表现出可检测的收益。相反，基于规则的事实检查会拒绝或缩短与事实矛盾的路径，并将每次干预与所陈述的事实关联。仅作用于冻结的规划器时，它在 navhard 上获得 2.4 个 EPDMS 点。相比在不参考事实的情况下改变相同帧的对照组，其 2.0 点的优势在统计上仍不确定。使用来自地图和标注的精确事实进行的诊断实验，相对其相应对照组产生 3.6 点的优势，95% 置信区间高于零。另外，不读取任何陈述事实的路径评分器和计划记忆将 navhard 从 41.2 提升至 51.8。使用推理器的事实对行驶距离进行约束在该项上增加 0.3，并使 navtest 降低 2.0。事实检查使每次干预可审计，而推理器事实的驾驶价值仍未有定论。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为用于视图合成的神经辐射场
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续的5D坐标（空间位置 $(x,y,z)$ 和观察方向 $(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和视角相关的发射辐射度。我们通过沿相机光线查询5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组已知相机姿态的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何形状和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Adjuvant myeloperoxidase inhibition promotes B and T cell mediated control of murine melanoma metastasis
items.title_zh: 辅助性髓过氧化物酶抑制促进B细胞和T细胞介导的小鼠黑色素瘤转移控制
items.abstract_en: Metastasis is the spread of cancer cells from primary tumors to distant organs and accounts for the majority of melanoma deaths, with a 5-year survival rate of only 30%. Despite strong evidence that myeloid cells promote metastasis, there are limited clinically effective myeloid-directed therapies. Here, we demonstrate that targeting myeloperoxidase (MPO), a myeloid-lineage restricted enzyme, significantly reduced multi-organ metastatic burden using an immunocompetent mouse model of spontaneous melanoma. Adjuvant MPO inhibition remodeled the metastatic microenvironment by a reduction in Ly6G+Ly6C+ myeloid cells and enrichment of B and T cell populations. Importantly, adjuvant MPO inhibitor-mediated metastatic control was dependent upon B, CD8+ T cells and CD4+ T cells, and rapidly reduced circulating and disseminated tumor cells. MPO inhibition markedly decreased NET release, while NET deficiency and inhibition recapitulated the anti-metastatic effects of targeting MPO, implicating NETs as a potential downstream mediator of MPO-driven metastasis. We further validated these findings in a distinct spontaneous breast cancer model where adjuvant MPO inhibition similarly reduced multi-organ metastatic burden with comparable changes within the metastatic immune microenvironment. Collectively, our studies introduce MPO as a druggable regulator of metastasis where MPO inhibition limits metastatic disease by targeting immunosuppressive myeloid cells.
items.abstract_zh: 转移是癌细胞从原发肿瘤扩散到远处器官，占黑色素瘤死亡的多数，5年生存率仅为30%。尽管有强有力的证据表明髓系细胞促进转移，但临床上有效的髓系导向疗法有限。在此，我们证明，使用免疫功能正常的小鼠自发性黑色素瘤模型，靶向髓系谱系限制性酶髓过氧化物酶（MPO）可显著降低多器官转移负荷。辅助性MPO抑制通过减少Ly6G+Ly6C+髓系细胞并富集B细胞和T细胞群，重塑了转移微环境。重要的是，辅助性MPO抑制剂介导的转移控制依赖于B细胞、CD8+ T细胞和CD4+ T细胞，并迅速减少循环和播散性肿瘤细胞。MPO抑制显著减少NET释放，而NET缺陷和抑制重现了靶向MPO的抗转移效应，表明NET可能是MPO驱动转移的潜在下游介质。我们在另一种自发性乳腺癌模型中进一步验证了这些发现，其中辅助性MPO抑制同样降低了多器官转移负荷，并在转移免疫微环境中具有可比的变化。总之，我们的研究将MPO引入为可成药的转移调节因子，其中MPO抑制通过靶向免疫抑制性髓系细胞来限制转移性疾病。

items.title_en: A fast and accurate model for gradient-based inverse design of multimode waveguides
items.title_zh: 一种用于多模波导基于梯度逆向设计的快速准确模型
items.abstract_en: Multimode photonic inverse design requires fast, accurate computational models that provide geometry gradients. Based on coupled-mode theory (CMT), we propose a differentiable surrogate model. Its parameter-extraction method uses a change of modal basis to obtain coupled-mode parameters from cross-sectional mode data. We also provide a complete, easy-to-implement propagation and optimization workflow. Using finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulation data as a common reference, we compare the prediction accuracy of our model and forward dataset-based eigenmode expansion (EME) for randomly generated thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) waveguide profiles that traverse modal coupling regions. Using identical modal libraries, the model reduces the maximum per-mode mean absolute transmission error by 17-37% compared with forward EME. We demonstrate a spot-size converter design that preserves the fundamental TM$_0$ mode in its hybridization region with the first-order TE$_1$ mode and obtain nine structures, each with FDTD-verified transmission above 98%. These tests demonstrate the model's utility for large-scale photonic inverse design, enabling rapid exploration of the design parameter space by combining gradient information with improved prediction accuracy.
items.abstract_zh: 多模光子逆向设计需要快速、准确且提供几何梯度的计算模型。基于耦合模理论（CMT），我们提出了一种可微代理模型。其参数提取方法使用模态基变换，从横截面模态数据获得耦合模参数。我们还提供了完整、易于实现的传播与优化工作流。以有限差分时域（FDTD）仿真数据作为共同参考，我们比较了我们的模型与基于前向数据集的特征模展开（EME）对随机生成的、穿越模态耦合区域的薄膜铌酸锂（TFLN）波导轮廓的预测精度。使用相同的模态库，与正向EME相比，该模型将每个模态的平均绝对透射率最大误差降低了17–37%。我们展示了一种光斑尺寸转换器设计，该设计在其与一阶TE$_1$模式的混合区域中保留基模TM$_0$模式，并获得九个结构，每个结构的FDTD验证透射率均高于98%。这些测试证明了该模型在大规模光子逆向设计中的实用性，通过将梯度信息与改进的预测精度相结合，能够快速探索设计参数空间。
