items.title_en: Improving Imitation Policies for Multi-Phase Tasks through Residual Learning Allocation
items.title_zh: 通过残差学习分配改进多阶段任务的模仿策略
items.abstract_en: Residual reinforcement learning corrects an imitation-trained base policy using a limited budget of environment interaction. In a task with several phases, this budget must be divided among the phases, and the phase in which the base policy fails is not necessarily the phase in which a correction most improves task completion. We formalize this distinction through the completion gain: the change in full-task completion probability when, during a single phase, a state-feedback controller replaces selected components of the base policy's action. We decompose the completion gain into the probability of reaching the phase and the conditional improvement in completion from the start of the phase, and we estimate it from paired episodes. The positive estimates determine which action components the residual policy corrects and how training episodes are distributed across phases. In stochastic point-mass docking experiments, most failures occurred in the final docking phase, whereas the largest completion gain occurred in the preceding channel phase; gain-based allocation improved completion over allocation proportional to failure counts and, in a variant with a longer approach, over uniform allocation at half of the budget. In simulated bimanual robotic assembly, the completion-gain estimates were positive only for insertion and release, although few failures occurred during release; in a second assembly configuration, a residual policy trained in the release phase improved completion from held-out states at the start of release by 16.9%.
items.abstract_zh: 残差强化学习使用有限的环境交互预算来修正模仿训练的基础策略。在具有多个阶段的任务中，该预算必须在各阶段之间分配，而基础策略失败的阶段不一定是通过修正最能提高任务完成度的阶段。我们通过完成增益来形式化这一区别：在单个阶段内，当状态反馈控制器替换基础策略动作的选定组件时，全任务完成概率的变化。我们将完成增益分解为到达该阶段的概率和从该阶段开始的条件完成改进，并从配对回合中估计它。正估计值决定残差策略修正哪些动作组件，以及训练回合如何跨阶段分配。在随机质点对接实验中，大多数失败发生在最终对接阶段，而最大的完成增益发生在先前通道阶段；基于增益的分配比按失败计数比例的分配提高了完成度，并且在具有更长接近过程的变体中，在半预算下比均匀分配提高了完成度。在模拟双臂机器人装配中，完成增益估计仅对插入和释放为正，尽管释放期间很少发生失败；在第二种装配配置中，在释放阶段训练的残差策略将从释放开始时的留出状态完成度提高了16.9%。

items.title_en: MemFolder: Structure-Guided Memory Folding for Efficient Agent Memory Management
items.title_zh: MemFolder：结构引导的记忆折叠用于高效智能体记忆管理
items.abstract_en: Long-term agents accumulate large external memory stores as interactions unfold, increasing the costs of storage, retrieval, and response generation. Efficiency is constrained by two coupled factors: a growing record count increases retrieval overhead, while longer retrieved contexts increase prefill computation and decoding-time attention costs. Existing methods prune or consolidate records, but pruning can discard useful evidence, whereas consolidation may produce fewer yet longer retrieval units. We introduce MemFolder, a structure-guided memory folding framework that sequentially reduces record count and context length. The framework comprises two core components that share memory groups, using cross-record structure to guide both evidence consolidation and compact representation. RecordFolder grounds entity mentions, progressively selects representative yet complementary anchors, and combines semantic and entity affinity with temporal chaining to consolidate compatible records into fewer retrieval units. ContextFolder encodes the original records within these groups into compact text and uses verification feedback to revise encodings when key facts cannot be recovered. Experiments on the three text-based memory benchmarks LoCoMo, PersonaMem, and LongMemEval and the two multimodal benchmarks M3-Bench-web and M3-Bench-robot demonstrate the strong performance of our methods. Notably, on Mem0, RecordFolder retains 99.0% of the original average performance across the three text-based benchmarks with 50% fewer records, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.9 percentage points in performance retention. Combined with ContextFolder, existing record compression methods further shorten their output records while retaining most of their performance.
items.abstract_zh: 长期智能体随着交互展开会积累大量外部记忆存储，增加存储、检索和响应生成的成本。效率受到两个耦合因素的制约：记录数量增长增加检索开销，而检索上下文变长增加预填充计算和解码时注意力成本。现有方法对记录进行剪枝或合并，但剪枝可能丢弃有用证据，而合并可能产生更少但更长的检索单元。我们提出MemFolder，一种结构引导的记忆折叠框架，顺序减少记录数量和上下文长度。该框架包括两个共享记忆组的核心组件，利用跨记录结构指导证据合并和紧凑表示。RecordFolder对实体提及进行接地，逐步选择具有代表性但互补的锚点，并将语义和实体亲和性与时间链相结合，将兼容记录合并为更少的检索单元。ContextFolder将这些组内的原始记录编码为紧凑文本，并在关键事实无法恢复时使用验证反馈修正编码。在三个基于文本的记忆基准LoCoMo、PersonaMem和LongMemEval以及两个多模态基准M3-Bench-web和M3-Bench-robot上的实验证明了我们方法的强大性能。值得注意的是，在Mem0上，RecordFolder在三个基于文本的基准上以少50%的记录保留了原始平均性能的99.0%，在性能保留方面超过最强基线1.9个百分点。与ContextFolder结合，现有记录压缩方法进一步缩短其输出记录，同时保留其大部分性能。

items.title_en: ADEPT: Adaptive Monocular Depth Estimation via Model-In-The-Loop Photometric Tuning with Capture Risk Prediction
items.title_zh: ADEPT：通过带捕获风险预测的模型在环光度调谐进行自适应单目深度估计
items.abstract_en: Exposure and gain determine the visual evidence available to monocular depth estimation (MDE), particularly when robot motion creates a tradeoff between light collection and motion blur. We present ADEPT, a framework that adapts these settings using learned feedback from a frozen depth model. During training, ground-truth depth identifies the lowest-error reference within a group of physically evaluated camera settings. A compact predictor learns reference-relative disagreement (RRD) between each candidate's depth prediction and the reference prediction using regression and ranking losses. At deployment, it scores observed captures using frozen-model features and camera, motion, and illumination context, without ground truth or reference images. A contextual Gaussian-process controller uses recent scores to select subsequent exposure and gain settings under motion and photometric constraints. We evaluate offline camera selection with relative and metric Depth Anything v2 and demonstrate online control with the affine-invariant variant on a mobile robot. Across nine equally weighted scene-illumination conditions, ADEPT reduces mean scale-and-shift-aligned $\mathrm{Abs}_{\mathrm{rel}}$ by 14.6% relative to built-in auto-exposure and by 10.0% relative to the best-performing evaluated prior controller.
items.abstract_zh: 曝光和增益决定了单目深度估计（MDE）可用的视觉证据，特别是当机器人运动在光收集和运动模糊之间产生权衡时。我们提出ADEPT，一个使用来自冻结深度模型的学习反馈来自适应这些设置的框架。在训练期间，真实深度识别一组经物理评估的相机设置中误差最低的参考。一个紧凑预测器使用回归和排序损失学习每个候选的深度预测与参考预测之间的参考相对不一致（RRD）。在部署时，它使用冻结模型特征以及相机、运动和照明上下文对观察到的捕获进行评分，无需真实值或参考图像。上下文高斯过程控制器使用最近的分数，在运动和光度约束下选择后续曝光和增益设置。我们使用相对和度量Depth Anything v2评估离线相机选择，并在移动机器人上使用仿射不变变体演示在线控制。在九个等权重的场景照明条件下，ADEPT相对于内置自动曝光将平均尺度与偏移对齐的$\mathrm{Abs}_{\mathrm{rel}}$降低了14.6%，相对于表现最好的已评估先前控制器降低了10.0%。

items.title_en: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
items.title_zh: 扩散Transformer中的强化学习后训练即激活引导
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training substantially improves the visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy of diffusion transformers. Because capabilities such as rendering requested text or composing multiple objects are inherently prompt-dependent, a natural hypothesis is that improving them requires learning complex, input-dependent transformations. To isolate how much of these gains an input-independent shift explains, we probe each RL-tuned model with a deliberately simple parameterization: a fixed set of steering vectors added to the block outputs of the frozen base model. On SD3.5-M, these vectors hold 65x fewer parameters than the RL-tuned LoRA (0.29M against 18.8M). We fit them to match the velocity predictions of public RL-tuned checkpoints, with no reward in the objective. Although the vectors are identical for every prompt, token, and sampling seed, they recover 90.0-96.3% of the reward gains of six RL-tuned image models, and 89.8% and 111.9% on two RL-tuned video models. Initialized at zero and trained with online RL, the vectors alone exceed the reward gains of weight-based RL on text rendering (OCR) and human preference (PickScore) on SD3.5-M. A constant shift thus suffices for most of the gain of policy-gradient RL post-training: without new input-dependent transformations, it steers the pretrained generator toward what it can already compute.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）后训练能显著提升扩散Transformer的视觉质量、文本渲染和组合准确性。由于渲染指定文本或组合多个物体等能力本质上依赖提示，一个自然假设是：改进这些能力需要学习复杂的、依赖输入的变换。为分离输入无关偏移能解释多少此类增益，我们用一个刻意简单的参数化探测每个经RL调优的模型：向冻结基础模型的模块输出加入一组固定引导向量。在SD3.5-M上，这些向量的参数量比经RL调优的LoRA少65倍（0.29M对18.8M）。我们拟合这些向量以匹配公开RL调优检查点的速度预测，目标函数中不含奖励。尽管这些向量对每个提示、token和采样种子都相同，它们仍恢复了六个RL调优图像模型奖励增益的90.0–96.3%，并在两个RL调优视频模型上分别恢复89.8%和111.9%。以零初始化并用在线RL训练时，仅这些向量在SD3.5-M的文本渲染（OCR）和人类偏好（PickScore）上就超过了基于权重的RL的奖励增益。因此，恒定偏移足以解释策略梯度RL后训练的大部分增益：无需新的依赖输入的变换，它便将预训练生成器引导向其已能计算的内容。

items.title_en: Corporal punishment acceptability among university students without childhood maltreatment experiences: Associated factors and subfactor-specific patterns
items.title_zh: 无童年虐待经历大学生对体罚的接受度：相关因素及子因子特异性模式
items.abstract_en: Background: Acceptance of corporal punishment and other harmful behaviors toward children may persist even among young adults without childhood maltreatment experiences. Objective: To identify factors associated with the acceptability of corporal punishment and related harmful behaviors toward children among university students without childhood maltreatment experiences, and to examine whether these associations differ across types of harmful behavior. Participants and Setting: An online cross-sectional survey was conducted at four Japanese universities in June 2024. Of 699 students analyzed, 568 reported no childhood maltreatment experiences. Methods: Participants rated the acceptability of 22 behaviors as discipline. Exploratory factor analysis identified three subfactors: neglect and psychological maltreatment, harsh physically aggressive behaviors, and less severe aggressive behaviors. Multivariable linear regression analyses were conducted among students without childhood maltreatment experiences. Higher scores indicated lower acceptance. Results: More egalitarian gender-role attitudes (B = 1.40, p = .001) and less frequent school-based physical violence experiences (B = 1.49, p = .024) were associated with lower overall acceptance of corporal punishment and related harmful behaviors. Associated factors differed across subfactors. Witnessing psychological violence, learning about child rearing, and enrollment in health, welfare, or rehabilitation-related faculties were associated with lower acceptance of less severe aggressive behaviors. Conclusions: Factors associated with acceptability differed across types of harmful behavior, even among students without childhood maltreatment experiences. These findings suggest the importance of prevention education addressing gender-role attitudes, recognition of harmful disciplinary practices, and child development. Educational opportunities throughout adolescence and young adulthood may help promote attitudes that reject violence against children.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：即使在没有童年虐待经历的年轻人中，对体罚及其他针对儿童的有害行为的接受也可能持续存在。目的：识别无童年虐待经历大学生中对体罚及针对儿童相关有害行为可接受度的影响因素，并检验这些关联是否因有害行为类型而异。参与者与场景：2024年6月在日本四所大学开展在线横断面调查。在分析的699名学生中，568名报告无童年虐待经历。方法：参与者对22种作为管教的行为的可接受度进行评分。探索性因子分析识别出三个子因子：忽视与心理虐待、严厉的身体攻击行为、较轻的攻击行为。在无童年虐待经历的学生中开展多变量线性回归分析。得分越高表示接受度越低。结果：更平等的性别角色态度（B=1.40，p=.001）和更少的校园身体暴力经历（B=1.49，p=.024）与对体罚及相关有害行为的总体接受度较低相关。相关因素因不同子因子而异。目睹心理暴力、学习育儿知识以及就读健康、福利或康复相关院系与对较轻攻击行为的接受度较低相关。结论：与可接受度相关的因素因有害行为类型而异，即使在无童年虐待经历的学生中也是如此。这些发现提示，针对性别角色态度、对有害管教行为的识别以及儿童发展的预防教育具有重要意义。贯穿青春期和青年期的教育机会可能有助于促进拒绝针对儿童暴力的态度。

items.title_en: Nonperturbative Bounds on the Ground-State Energy of Lattice QED
items.title_zh: 格点QED基态能量的非微扰界
items.abstract_en: We establish nonperturbative bounds on the ground-state energy of lattice quantum electrodynamics with naive fermions in Coulomb gauge, within the Gaussian photon approximation. Our central result is a spectral comparison theorem showing that, in the thermodynamic limit, the minimum fermionic energy density over all link configurations coincides with that of the trivial gauge configuration. The proof exploits a logarithmic determinant representation and dimensional reduction, without relying on reflection positivity, and applies to lattices of either parity. Combining this result with the positivity of the electromagnetic and Coulomb Hamiltonians, we derive an explicit lower bound on the interacting ground-state energy. Finite-lattice counterexamples show that the thermodynamic limit is essential.
items.abstract_zh: 我们在高斯光子近似下，为库仑规范中带朴素费米子的格点量子电动力学的基态能量建立了非微扰界。我们的核心结果是一个谱比较定理，表明在热力学极限下，所有链路构型上的最小费米子能量密度与平凡规范构型的费米子能量密度一致。该证明利用对数行列式表示和维度约化，不依赖反射正定性，并适用于偶宇称或奇宇称的格点。将该结果与电磁及库仑哈密顿量的正定性相结合，我们导出了相互作用基态能量的显式下界。有限格点反例表明热力学极限是必要的。

items.title_en: cmHC: Balancing Stream Mixing in Hyper-Connections via Geometric Contraction
items.title_zh: cmHC：通过几何收缩平衡超连接中的流混合
items.abstract_en: Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) extends residual connections to multiple streams and stabilizes residual propagation by constraining stream-mixing residual matrices to the Birkhoff polytope, the set of doubly stochastic matrices. In this work, we investigate how to effectively mix residual streams within the Birkhoff polytope. We reveal a mixing trade-off: when under-mixed residual matrices stay close to the vertices of the Birkhoff polytope, hyper-connections will degenerate into a set of nearly independent streams; when over-mixed residual matrices are concentrated around the uniform barycenter of the polytope, streams will become less distinguishable from each other. We theoretically validate our findings by bounding the cumulative residual mixing, stream difference and gradient difference of mixing coefficients across layers. Motivated by these findings, we propose Contraction for Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (cmHC), an exact doubly stochastic method which geometrically contracts the Birkhoff polytope toward its interior. This contraction mitigates under-mixing by forcing the residual matrices to explore deeper into the polytope, with a provable stream mixing bound and no new parameterization. Moreover, we apply a moderate contraction at the shallow layers to prevent over-mixing, enabling stable gradient propagation on extremely large-scale model pretraining. Extensive experiments across dense and mixture-of-experts models at various parameter scales demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of cmHC. We also develop fused operators for cmHC on Ascend NPUs, reducing hyper-connection execution latency by up to 44.8%.
items.abstract_zh: 流形约束超连接（mHC）将残差连接扩展到多个流，并通过将流混合残差矩阵约束到Birkhoff多面体（双随机矩阵集合）来稳定残差传播。在本工作中，我们研究如何在Birkhoff多面体内有效混合残差流。我们揭示了一种混合权衡：当混合不足时，残差矩阵靠近Birkhoff多面体的顶点，超连接将退化为一组近乎独立的流；当混合过度时，残差矩阵集中在多面体的均匀重心附近，流之间将变得难以区分。我们通过对跨层的累积残差混合、流差异及混合系数的梯度差异进行界定，从理论上验证了这些发现。受此启发，我们提出流形约束超连接的收缩方法（cmHC），这是一种精确双随机方法，在几何上将Birkhoff多面体向其内部收缩。该收缩迫使残差矩阵更深入多面体内部探索，从而缓解混合不足，具有可证明的流混合界且不引入新参数化。此外，我们在浅层施加适度收缩以防止过度混合，从而在超大规模模型预训练中实现稳定梯度传播。在多种参数规模的稠密模型和专家混合模型上的大量实验证明了cmHC的有效性和可扩展性。我们还为cmHC开发了Ascend NPU上的融合算子，将超连接执行延迟最多降低44.8%。

items.title_en: Multimodal Error Detection in Chest X-ray Reports: A Large Language Model Reading Image Evidence
items.title_zh: 胸部X射线报告中的多模态错误检测：大型语言模型读取图像证据
items.abstract_en: Rad-Linter checks chest X-ray reports against image-derived evidence to flag potential errors for review. A pretrained image classifier supplies scores for nine pathologies, and a 1.5B-parameter language model, fine-tuned with LoRA on 1,816 examples, checks their consistency with the report. We compare it with a keyword-and-negation rule baseline given the same reports and scores. Evaluation uses controlled report-score pairings from OpenI, with consistency labels derived from automatic report labels and score thresholds. Each counterfactual quad crosses two real reports with two real score vectors from other patients, creating two consistent and two inconsistent pairs. Every report and score vector occurs in both conditions, so either input alone permits only 50% accuracy. On 131 quads, Rad-Linter achieves 98.5% pair accuracy versus 80.5% for the rule baseline, and classifies all four pairs correctly in 94.4% of quads versus 56.5%. The checkers perform similarly on omission items, including unmentioned and negated findings; larger differences occur on the remaining item types, which require interpreting how findings are described. The same language model without fine-tuning remains near 50% accuracy. On a second set of 181 quads that also includes reports on which the automatic labelers disagree, pair accuracy is 93.4% versus 75.3%. These controlled results show that, given the same image-derived scores, a trained language model detects report-score inconsistencies more accurately than the tested rule baseline, with the advantage concentrated in interpreting how findings are worded.
items.abstract_zh: Rad-Linter将胸部X射线报告与图像导出的证据进行核对，以标记潜在错误供审查。一个预训练图像分类器提供九种病变的评分，一个15亿参数的语言模型使用LoRA在1,816个样本上微调，检查这些评分与报告的一致性。我们在给定相同报告和评分的情况下，将其与关键词与否定规则基线进行比较。评估使用来自OpenI的受控报告-评分配对，一致性标签由自动报告标签和评分阈值导出。每个反事实四元组将两份真实报告与来自其他患者的两份真实评分向量交叉组合，形成两个一致对和两个不一致对。每份报告和评分向量都出现在两种条件中，因此单独任一输入仅能达到50%准确率。在131个四元组上，Rad-Linter的配对准确率为98.5%，规则基线为80.5%；在94.4%的四元组中正确分类全部四个配对，而基线为56.5%。各检查器在遗漏项（包括未提及和否定的发现）上表现相似；较大差异出现在其余项目类型上，这些类型需要解释发现是如何描述的。同一语言模型未经微调时准确率仍接近50%。在第二组181个四元组上（其中还包括自动标注器存在分歧的报告），配对准确率为93.4%对75.3%。这些受控结果表明，在给定相同图像导出评分的情况下，训练后的语言模型检测报告-评分不一致比所测试的规则基线更准确，其优势集中在解释发现的措辞方式上。

items.title_en: FORTH: Grounding Tactile VLA Execution via Forward-Only Proxy-Control Pairing
items.title_zh: FORTH：通过仅前向的代理-控制配对实现触觉VLA执行接地
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are widely credited with force control, operating on the unverified assumption that proxy loss minimization implies physical force grounding. In this work, we demonstrate that this assumption breaks down at three core deployment levels: frozen visual backbones discard contact geometry, downstream losses mask token-level gradient alignment, and discrete indicators trigger optimization collapse. To address these disconnections, we present FORTH, a forward-only measurement harness and execution framework that explicitly pairs the optimization objective at each level with its physical control observable. FORTH incorporates three grounded pillars: a layer-local, forward-only tactile encoder that preserves spatial contact geometry without backpropagation, a token-parallel zeroth-order adapter enabling activation-space updates, and SlipGuard, a continuous tactile verification gate that fires on incipient slip. On an elasto-plastic structural shell, FORTH's closed-loop gate peaks at 29 times lower grip force than a monotone reflex ramp, preventing structural crush where the baseline leaves permanent deformation. Furthermore, FORTH matches state-of-the-art execution performance with a 97.6% average success rate across three evaluated LIBERO suites, while reducing peak activation memory by 7.12 times compared to a backpropagated step on the same backbone. Enhanced perception enables deeper physical intelligence.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略被广泛认为具备力控制能力，但其运行基于一个未经证实的假设：代理损失最小化意味着物理力接地。在本工作中，我们证明该假设在三个核心部署层面失效：冻结的视觉主干丢弃接触几何，下游损失掩盖了token级梯度对齐，离散指标引发优化崩溃。为解决这些脱节，我们提出FORTH，一种仅前向的测量框架与执行框架，将每个层面的优化目标与其物理控制可观测量显式配对。FORTH包含三个接地支柱：一个层局部、仅前向的触觉编码器，无需反向传播即可保留空间接触几何；一个token并行的零阶适配器，支持激活空间更新；以及SlipGuard，一种在初始滑移时触发的连续触觉验证门控。在弹塑性结构壳体上，FORTH的闭环门控峰值抓取力比单调反射斜坡低29倍，在基线留下永久变形的情况下防止结构压溃。此外，FORTH在三个评估的LIBERO套件上以97.6%的平均成功率匹配最先进的执行性能，同时与同一主干上的反向传播步骤相比，将峰值激活内存减少7.12倍。增强的感知使更深的物理智能成为可能。

items.title_en: $\varepsilon$-SegFormer: Multi-Resolution Vision Transformers for Sparsely Supervised Segmentation in Electron Microscopy
items.title_zh: $\varepsilon$-SegFormer：用于电子显微镜稀疏监督分割的多分辨率视觉Transformer
items.abstract_en: Segmenting organelles in electron microscopy (EM) volumes requires dense annotations that take experts months to produce, and every gain in imaging resolution adds to this cost. Sparsely supervised methods reduce this cost to a small fraction of labeled pixels, but the convolutional networks they build on see a limited neighborhood around each pixel, while the identity of an organelle often depends on context far beyond it. We introduce $\varepsilon$-SegFormer, a multi-resolution Vision Transformer for sparsely supervised semantic segmentation, which builds on the architecture of MuViT and extends the training method of $\varepsilon$-Seg. For each labeled pixel, $\varepsilon$-SegFormer samples views at three physical resolutions centered on it, embeds their patches into a single token sequence, and encodes every token's position in image coordinates, so that attention relates all views in one shared frame. A segmentation head classifies the pixel from the tokens around it; during training, the pixel's own token is hidden, so the label must be predicted from context rather than local appearance. The model is trained in a single stage, without pretraining, with an auxiliary reconstruction loss. On the BetaSeg FIB-SEM dataset, $\varepsilon$-SegFormer learns from about 10,000 labeled pixels among the 670 million voxels inside three cells, and, given the cell mask, segments nuclei, mitochondria and insulin granules in a slice of a fourth, unseen cell with an average Dice of 0.89 (0.91 after post-processing). Ablations show that coarser views improve accuracy and that a compact head on local tokens works best, with the wider context entering through attention in the encoder.
items.abstract_zh: 在电子显微镜（EM）体数据中分割细胞器需要密集标注，专家需要数月才能完成，而成像分辨率的每次提升都会增加这一成本。稀疏监督方法将这一成本降低到标注像素的一小部分，但它们所基于的卷积网络只能看到每个像素周围的有限邻域，而细胞器的身份往往取决于远超该邻域的上下文。我们提出 $\varepsilon$-SegFormer，一种用于稀疏监督语义分割的多分辨率视觉Transformer，它基于 MuViT 的架构，并扩展了 $\varepsilon$-Seg 的训练方法。对于每个标注像素，$\varepsilon$-SegFormer 以其为中心在三种物理分辨率下采样视图，将其图像块嵌入到单个 token 序列中，并编码每个 token 在图像坐标中的位置，从而使注意力在一个共享框架中关联所有视图。分割头根据像素周围的 token 对该像素进行分类；训练期间，像素自身的 token 被隐藏，因此标签必须根据上下文而非局部外观来预测。该模型单阶段训练，无需预训练，并使用辅助重建损失。在 BetaSeg FIB-SEM 数据集上，$\varepsilon$-SegFormer 从三个细胞内的 6.7 亿个体素中约 10,000 个标注像素学习，并在给定细胞掩码的情况下，在第四个未见细胞的一个切片中分割细胞核、线粒体和胰岛素颗粒，平均 Dice 为 0.89（后处理后为 0.91）。消融实验表明，更粗的视图可提高准确率，并且对局部 token 使用紧凑头效果最佳，更广泛的上下文通过编码器中的注意力进入。

items.title_en: Transmural compression drives lymphatic endothelial dysfunction through Piezo1-CaMKII signaling
items.title_zh: 透壁压迫通过 Piezo1-CaMKII 信号驱动淋巴内皮功能障碍
items.abstract_en: Background: Secondary lymphedema is characterized by progressive lymphatic dysfunction, chronic inflammation, and tissue fibrosis, but how mechanical changes during disease progression contribute to lymphatic failure remains poorly understood. Lymphatic vessels initially undergo intraluminal pressure-induced dilation, whereas advanced disease is associated with extraluminal compression resulting from tissue remodeling. We investigated how these different mechanical stimuli affect lymphatic endothelial function. Methods and Results: We developed a human lymphatic vessel-on-chip model enabling independent control of intra- and extraluminal pressure. In contrast to vessel dilation, extraluminal compression profoundly disrupted lymphatic endothelial barrier integrity, increasing permeability and causing junctional disorganization, while also inducing a strong pro-inflammatory transcriptional response. Mechanistically, compression induced sustained intracellular Ca2 influx and activated the mechanosensitive ion channel Piezo1. Piezo1 inhibition attenuated compression-induced Ca2 responses and protected endothelial barrier integrity, identifying Piezo1 as an upstream mediator of compression-induced dysfunction. Downstream, compression-induced Ca2 signaling activated Ca2 /calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II (CaMKII), whose inhibition preserved endothelial junctional integrity and reduced both barrier dysfunction and inflammatory activation. In a murine model of secondary lymphedema, CaMKII inhibition improved lymphatic function and reduced lymphedema-associated tissue remodeling. Conclusions: These findings identify a Piezo1-CaMKII signaling axis that links pathological extraluminal compression to lymphatic endothelial dysfunction and inflammation. Targeting this pathway may help preserve lymphatic function during lymphedema progression.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：继发性淋巴水肿的特征是进行性淋巴功能障碍、慢性炎症和组织纤维化，但疾病进展过程中的机械变化如何导致淋巴衰竭仍知之甚少。淋巴管最初经历腔内压力诱导的扩张，而晚期疾病则与组织重塑导致的腔外压迫相关。我们研究了这些不同的机械刺激如何影响淋巴内皮功能。方法与结果：我们开发了一种人淋巴管芯片模型，能够独立控制腔内和腔外压力。与血管扩张相反，腔外压迫深刻破坏淋巴内皮屏障完整性，增加通透性并导致连接紊乱，同时还诱导强烈的促炎转录反应。机制上，压迫诱导持续的细胞内 Ca2 内流并激活机械敏感离子通道 Piezo1。抑制 Piezo1 减弱了压迫诱导的 Ca2 反应并保护内皮屏障完整性，从而确定 Piezo1 是压迫诱导功能障碍的上游介质。下游方面，压迫诱导的 Ca2 信号激活 Ca2/钙调蛋白依赖性蛋白激酶 II（CaMKII），抑制 CaMKII 可保持内皮连接完整性，并减少屏障功能障碍和炎症激活。在继发性淋巴水肿小鼠模型中，抑制 CaMKII 改善了淋巴功能，并减少了淋巴水肿相关的组织重塑。结论：这些发现确定了一条 Piezo1-CaMKII 信号轴，将病理性腔外压迫与淋巴内皮功能障碍和炎症联系起来。靶向该通路可能有助于在淋巴水肿进展过程中保护淋巴功能。

items.title_en: A Microwave-Photonics Formulation of the Rydberg-Atom Receiver
items.title_zh: 里德堡原子接收机的微波光子学表述
items.abstract_en: The performance of Rydberg-atom receivers is seldom stated as a radio-frequency (RF) link budget. The receiver is shown to be an intensity-modulated direct-detection analog optical link whose modulator is the laser-driven vapor. The transmission of a warm vapor is derived in closed form by averaging the four-level response over atomic velocities. The conversion gain, noise figure, bandwidth, intercept points, and spurious-free dynamic range follow from this one function. For a weak probe the instantaneous bandwidth is half the width of the transparency window in two-photon detuning. The local-oscillator beat places the second-order intercept near twice the local-oscillator field, so the local oscillator sets the even-order linearity. For a rubidium transition at 17.04 GHz the closed forms agree with a velocity-resolved density-matrix model to 1% for the slope and the intercepts and to 10% for the bandwidth. They underestimate the group delay by a third. The response is tied to atomic constants, and the sensing volume escapes the Chu limit. However, the noise figure of a warm vapor rules it out as a general replacement for an antenna and low-noise amplifier.
items.abstract_zh: 里德堡原子接收机的性能很少以射频（RF）链路预算的形式表述。该接收机被证明是一种强度调制直接检测模拟光链路，其调制器是激光驱动的蒸气。热蒸气的传输通过将四能级响应对原子速度平均而以闭式形式导出。转换增益、噪声系数、带宽、截点以及无杂散动态范围均由这一个函数得出。对于弱探测，瞬时带宽是双光子失谐中透明窗口宽度的一半。本振拍频使二阶截点接近本振场的两倍，因此本振决定了偶数阶线性度。对于 17.04 GHz 的铷跃迁，闭式结果与速度分辨密度矩阵模型在斜率和截点上一致到 1%，在带宽上一致到 10%。它们将群延迟低估了三分之一。响应与原子常数相关，并且传感体积突破了 Chu 极限。然而，热蒸气的噪声系数使其无法作为天线和低噪声放大器的通用替代方案。

items.title_en: On the Complete Feature Set for ADHD Classification in Children and Adolescents Based on EEG Signals
items.title_zh: 基于 EEG 信号的儿童和青少年 ADHD 分类完整特征集
items.abstract_en: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder is a neurodevelopmental condition that can affect attention, activity and impulse control. Electroencephalography (EEG) records brain activity as children and adolescents perform cognitive tasks. However, comparing features derived from these recordings requires consistent signal preparation, shared analysis windows and documented quality decisions. We curated 669 existing BALLADEER recordings from 156 participants across five task conditions so that researchers can compare seven EEG feature families on the same time intervals for each participant and task. The dataset links continuous signals to precomputed measurements from 115 feature definitions or templates and records the quality decisions made for each recording. Analyses must still account for repeated measurements within participants, residual artefacts and differences between acquisition systems. Technical validation covered signal integrity, numerical checks on feature estimators and completeness of the released files. In every task, the median proportion of recording time retained after preprocessing was 100%. To illustrate reuse, we report saved participant-held-out evaluations comparing XGBoost using all seven families on eight-second windows with a predictor based only on recruitment-group prevalence in the training fold. Recruitment-group discrimination was stronger in Robots than in the three Slackline conditions. These descriptive results from overlapping cohorts do not establish diagnostic validity. The dataset, curation software and aggregate results for the predictive example are publicly available.
items.abstract_zh: 注意缺陷/多动障碍是一种神经发育状况，可影响注意力、活动和冲动控制。脑电图（EEG）记录儿童和青少年执行认知任务时的脑活动。然而，比较由这些记录衍生的特征需要一致的信号准备、共享的分析窗口和记录在案的质量决策。我们整理了来自 156 名参与者在五种任务条件下的 669 份现有 BALLADEER 记录，以便研究人员能够针对每名参与者和每项任务在相同时间区间上比较七个 EEG 特征族。该数据集将连续信号与来自 115 个特征定义或模板的预计算测量值关联起来，并记录了对每份记录所做的质量决策。分析仍须考虑参与者内的重复测量、残余伪迹以及采集系统之间的差异。技术验证涵盖信号完整性、特征估计器的数值检查以及发布文件的完整性。在每项任务中，预处理后保留的记录时间比例中位数均为 100%。为说明复用，我们报告了保存的参与者留出评估，将使用全部七个特征族、基于八秒窗口的 XGBoost 与仅基于训练折中招募组流行率的预测器进行比较。招募组区分在 Robots 条件下比在三种 Slackline 条件下更强。这些来自重叠队列的描述性结果并未确立诊断有效性。该数据集、整理软件以及预测示例的汇总结果均已公开可用。

items.title_en: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
items.title_zh: MemOnce：一种面向大语言模型的可扩展记忆架构
items.abstract_en: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures. Standard Transformers accumulate layer-wise, token-level KV caches, incurring linear GPU memory growth and quadratic computational complexity as the context expands. In contrast, linear-time architectures compress history into fixed-size states, but struggle to retain fine-grained details. We introduce MemOnce, a foundation architecture that learns scalable memory states for language models. MemOnce is based on two core designs: (a) Memory encoder-decoder: it caches only a small subset of final-layer hidden states as compact memory representations and dynamically decodes them back into KV caches for attention layers; (b) Memory sparse attention: for each continual input, MemOnce adaptively retrieves relevant memory representations, with the sparse indices computed only once across layers. Coupling these two designs enables efficient on-the-fly memory loading and KV cache decoding, drastically reducing the GPU memory footprint and achieving linear-time complexity. We conduct extensive experiments to show that MemOnce outperforms Transformers and other architectures across varying model sizes, context lengths, and training paradigms (pretraining and post-training adaptation). In particular, adapting Qwen3.5-4B with MemOnce reduces memory state cache by 1313$\times$ and prefill latency by 6.9$\times$ at 1M context, and improves throughput by 3.5$\times$ and overall memory performance by +5.77%. Finally, MemOnce generalizes zero-shot to downstream representation tasks, achieving competitive results against specialized models.
items.abstract_zh: 在长时程和持续交互中部署大语言模型（LLM）需要为未来推理维护可复用的记忆状态，这对现有架构构成了挑战。标准 Transformer 会累积逐层、token 级的 KV 缓存，随着上下文扩展，导致 GPU 内存线性增长和二次计算复杂度。相比之下，线性时间架构将历史压缩为固定大小的状态，但难以保留细粒度细节。我们提出 MemOnce，一种为语言模型学习可扩展记忆状态的基础架构。MemOnce 基于两个核心设计：（a）记忆编码器-解码器：它仅将最后一层隐藏状态的一小部分缓存为紧凑的记忆表示，并动态地将它们解码回注意力层的 KV 缓存；（b）记忆稀疏注意力：对于每个持续输入，MemOnce 自适应地检索相关记忆表示，稀疏索引仅跨层计算一次。将这两种设计耦合起来，可实现高效的即时记忆加载和 KV 缓存解码，大幅减少 GPU 内存占用并实现线性时间复杂度。我们进行了大量实验，表明 MemOnce 在不同模型规模、上下文长度和训练范式（预训练和后训练适配）下均优于 Transformer 和其他架构。特别是，在 1M 上下文下，用 MemOnce 适配 Qwen3.5-4B 可将记忆状态缓存减少 1313$\times$，将预填充延迟降低 6.9$\times$，并将吞吐量提高 3.5$\times$，整体记忆性能提高 +5.77%。最后，MemOnce 可零样本泛化到下游表示任务，与专用模型相比取得有竞争力的结果。

items.title_en: GNetSS: Towards Learning GNSS Corrections without Ground Truth
items.title_zh: GNetSS：迈向无需真值学习 GNSS 校正
items.abstract_en: We present GNetSS, a self-supervised GNSS position correction framework that improves the robustness of single point positioning (SPP) without requiring ground-truth locations for training. GNetSS combines a transformer-based network with a deterministic differentiable positioning solver. The network predicts satellite-wise pseudorange corrections by modelling inter-satellite geometry and temporal context, while the solver converts these corrected measurements into receiver position corrections under GNSS geometry and optional motion constraints. Unlike supervised GNSS correction methods that rely on ground-truth, GNetSS derives its training signal directly from GNSS measurement consistency. Experimental results show that GNetSS improves robustness across open-sky, urban, and forested environments. The method is particularly effective at suppressing large-error outliers, reducing the maximum 3D positioning error by over 50% compared with SPP. These results demonstrate the potential of self-supervised pseudorange correction for scalable and robust GNSS positioning in real-world autonomy applications. Code and the in-house dataset will be released upon acceptance.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 GNetSS，一种自监督 GNSS 位置校正框架，可在训练时无需真值位置的情况下提高单点定位（SPP）的鲁棒性。GNetSS 将基于 Transformer 的网络与确定性可微定位求解器相结合。该网络通过建模卫星间几何关系和时间上下文来预测逐卫星伪距校正，而求解器在 GNSS 几何和可选运动约束下将这些校正后的测量值转换为接收机位置校正。与依赖真值的监督式 GNSS 校正方法不同，GNetSS 直接从 GNSS 测量一致性中获取训练信号。实验结果表明，GNetSS 在开阔天空、城市和森林环境中均提高了鲁棒性。该方法在抑制大误差离群值方面特别有效，与 SPP 相比将最大三维定位误差降低 50% 以上。这些结果展示了自监督伪距校正在真实世界自主应用中实现可扩展且鲁棒的 GNSS 定位的潜力。代码和内部数据集将在接收后发布。

items.title_en: Interpretable Tissue Architecture Complements Pathology Foundation Models
items.title_zh: 可解释的组织结构可补充病理基础模型
items.abstract_en: Tissue architecture provides important information for histopathological assessment, yet its complementary predictive value alongside pathology foundation-model representations remains insufficiently understood. This study investigates whether interpretable measurements of cellular and multicellular tissue organization provide additional predictive information beyond learned representations. We introduce a 139-dimensional cellular-to-community representation comprising nine feature groups characterizing nuclear morphology, cellular composition, spatial connectivity, community organization, and cell-cell interactions. Their predictive contributions are systematically evaluated independently and through feature-level fusion with CTransPath and PLIP embeddings using multiple-instance learning (MIL). On the BCNB dataset, estrogen receptor (ER) and progesterone receptor (PR) classification is evaluated across four MIL architectures using five-fold patient-disjoint cross-validation. Selected CTransPath fusion configurations achieved mean ROC-AUC values of 0.9144 (ER) and 0.8360 (PR), while PLIP fusion achieved 0.8791 and 0.8015, respectively. Patient-level analyses identified ER-associated differences in nuclear morphology, graph connectivity, cellular communities, and cell-cell interactions. On LungHist700, selected fusion configurations achieved higher mean ROC-AUC across four classification tasks, including adenocarcinoma versus squamous cell carcinoma (0.7967 versus 0.7137 for CTransPath alone). Overall, these findings suggest that interpretable tissue-architecture descriptors can complement foundation-model representations while providing measurable insights into histopathological organization.
items.abstract_zh: 组织结构为组织病理学评估提供了重要信息，但其与病理基础模型表征相伴随的互补预测价值仍未被充分理解。本研究探讨细胞及多细胞组织结构的可解释度量能否在学习到的表征之外提供额外的预测信息。我们引入一个139维的从细胞到群落的表征，包含九个特征组，分别刻画细胞核形态、细胞组成、空间连通性、群落组织以及细胞间相互作用。采用多示例学习（MIL），对这些特征的预测贡献在独立使用以及与CTransPath和PLIP嵌入进行特征级融合两种情形下进行系统评估。在BCNB数据集上，采用五折患者不交叉的交叉验证，在四种MIL架构上评估雌激素受体（ER）与孕激素受体（PR）分类。选定的CTransPath融合配置取得平均ROC-AUC为0.9144（ER）和0.8360（PR），而PLIP融合分别取得0.8791和0.8015。患者水平分析识别出与ER相关的差异，涉及细胞核形态、图连通性、细胞群落和细胞间相互作用。在LungHist700上，选定的融合配置在四个分类任务上取得更高的平均ROC-AUC，包括腺癌与鳞状细胞癌分类（0.7967，而单独CTransPath为0.7137）。总体而言，这些发现表明可解释的组织结构描述符能够补充基础模型表征，同时提供对组织病理学组织的可度量洞察。

items.title_en: Within-scan MRI signal and texture in Alzheimer disease: a multicohort study
items.title_zh: 阿尔茨海默病中的扫描内MRI信号与纹理：一项多队列研究
items.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Conventional MRI contains tissue signal and texture information beyond regional volume, but acquisition variability limits their comparability. We evaluated within-scan signal and texture analyses for estimating contemporaneous cognition and amyloid/tau burden in Alzheimer's disease (AD) beyond volumetry. METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 2,437 baseline datasets from ADNI3, ADNI4, MCSA, SCAN/CLARiTI, and OASIS-3. SynthSeg defined regions for T1-weighted and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) measurements. Within-scan regional-to-rest log ratios (WSRLR) were compared with scanner-matched, cross-fitted cognitively normal (CN) references. Texture analysis used three-dimensional gray-level co-occurrence matrices (GLCM). Covariate-adjusted rank models examined associations; ADNI3-trained ridge, elastic-net, gradient-boosting, and TabPFN-v2 models were tested externally. RESULTS: Moderate-to-strong correlations were observed between regional signal changes assessed using WSRLR vs. CN-reference (cohort median regional rho=0.504-0.890; n=2,314). Lower entorhinal FLAIR WSRLR and greater entropy were associated with AD dementia adjusted for volume, while opposite correlations were observed with the hippocampus (all q<0.001). Greater entorhinal FLAIR entropy correlated with lower Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) and Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) scores (r=-0.198 and -0.098, respectively; both q<0.001). Lower entorhinal FLAIR WSRLR and T1 cluster shade were associated with higher regional tau uptake beyond volume and diagnosis (r=-0.146 and -0.205; both q<=0.010). Adding entorhinal and hippocampal signal and texture significantly improved pooled external MoCA (n=868) and MMSE (n=551) prediction in three of four models. DISCUSSION: Within-scan signal and texture demonstrated AD-related regional associations and improved prediction of contemporaneous cognitive performance beyond volumetry. Prospective validation is needed to evaluate their potential value in opportunistic dementia screening.
items.abstract_zh: 引言：常规MRI包含超出区域体积的组织信号与纹理信息，但采集变异性限制了其可比性。我们在体积测量之外，评估扫描内信号与纹理分析用于估计阿尔茨海默病（AD）同期认知及淀粉样蛋白/tau负荷的能力。方法：我们回顾性分析了来自ADNI3、ADNI4、MCSA、SCAN/CLARiTI和OASIS-3的2,437个基线数据集。SynthSeg定义了用于T1加权和液体衰减反转恢复（FLAIR）测量的区域。将扫描内区域相对其余区域的比值对数（WSRLR）与扫描仪匹配、交叉拟合的认知正常（CN）参考进行比较。纹理分析使用三维灰度共生矩阵（GLCM）。采用协变量校正的秩模型检验关联；在ADNI3上训练的ridge、弹性网、梯度提升和TabPFN-v2模型进行了外部测试。结果：使用WSRLR评估的区域信号变化与CN参考之间观察到中至强相关（队列中位区域rho=0.504–0.890；n=2,314）。在校正体积后，较低的内嗅皮层FLAIR WSRLR和较高的熵与AD痴呆相关，而海马则观察到相反的关联（均q<0.001）。较高的内嗅皮层FLAIR熵与较低的蒙特利尔认知评估（MoCA）和简易精神状态检查（MMSE）评分相关（r分别为-0.198和-0.098；均q<0.001）。在体积和诊断之外，较低的内嗅皮层FLAIR WSRLR和T1 cluster shade与更高的区域tau摄取相关（r=-0.146和-0.205；均q≤0.010）。加入内嗅皮层和海马的信号与纹理后，在四个模型中的三个显著改善了对合并外部MoCA（n=868）和MMSE（n=551）预测。讨论：扫描内信号与纹理呈现出AD相关的区域关联，并在体积测量之外改善了对同期认知表现的预测。需要前瞻性验证以评估其在机会性痴呆筛查中的潜在价值。

items.title_en: Shift current as a stacking spectroscopy of hexagonal boron nitride multilayers
items.title_zh: 位移电流作为六方氮化硼多层的堆叠光谱学
items.abstract_en: Out-of-plane polarization can be tuned by sliding polar monolayers in van der Waals materials; the bulk photovoltaic effect is emerging as a natural optical probe, provided the photocurrent tracks the polarization. We test that assumption by computing the polarization and the shift-current tensor from first principles across the stacking landscape of bi-, tri-, and tetralayer hexagonal boron nitride. The two quantities share one robust property: the vertical response reverses with the polarization while the in-plane one does not. Beyond this rule, the correspondence must be read with caution: stackings with identical polarization carry vertical monochromatic photocurrents of opposite sign; the spectra reorganize and even reverse sign at some photon energies along a constant-polarization plateau; and the strongest vertical peak of the entire pathway sits where the polarization crosses zero. The reason is structural: the polarization counts polar interfaces, while the shift current reads their positions. Broadband illumination reads the domain sign; monochromatic photocurrent maps can read the stacking registry. In a sliding ferroelectric, the bulk photovoltaic effect can operate as a stacking spectroscopy.
items.abstract_zh: 在范德华材料中，面外极化可通过滑动极性单层来调控；体光伏效应正成为一种自然的光学探针——前提是光电流能够追踪极化。我们通过第一性原理计算双层、三层和四层六方氮化硼在整个堆叠构型空间中的极化与位移电流张量，来检验该假设。这两个量共享一个稳健性质：垂直响应随极化反转，而面内响应不随其反转。在这一规则之外，这种对应关系须谨慎解读：极化相同的堆叠却具有符号相反的垂直单色光电流；在恒定极化平台上，光谱在某些光子能量处发生重组甚至变号；而整个路径中最强的垂直峰位于极化过零处。原因在于结构：极化计数的是极性界面，而位移电流读取的是它们的位置。宽带光照读取畴的符号；单色光电流图可读取堆叠配准。在滑动铁电体中，体光伏效应可作为堆叠光谱学运作。

items.title_en: A Methodologically Rigorous Benchmark of Linear Regression,RNN, and LSTM for S&P 500 Forecasting:Identifying Sources of Performance Inflation in Financial DeepLearning
items.title_zh: 面向标普500预测的线性回归、RNN与LSTM方法学严谨基准：识别金融深度学习中性能虚高的来源
items.abstract_en: This study examines one-day-ahead forecasting of the S&P 500 closing level using a 2006-2025 dataset that includes fundamental price data, macroeconomic indicators, and engineered technical features. We benchmark three model families, namely linear regression, vanilla recurrent neural networks (RNN), and long short-term memory networks (LSTM), within a unified preprocessing and chronological evaluation pipeline. A central contribution of this work is a methodological audit of common practices in the deep-learning-for-stock-prediction literature. We identify three sources of result inflation that frequently appear in published methodologies: wavelet-denoised evaluation targets, the absence of a naive persistence baseline, and best-of-N replicate reporting. We then re-evaluate all model families under a corrected protocol that controls for each. Performance is reported using root mean squared error, mean absolute percentage error, and the Pearson correlation coefficient, averaged across N = 30 independent replicates per configuration. We compare models on accuracy, stability across replicates, and architectural depth sensitivity, using the naive persistence forecast (predicting today's close as tomorrow's close) as a primary baseline against which all candidate models must demonstrate improvement.
items.abstract_zh: 本研究使用2006—2025年数据集，检验对标普500收盘水平的一日前预测，该数据集包含基础价格数据、宏观经济指标和工程化技术特征。我们在统一的预处理与按时间顺序评估流程中，对三类模型族进行基准测试，即线性回归、原始循环神经网络（RNN）和长短期记忆网络（LSTM）。本工作的一项核心贡献是对股票预测深度学习文献中常见做法进行方法学审计。我们识别出已发表方法学中频繁出现的三个结果虚高来源：小波去噪的评估目标、缺少朴素持续性基线，以及N次重复取最优（best-of-N）的报告方式。随后，我们在对上述各项均加以控制的校正协议下重新评估所有模型族。性能以均方根误差、平均绝对百分比误差和Pearson相关系数报告，并对每种配置的N = 30次独立重复取平均。我们从准确率、跨重复稳定性以及架构深度敏感性三方面比较模型，并以朴素持续性预测（以今日收盘价作为明日收盘价）作为主要基线，所有候选模型都须相对其展现改进。

items.title_en: AltRA-Test: An Alternative Annotator Test for LLM Judges Without Shared Annotators
items.title_zh: AltRA-Test：一种无需共享标注者的LLM评判者替代标注者检验
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges and graders to replace human annotators, raising the question of when such replacement is statistically justified. To support such decisions, the Alternative Annotator Test (Alt-Test) was introduced for dense settings where all items are annotated by the same annotators. However, in many large-scale annotation settings, items are annotated by different subsets of annotators. We therefore propose the Alternative Annotator Test with Resampled Annotations (AltRA-Test), a statistical test that does not require that all items are annotated by the same annotators. AltRA-Test uses a bootstrap that resamples items, draws k human annotations for each item, and substitutes one of them with an LLM annotation. This produces paired all-human and mixed human-LLM panels. A replacement is supported when the inter-annotator agreement (IAA) of the mixed panel is statistically non-inferior to the IAA of the all-human panel, i.e., when the LLM preserves the signal that the human annotators share. We establish that AltRA-Test is a consistent test of asymptotic level alpha. We then evaluate it through simulations and real-world experiments in which we test 18 LLMs and 5 prompting techniques on 20 datasets across text, image, audio, and video. Across these evaluations, about 100 items often suffice for the test. In simulations, where we know whether the LLM is a better or a worse annotator than the humans, AltRA-Test makes more correct replacement decisions than existing baselines. In real-world data experiments, LLMs pass the test in about half of the setups, depending mainly on the task. Since replacement is not always justified, we encourage researchers to test it for their task.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作评判者和评分者以替代人工标注者，这引出了何时这种替代在统计上合理的问题。为支持此类决策，替代标注者检验（Alt-Test）被提出，用于所有条目均由同一批标注者标注的稠密情形。然而，在许多大规模标注情形中，条目由不同的标注者子集标注。因此，我们提出重采样标注的替代标注者检验（AltRA-Test），这是一种不要求所有条目均由同一批标注者标注的统计检验。AltRA-Test使用自助法重采样条目，为每个条目抽取k个人工标注，并将其中的一个替换为LLM标注。由此产生配对的全人工面板与人工-LLM混合面板。当混合面板的标注者间一致性（IAA）在统计上非劣于全人工面板的IAA时，即当LLM保留了人工标注者共有的信号时，支持进行替代。我们证明AltRA-Test是渐近水平为alpha的一致检验。随后我们通过模拟与真实世界实验对其进行评估，在涵盖文本、图像、音频和视频的20个数据集上测试了18个LLM和5种提示技术。在这些评估中，约100个条目通常足以完成该检验。在已知LLM标注者优于还是劣于人工标注者的模拟中，AltRA-Test比现有基线做出更多正确的替代决策。在真实数据实验中，LLM在约一半的设置中通过检验，主要取决于任务。由于替代并非总是合理，我们鼓励研究人员针对其任务进行检验。

items.title_en: Stereo Visual Odometry with In-the-Loop Geometric Feed-Forward Models Towards Dense Metric Mapping
items.title_zh: 面向稠密度量建图的环路内几何前馈模型立体视觉里程计
items.abstract_en: We present a stereo visual odometry (SVO) framework that integrates geometric feed-forward models (GFMs) for dense depth prediction with factor-graph-based visual odometry to achieve accurate localisation and dense metric mapping. Our key idea is to exploit sparse but reliable metric geometry estimated from stereo and temporal multi-view observations to calibrate dense GFM predictions, while retaining the robustness and efficiency of model-based SVO. Rather than directly conditioning the GFM on potentially noisy stereo depth, optimised 3D landmarks are used to jointly estimate a scale-shift transformation over all keyframes within each local submap, yielding metrically consistent dense depth predictions. To balance accuracy and computational efficiency, we introduce a hierarchical factor-graph architecture. At the local level, sliding-window optimisation estimates high-frequency camera poses and multi-view-refined 3D landmarks. Dense predictions are generated only for selected keyframes and registered within each submap using SE(3) Generalised ICP. Consecutive submaps are further aligned in Sim(3) using their shared geometry, allowing residual scale inconsistencies to be corrected. These intra- and inter-submap constraints are incorporated into a global factor graph to produce a consistent trajectory and dense metric reconstruction. Extensive experiments on public and in-house datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive odometry accuracy against geometric and learning-based baselines while providing accurate dense metric reconstruction and improved robustness to failures in learned depth prediction.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种立体视觉里程计（SVO）框架，将用于稠密深度预测的几何前馈模型（GFM）与基于因子图的视觉里程计相结合，以实现准确定位和稠密度量建图。我们的核心思想是利用由立体与时间多视图观测估计出的稀疏但可靠的度量几何，来校准GFM的稠密预测，同时保留基于模型的SVO的鲁棒性与效率。我们不直接将GFM以可能含噪的立体深度为条件，而是利用优化后的三维路标点，在每个局部子地图内对所有关键帧联合估计一个尺度-平移变换，从而得到度量一致的稠密深度预测。为平衡精度与计算效率，我们引入分层因子图架构。在局部层面，滑动窗口优化估计高频相机位姿与经多视图精化的三维路标点。稠密预测仅对选定的关键帧生成，并使用SE(3)广义ICP在每个子地图内进行配准。相邻子地图进一步利用其共享几何在Sim(3)下对齐，从而可校正残余的尺度不一致。这些子地图内与子地图间的约束被纳入全局因子图，以产出一致的轨迹与稠密度量重建。在公开数据集与自建数据集上的大量实验表明，所提框架相对于几何基线和基于学习的基线取得了有竞争力的里程计精度，同时提供准确的稠密度量重建，并对学习深度预测的失败具有更强的鲁棒性。

items.title_en: When Does Looking Closer Pay Off? Simple Foveated ViTs for Fine-Grained Recognition
items.title_zh: 何时更近距离观察才有回报？用于细粒度识别的简单中央凹ViT
items.abstract_en: Fine-grained recognition benefits from high resolution, but not every image region needs it. We study a foveated Vision Transformer (FoVT) that uses last-block class attention from a 224-pixel glance to select regions for refinement. Fine patches from the 448-pixel image replace the selected coarse cells, and the same backbone classifies the mixed-resolution input. We evaluate FoVT on five benchmarks with two seeds and 26 configurations per dataset. Attention beats random selection on all five benchmarks, by up to 2.45 percentage points overall and 4.18 points on the smallest objects. At equal transformer cost, Holm-corrected tests detect no FoVT deficit relative to a port of the official CF-ViT, but no dataset shows a corrected FoVT advantage in both seeds. FoVT requires no feature reuse, distillation loss, or selection schedule. Reusing coarse features shows no significant benefit and costs 1 to 3 points when the reuse module is trained at the head learning rate. Skipping refinement for the most confident 19 to 24 percent of images leaves accuracy unchanged to two decimal places. At the transformer cost of uniform 336-pixel inference, gated FoVT improves accuracy on four benchmarks, with the largest gains on NABirds and FGVC-Aircraft and no significant gain on Stanford Dogs. Foveation primarily saves computation: relative to a uniform 448-pixel model trained with the same auxiliary glance loss, ungated FoVT uses 44 percent fewer transformer operations, with no significant accuracy difference on four benchmarks and a 0.53-point deficit on FGVC-Aircraft. Wall-clock savings are smaller than the reduction in transformer operations.
items.abstract_zh: 细粒度识别受益于高分辨率，但并非每个图像区域都需要高分辨率。我们研究一种中央凹视觉Transformer（FoVT），它利用224像素概览图像最后一个模块的类别注意力来选择需要细化的区域。来自448像素图像的精细图块替换选定的粗粒度单元，并由同一主干网络对混合分辨率输入进行分类。我们在五个基准上评估FoVT，每个数据集使用两个随机种子和26种配置。在全部五个基准上，注意力选择优于随机选择，总体最高提升2.45个百分点，在最小目标上最高提升4.18个百分点。在相同Transformer计算成本下，经Holm校正的检验未发现FoVT相对于官方CF-ViT移植版本的性能劣势，但没有任何数据集在两个随机种子上均显示经校正的FoVT优势。FoVT不需要特征重用、蒸馏损失或选择调度。重用粗粒度特征未显示显著收益，并且当重用模块以头部学习率训练时会带来1至3个百分点的损失。对置信度最高的19%至24%的图像跳过细化，准确率在两位小数上保持不变。在均匀336像素推理的Transformer成本下，门控FoVT在四个基准上提高准确率，其中在NABirds和FGVC-Aircraft上增益最大，而在Stanford Dogs上没有显著增益。中央凹处理主要节省计算：相对于以相同辅助概览损失训练的均匀448像素模型，非门控FoVT使用的Transformer运算少44%，在四个基准上没有显著准确率差异，在FGVC-Aircraft上低0.53个百分点。实际耗时节省小于Transformer运算量的减少。

items.title_en: A specialized extracellular matrix patterns the conserved cortical protein EFA-6 at neuron-epidermal interfaces
items.title_zh: 特化的细胞外基质在神经元-表皮界面处对保守的皮层蛋白EFA-6进行模式化
items.abstract_en: Sensory neurons establish intimate connections with the surrounding epidermis, where specialized extracellular matrix (ECM) help maintain neuron-epidermal interactions. However, whether and how this specialized ECM regulates the spatial organization of cortical proteins at these interfaces remains poorly understood. Here, we show a specialized ECM patterns the cortical microtubule regulator EFA-6 at neuron-epidermal interfaces in Caenorhabditis elegans. We show that EFA-6 in the epidermal cortex is enriched adjacent to the neurites of touch receptor neurons, characterized by discrete foci at the distal neurite and a diffuse distribution in the proximal neurite. We identify the specialized ECM components MEC-1 and HIM-4/hemicentin as regulators of EFA-6 spatial patterning at the interface between epidermis and neuronal processes. EFA-6 proteins contain an intrinsically disordered region (IDR) that is necessary and sufficient for EFA-6 targeting to and patterning at the neuron-epidermal interface. Within the IDR, we further identify an 8 residue motif that regulates enrichment and patterning of EFA-6 IDR at this interface. Finally, we find that EFA-6 contributes to age-dependent neurite defects in him-4 mutants. Together, our findings reveal how a specialized extracellular matrix and an intrinsically disordered region coordinate the spatial organization of a cortical MT regulator at neuron-epidermal interface.
items.abstract_zh: 感觉神经元与周围表皮建立紧密连接，其中特化的细胞外基质（ECM）有助于维持神经元-表皮相互作用。然而，这种特化ECM是否以及如何调控这些界面处皮层蛋白的空间组织仍知之甚少。在此，我们展示在秀丽隐杆线虫中，一种特化ECM在神经元-表皮界面处对皮层微管调节因子EFA-6进行模式化。我们发现，表皮皮层中的EFA-6富集于触觉受体神经元神经突附近，其特征是在远端神经突处呈离散焦点，在近端神经突处呈弥散分布。我们确定特化ECM组分MEC-1和HIM-4/hemicentin是表皮与神经元突起之间界面处EFA-6空间模式化的调节因子。EFA-6蛋白含有一个内在无序区（IDR），该区域对于EFA-6靶向至神经元-表皮界面并在该界面处形成模式是必要且充分的。在IDR内，我们进一步鉴定出一个8残基基序，其调控EFA-6 IDR在该界面处的富集和模式化。最后，我们发现EFA-6参与him-4突变体中年龄依赖性神经突缺陷。总之，我们的发现揭示了特化细胞外基质和内在无序区如何协调皮层MT调节因子在神经元-表皮界面处的空间组织。

items.title_en: World Models for Learning Quantum Many-Body Dynamics
items.title_zh: 用于学习量子多体动力学的世界模型
items.abstract_en: We propose using world models for learning Hamiltonians from measured dynamics of a quantum computer or simulator. Implicitly, the parameters of a Hamiltonian are encoded in how the measured few-body observables evolve. By using a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) to perform prediction in latent space, we show that the device Hamiltonian can be efficiently inferred from noisy measurements. We train a spatiotemporal encoder and predictor with approximately $2.7$ million trainable weights using a single objective, to predict the representation of the next window of measurements from the previous one. The network is thereby driven to retain the reproducible dynamics and discard shot noise. We recover the field and coupling maps of a two-dimensional Ising lattice in real and imaginary time, and the disorder map of a one-dimensional Heisenberg chain of $100$ sites. In every settings the encoder achieves lower error than a masked autoencoder and than the same encoder left untrained. It also outperforms the same regression head applied directly to time-averaged observables, by factors of $4.4$ to $30$. We establish latent prediction as a practical self-supervised objective for learning from measurements of quantum dynamics.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出使用世界模型从量子计算机或模拟器的测量动力学中学习哈密顿量。隐含地，哈密顿量的参数编码在测量的少体可观测量的演化方式中。通过使用联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）在潜在空间中进行预测，我们表明可以从噪声测量中高效推断设备哈密顿量。我们使用单一目标训练一个具有约270万个可训练权重的时空编码器和预测器，以从先前窗口预测下一测量窗口的表示。由此网络被驱动去保留可复现的动力学并丢弃散粒噪声。我们恢复了实时间和虚时间下二维Ising晶格的场图和耦合图，以及100个格点的一维Heisenberg链的无序图。在所有设置中，编码器比掩码自编码器以及未经训练的同一编码器取得更低误差。它也比直接将同一回归头应用于时间平均可观测量的方法优4.4至30倍。我们确立潜在预测作为一种实用的自监督目标，用于从量子动力学的测量中学习。

items.title_en: Passivity Correction of the Thermistor Model in Bolometric Power Sensors and Its Dependence on Bead Temperature
items.title_zh: 辐射热式功率传感器中热敏电阻模型的无源性校正及其对珠温的依赖性
items.abstract_en: This paper closes a series of works on thermistor bolometric power sensors, coaxial and waveguide, by treating what the two have in common. The per-state transformation m introduced in the waveguide work, which corrects the thermistor impedances of the model in each bridge state so that the two-port of the mount is passive, is analyzed on the eleven sensors of the preceding papers: the corrections are a few tenths of a percent in the coaxial mounts and one to two percent in the waveguide mounts, follow one pattern within each family, and the hottest state is the one whose efficiency departs most from the others. The transformation is tested by an independent measurement: the substituted powers of the three states, read with the manufacturer's procedure against a leveled source whose reflection is obtained from the closure of three Apollonius circles, give efficiency ratios of 0.999 +/- 0.016 and 0.997 +/- 0.008 (k = 2), which contain the values at the passivity floor (0.996, 0.998) and exclude those of the first pass (0.941, 1.023). Three sensors were swept in the bridge resistance, 23 and 31 states, and a fourth is treated apart: the correction reduces to one constant per state, the parallel resistance of the bead, represented by a law with one term scaling with the bridge resistance and one exponential in the bead temperature, with one thermal coefficient per family. The same property explains why the cross-ratio of four measured reflection coefficients, invariant under any state-independent two-port, departs from that of the four bridge resistances.
items.abstract_zh: 本文通过处理同轴和波导两类热敏电阻辐射热式功率传感器的共同点，结束了关于它们的一系列工作。在波导工作中引入的逐状态变换m，用于校正每个桥状态下模型的热敏电阻阻抗，使安装座的双端口为无源的；我们在前文论文的十一个传感器上分析了该变换：在同轴安装座中校正量为百分之零点几，在波导安装座中为百分之一到二，且在每个系列内遵循一种模式，最热状态是其效率与其他状态偏离最大的状态。该变换通过一项独立测量进行检验：按照制造商程序，对经电平校准的源读取三个状态的替代功率，该源的反射由三个阿波罗尼斯圆的闭合获得，给出的效率比为0.999 ± 0.016和0.997 ± 0.008（k=2），这些区间包含无源性下限处的值（0.996，0.998），并排除了第一轮的值（0.941，1.023）。对三个传感器在桥电阻方面进行了扫描，分别为23个和31个状态，第四个则单独处理：校正简化为每个状态一个常数，即珠体的并联电阻，由一项随桥电阻缩放的项和一项珠温指数项构成的规律表示，每个系列有一个热系数。同一性质解释了为什么四个测得反射系数的交比——在任何与状态无关的双端口下不变——会偏离四个桥电阻的交比。

items.title_en: Twice-Told Critiques: Claim-Level Homogenization of Peer Review in the LLM Era
items.title_zh: 重复讲述的批评：LLM时代同行评审在论断层面的同质化
items.abstract_en: Peer review relies on several readers finding different problems. We measure critique overlap in conference and journal reviews. At ICLR, measured overlap rose from 12.0% in 2026 to 21.3% in 2027, in reviews from the same stage of the review process, with year-on-year rises at NeurIPS, ICML and the F1000 and PLOS journals. A third ICLR review of a paper added 5.46 new problems to the other two in 2027, against 6.12 in 2026. We apply MELD, a detector of LLM-generated text, to all reviews. Within a paper, two reviews that MELD flags overlap more than two unflagged reviews: by 3.0 points at ICLR in 2024-2025, by 4.5 points in 2026-2027, and by 5.4 points across five journal sources. These results provide evidence that LLM-flagged reviews of one paper are less distinct from each other than unflagged reviews, and suggest that the diversity of critiques among reviews of a single paper is falling.
items.abstract_zh: 同行评审依赖于多位读者发现不同的问题。我们测量会议和期刊评审中的批评重叠。在ICLR，来自同一评审阶段的评审中，测得重叠从2026年的12.0%上升到2027年的21.3%，NeurIPS、ICML以及F1000和PLOS期刊也出现逐年上升。2027年，对一篇论文的第三篇ICLR评审相较另外两篇增加了5.46个新问题，而2026年为6.12个。我们将LLM生成文本检测器MELD应用于所有评审。在一篇论文内，两篇被MELD标记的评审比两篇未被标记的评审重叠更多：2024-2025年ICLR高3.0个百分点，2026-2027年高4.5个百分点，五个期刊来源中高5.4个百分点。这些结果为以下观点提供了证据：同一论文中被LLM标记的评审彼此之间不如未被标记的评审那样有区分度，并表明单篇论文各评审之间批评的多样性正在下降。

items.title_en: Interactive Semi-Parametric On-Track Learning for Vehicle Dynamics in Autonomous Racing
items.title_zh: 自动驾驶赛车中车辆动力学的交互式半参数赛道学习
items.abstract_en: Autonomous racing requires an accurate vehicle dynamics model near the limits of handling, yet a mismatch between the nominal and actual dynamics inevitably remains. To reduce this mismatch, existing methods learn from on-track data, i.e., data collected while the vehicle drives on the track under racing conditions, by adapting the physical parameters of the nominal model or by learning a residual that captures the remaining mismatch. However, these on-track learning methods typically handle either the physical parameters or the residual separately, which restricts their ability to resolve the mismatch. To address this limitation, we propose an interactive semi-parametric learning framework that learns both the physical parameters and the residual under a single shared prediction-error objective. Since updating one changes the learning target of the other, they are recursively updated in turn, each guided by the other's latest update. Each update is then accepted only if it does not increase the shared objective, so that the objective is guaranteed to be non-increasing and convergent over the recursion. Numerical simulations and hardware experiments show that the proposed framework outperforms the baselines. Compared with the nominal model, it reduces the one-step prediction errors of lateral velocity and yaw rate by 90.0% and 81.6% in simulation and by 54.0% and 59.4% on hardware.
items.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶赛车需要在操控极限附近具有准确的车辆动力学模型，但标称动力学与实际动力学之间不可避免地仍存在不匹配。为减少这种不匹配，现有方法从赛道数据（即车辆在赛车条件下在赛道上行驶时收集的数据）中学习，通过调整标称模型的物理参数或学习捕捉剩余不匹配的残差来实现。然而，这些赛道学习方法通常分别处理物理参数或残差，这限制了它们解决不匹配的能力。为解决这一局限，我们提出一种交互式半参数学习框架，在单一共享预测误差目标下同时学习物理参数和残差。由于更新其中一个会改变另一个的学习目标，它们轮流递归更新，每次更新都由对方的最新更新引导。每次更新仅在不会增加共享目标时才被接受，因此目标在递归过程中保证非增且收敛。数值仿真和硬件实验表明，所提出框架优于基线。与标称模型相比，它在仿真中将横向速度和横摆角的一步预测误差分别降低90.0%和81.6%，在硬件上分别降低54.0%和59.4%。

items.title_en: A Vision-Based Framework for Manual Assembly Verification and Adaptive Operator Assistance
items.title_zh: 一种基于视觉的手动装配验证与自适应操作员辅助框架
items.abstract_en: Manual assembly remains difficult to monitor because operator actions, components, and task progress must be interpreted together. This paper presents a modular framework based on a single overhead red-green-blue (RGB) camera, combining object detection, hand-motion tracking, region-aware interaction detection, finite-state verification, task-specific pose classification, and configurable visual guidance. The system was evaluated during pneumatic-piston assembly and disassembly with eight participants under three assistance conditions: full, mid, and no guidance. Mixed-effects analysis identified an association between assistance condition and a composite measure of motion quality, with lower estimated scores under mid and no guidance relative to full guidance. However, the condition-by-trial interaction was not statistically significant, and the estimated differences in learning trajectories remain descriptive. No condition differences were detected in completion time or failed-stage counts. The study demonstrates the integration of visual perception, procedural verification, and configurable operator feedback in a single-camera workflow. Selecting assistance according to operator expertise remains a design objective for future investigation.
items.abstract_zh: 人工装配仍然难以监测，因为必须结合解释操作员动作、部件和任务进度。本文提出一个基于单台顶置红绿蓝（RGB）相机的模块化框架，结合目标检测、手部运动跟踪、区域感知交互检测、有限状态验证、任务特定姿态分类和可配置视觉引导。系统在气动活塞装配与拆卸过程中、由八名参与者、在三种辅助条件下进行评估：完全、中等和无引导。混合效应分析识别出辅助条件与运动质量复合指标之间的关联，相对于完全引导，中等和无引导下的估计得分更低。然而，条件与试验的交互作用不具有统计学显著性，学习轨迹的估计差异仍为描述性的。在完成时间或失败阶段计数上未检测到条件差异。该研究展示了在单相机工作流中集成视觉感知、过程验证和可配置操作员反馈。根据操作员专业水平选择辅助仍是未来研究的设计目标。

items.title_en: BASIN: Background-Anchored Signal Normalization with Integrated Quality Control for CUT&RUN and CUT&Tag
items.title_zh: BASIN：用于 CUT&RUN 和 CUT&Tag 的集成质量控制背景锚定信号归一化
items.abstract_en: Quantitative comparison of CUT&RUN and CUT&Tag datasets is complicated when a perturbation changes the global abundance of the profiled chromatin feature or when there is substantial variability between replicates. Read-depth normalization removes global differences by design, whereas exogenous spike-in normalization can introduce substantial technical variability. We developed Background-Anchored SIgnal Normalization (BASIN), an endogenous-reference framework that exploits recurrent, peak-like background in IgG controls as a quantitative internal reference. BASIN Anchor Regions (BARs) act as reproducible read sinks whose representation rises as specific signal falls, allowing global differences to be inferred from the balance between specific and nonspecific reads. BASIN comprises three pipelines: OVERTURE identifies and evaluates BAR panels, HARMONY derives and applies robust sample-specific scale factors from trimmed BAR signal, and CODA determines whether the assumptions supporting normalization are satisfied. BASIN provides a validated, ready-to-use universal BAR panel for Drosophila melanogaster, and the OVERTURE pipeline enables BAR panel development in other organisms. We tested BASIN against independent expectations and compared its performance with spike-in normalization. BASIN remained quantitatively stable across a >100-fold cell-input titration and detected global depletion of H3K36me3 in Set2 mutants that read-depth normalization concealed. BASIN also preserved expected H3K9me3 differences even when target signal overlapped anchor regions. Applied to a variety of profiling experiments, CODA distinguished normalization failures arising from both biological and technical causes. BASIN thus converts reproducible background from a nuisance signal into an internal reference standard, enabling spike-in-free quantification of global chromatin changes while providing an explicit framework to test when and why that normalization can or cannot be trusted.
items.abstract_zh: 当扰动改变所分析的染色质特征的全局丰度，或重复样本之间存在显著变异时，CUT&RUN 和 CUT&Tag 数据集的定量比较会变得复杂。读段深度归一化按设计消除全局差异，而外源 spike-in 归一化可能引入显著的技术变异。我们开发了背景锚定信号归一化（BASIN），这是一种内源性参考框架，利用 IgG 对照中反复出现的峰状背景作为定量内部参考。BASIN 锚定区域（BAR）作为可重复的读段汇，其表征随特异性信号下降而上升，从而允许从特异性与非特异性读段之间的平衡推断全局差异。BASIN 包含三个流程：OVERTURE 识别并评估 BAR 面板，HARMONY 从经修剪的 BAR 信号中推导并应用稳健的样本特异性缩放因子，CODA 判断支撑归一化的假设是否满足。BASIN 提供经过验证、可直接使用的黑腹果蝇通用 BAR 面板，OVERTURE 流程支持在其他生物中开发 BAR 面板。我们依据独立预期测试 BASIN，并将其性能与 spike-in 归一化进行比较。BASIN 在超过 100 倍的细胞输入滴定中保持定量稳定，并检测到 Set2 突变体中读段深度归一化所掩盖的 H3K36me3 全局减少。即使目标信号与锚定区域重叠，BASIN 也保留了预期的 H3K9me3 差异。应用于多种分析实验时，CODA 区分了由生物学和技术原因引起的归一化失败。因此，BASIN 将可重复背景从干扰信号转化为内部参考标准，实现无需 spike-in 的全局染色质变化定量，同时提供明确框架以检验该归一化何时以及为何可信或不可信。

items.title_en: Autonomous quantum machine learning via Riemannian gradient-based optimization
items.title_zh: 基于黎曼梯度的自主量子机器学习
items.abstract_en: Quantum machine learning models typically rely on repeated quantum measurements and classical optimization during training, making the quantum-to-classical information-extraction process a fundamental bottleneck for scalability. We propose a framework for autonomous self-training quantum machine learning, based on Riemannian gradient optimization, in which the optimization proceeds entirely within the quantum domain without requiring quantum measurements or classical feedback. We derive the Riemannian gradient update rules for a broad class of learning tasks and identify sufficient conditions under which the resulting training dynamics can be realized fully autonomously. Within this regime, we establish an exponential convergence guarantee, in the training iterations, for sufficiently small step sizes, and further analyze the training cost in terms of the growth of the circuit depth. Importantly, we further show that the trained model can automatically discover symmetries hidden in the training data without $\textit{a priori}$ specification. For the canonical examples of quantum phase classification and unitary learning with a hidden symmetry, our numerical study indicates that learning can be achieved at low circuit depths with only a few distinct training examples. Our results thus establish autonomous quantum machine learning as a promising paradigm that removes the classical optimization loop while retaining strong theoretical guarantees and practical performances.
items.abstract_zh: 量子机器学习模型在训练过程中通常依赖重复的量子测量和经典优化，使量子到经典的信息提取过程成为可扩展性的根本瓶颈。我们提出一个基于黎曼梯度优化的自主自训练量子机器学习框架，其中优化完全在量子域内进行，不需要量子测量或经典反馈。我们为广泛类别的学习任务推导黎曼梯度更新规则，并确定所得训练动力学能够完全自主实现的充分条件。在此机制下，对于足够小的步长，我们在训练迭代方面建立指数收敛保证，并进一步从电路深度增长的角度分析训练成本。重要的是，我们进一步表明，训练后的模型无需先验指定即可自动发现训练数据中隐藏的对称性。对于量子相位分类和具有隐藏对称性的酉学习这两个典型示例，我们的数值研究表明，仅需少量不同训练样本即可在低电路深度下实现学习。因此，我们的结果确立了自主量子机器学习作为一种有前景的范式，它去除了经典优化循环，同时保留强理论保证和实际性能。

items.title_en: Geometrical Estimation of Electromagnetic Degrees of Freedom in Reflecting Environments
items.title_zh: 反射环境中电磁自由度的几何估计
items.abstract_en: The number of spatial degrees of freedom (NDoF) of electromagnetic communication channels in reflecting environments is investigated using a full-vector formulation based on dyadic Green's functions and equivalent electric and magnetic surface currents. The channel correlation eigenproblem characterizes the electromagnetic communication modes and their coupling strengths, while the leading-order NDoF is estimated geometrically from the receiver-accessible phase space volume in the electrically large regime. By combining two geometrical projection Jacobians, the phase space volume is related to the mutual shadow area, establishing the equivalence between the two geometrical NDoF formulations and yielding a two-polarization estimate equal to twice the mutual shadow area divided by the squared wavelength. The free-space mutual shadow formulation is extended to perfect electric conductor (PEC) reflecting environments through image construction and phase space ray tracing, accounting for specular reflections and geometrical visibility constraints. The formulation is validated against the eigenvalue spectra of full-vector electromagnetic channels involving planar PEC reflectors, a parabolic reflector, a parallel-plate waveguide, and a non-line-of-sight L-shaped corridor. The geometrical predictions agree with the observed spectral transitions across configurations involving multiple reflections, focusing, and blockage.
items.abstract_zh: 本文使用基于并矢格林函数及等效电、磁表面电流的全矢量表述，研究反射环境中电磁通信信道的空间自由度数量（NDoF）。信道相关本征问题表征电磁通信模式及其耦合强度，而在电大尺寸区域，主导阶 NDoF 由接收机可访问的相空间体积进行几何估计。通过组合两个几何投影雅可比，将相空间体积与互阴影面积联系起来，建立两种几何 NDoF 表述之间的等价性，并得到等于互阴影面积两倍除以波长平方的双极化估计。通过镜像构建和相空间射线追踪，将自由空间互阴影表述扩展到理想电导体（PEC）反射环境，考虑镜面反射和几何可见性约束。该表述通过对涉及平面 PEC 反射器、抛物面反射器、平行板波导和非视距 L 形走廊的全矢量电磁信道本征谱进行验证。几何预测与涉及多次反射、聚焦和遮挡的配置中观察到的谱转变一致。

items.title_en: From Novel Combinations to Informative Absence: Structural permission, communicative opportunity, and form choice in language learning
items.title_zh: 从新颖组合到有信息量的缺失：语言学习中的结构许可、交际机会与形式选择
items.abstract_en: Language learners must infer which novel expressions are grammatically licensed and when continued absence is evidence against them. Our generative theory unites these capacities via counterfactual expression opportunities, decomposing utterance generation into structural permission, communicative opportunity, and form choice. First, shared predictive continuations recover structural permission for unseen word-construction pairings across 30 artificial grammars (mean AUC 0.945 after 120 sentences). Second, under hierarchical uncertainty, we derive a joint evidence law linking omissions to context diversity and within-context repetition, and an exact finite-sample context-refinement inequality. Thus, observing related expressions calibrates expected use to sharpen negative evidence, and higher expected use can drive steeper posterior declines for stronger-permission candidates (reversing initial order after six omissions in a fixed-rate example). Third, we prove that while raw counts confound semantic availability and form selection, scene-level opportunity observations identify both. Empirically, reanalyzing adult and child artificial-language experiments shows meaning-conditioned restriction; judgments of restricted combinations improve held-out production predictions across 399 participants (+0.036 nats/production). Naturalistic child-directed and child speech (11 families, six corpora) shows pervasive source-level usage clustering beyond lexical, number, and dependency-role controls, grounding hierarchical rate uncertainty. Finally, modeling causative judgments across five languages shows that structural compatibility and calibrated usage probabilities draw on distinct distributional, semantic, and discriminative cues. Together, these findings show how the organization and calibration of communicative opportunities govern the evidential value of linguistic absence.
items.abstract_zh: 语言学习者必须推断哪些新颖表达在语法上被允许，以及持续缺失何时构成反对它们的证据。我们的生成理论通过反事实表达机会将这两种能力统一起来，将话语生成分解为结构许可、交际机会和形式选择。首先，共享的预测性续写可在 30 种人工语法中恢复未见词—构式配对的结构许可（120 个句子后平均 AUC 为 0.945）。其次，在分层不确定性下，我们推导出一个联合证据律，将省略与语境多样性和语境内的重复联系起来，并给出一个精确的有限样本语境细化不等式。因此，观察相关表达会校准预期使用量以锐化负面证据，而更高的预期使用量可导致许可更强的候选出现更陡的后验下降（在一个固定速率示例中，六次省略后反转初始顺序）。第三，我们证明，原始计数会混淆语义可用性与形式选择，而场景级机会观察能够同时识别二者。在实证上，重新分析成人和儿童人工语言实验显示出意义条件化限制；对受限组合的判断在 399 名参与者中改善了留出产出预测（+0.036 nats/产出）。自然情境下的儿童导向言语和儿童言语（11 个家庭、六个语料库）显示出超越词汇、数量和依存角色控制的普遍来源层面使用聚类，为分层速率不确定性提供依据。最后，对五种语言中的致使判断进行建模表明，结构兼容性和校准的使用概率依赖于不同的分布、语义和判别线索。总之，这些发现表明交际机会的组织和校准如何支配语言缺失的证据价值。

items.title_en: Generalist Action Critic: Harnessing Frontier Models in Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: 通用动作评论器：在自动驾驶中利用前沿模型
items.abstract_en: Frontier models have demonstrated remarkable general-purpose reasoning capabilities, opening new possibilities for intelligent decision making in the physical world. In autonomous driving, many recent approaches seek to leverage these capabilities through additional adaptation for action output, particularly in scenarios where existing models underperform. We introduce Generalist Action Critic (GAC), a zero-shot framework that combines frontier models' general-purpose reasoning with the planning competence of specialized driving models through an inference-time harness. In GAC, specialized planners generate multiple candidate trajectories and make an initial selection, while a frozen frontier model serves as an action critic that assesses the selected trajectory against scene evidence and either retains it or reselects from the available candidates. The harness combines camera images with spatial overlays, provides driving context and reasoning principles through textual instructions, and regulates the information available at each stage to support trajectory assessment and reselection. On HUGSIM, GAC raises DrivoR's HD-Score to 43.2, achieving state-of-the-art performance among methods trained without additional simulation data. GAC also consistently improves closed-loop driving safety across three planners, with relative HD-Score gains of up to 32.1%. Experiments on NAVSIM v1 further reveal how GAC improves planning performance by correcting up to 52.13% of eligible unsafe trajectory selections while introducing new failures in only 0.67% of originally high-quality selections. These results demonstrate the potential of harnessing frontier models to improve driving safety through inference-time cooperation with specialized planners.
items.abstract_zh: 前沿模型已展现出卓越的通用推理能力，为物理世界中的智能决策开辟了新可能。在自动驾驶中，许多近期方法试图通过对动作输出的额外适配来利用这些能力，尤其是在现有模型表现不佳的场景中。我们提出通用动作评论器（Generalist Action Critic, GAC），这是一个零样本框架，通过推理时框架将前沿模型的通用推理与专用驾驶模型的规划能力结合起来。在 GAC 中，专用规划器生成多个候选轨迹并进行初始选择，而一个冻结的前沿模型作为动作评论器，依据场景证据评估所选轨迹，并保留该轨迹或从可用候选中重新选择。该框架将相机图像与空间叠加层结合，通过文本指令提供驾驶上下文和推理原则，并调节每个阶段可用的信息以支持轨迹评估和重新选择。在 HUGSIM 上，GAC 将 DrivoR 的 HD-Score 提升至 43.2，在未使用额外仿真数据训练的方法中达到最先进性能。GAC 还在三个规划器上持续提升闭环驾驶安全性，相对 HD-Score 增益最高达 32.1%。在 NAVSIM v1 上的实验进一步揭示，GAC 通过纠正高达 52.13% 的符合条件的不安全轨迹选择来改善规划性能，同时仅在 0.67% 的原本高质量选择中引入新失败。这些结果展示了通过推理时与专用规划器协作来利用前沿模型提升驾驶安全的潜力。

items.title_en: A Novel Dataset and Framework for Schenkerian Optical Music Recognition
items.title_zh: 用于申克式光学音乐识别的新数据集与框架
items.abstract_en: Music theory enables performers, composers, and listeners to engage more deeply with music. Schenkerian analysis (SchA) is a particularly illustrative and widely used approach for modeling tonal structure, organizing music into hierarchical layers of harmonic and voice-leading relationships. Despite its importance in pedagogy and scholarship, producing well-formatted Schenkerian graphs remains difficult. A typical workflow might involve writing the Schenkerian analysis on paper, and then manually, painstakingly, entering each symbol by hand into music software, exporting to vector graphics, and manually refining layouts in graphical editors. Existing optical music recognition (OMR) systems for handwritten common western music notation (CWMN) can be leveraged for their ability to recognize small-scale symbols common to those in SchA. However, CWMN OMR models generally fail to recognize large symbols such as phrase slurs, struggle with dense notation, and do not recognize Schenkerian analysis markings. Thus, these models do not extend well to digitizing SchA. This paper introduces a novel framework for optical music recognition of both CWMN and SchA. Our novel contributions include (1) an ensemble model in which each individual model follows a different image-cropping scheme for improved object detection, (2) a topological neural network architecture for notation assembly, where candidate hyperedges attend to one another and perform hierarchical message passing, (3) the first dataset of labeled handwritten SchAs, gathered with novel model integration to the OMR-annotation software, MuNG Studio, and (4) the first algorithm for converting semantic Schenkerian graphs into typeset format.
items.abstract_zh: 音乐理论使演奏者、作曲家和听众能够更深入地参与音乐。申克式分析（SchA）是一种特别具有说明性且广泛使用的方法，用于对调性结构建模，将音乐组织为和声与声部进行关系的层级。尽管其在教学和学术研究中很重要，生成格式良好的申克式图仍然困难。典型工作流可能包括在纸上书写申克式分析，然后手动、费力地将每个符号逐个输入音乐软件，导出为矢量图形，并在图形编辑器中手动精修布局。现有的用于手写通用西方音乐记谱（CWMN）的光学音乐识别（OMR）系统可利用其识别 SchA 中常见小尺度符号的能力。然而，CWMN OMR 模型通常无法识别乐句连音线等大型符号，难以处理密集记谱，并且不识别申克式分析标记。因此，这些模型不能很好地扩展到 SchA 的数字化。本文提出一种用于 CWMN 和 SchA 光学音乐识别的新框架。我们的新贡献包括：（1）一种集成模型，其中每个个体模型遵循不同的图像裁剪方案以改进目标检测；（2）一种用于记谱组装的拓扑神经网络架构，其中候选超边相互关注并执行分层消息传递；（3）首个带标注手写 SchA 数据集，通过将新模型集成到 OMR 标注软件 MuNG Studio 中采集；（4）首个将语义申克式图转换为排版格式的算法。

items.title_en: A Strategy to Identify Endogenous Ligands for a Protein
items.title_zh: 一种鉴定蛋白质内源性配体的策略
items.abstract_en: Protein-metabolite interactions are essential to numerous metabolic processes and underly many disease mechanisms. However, detecting these interactions is a challenge due to the transient nature of protein-metabolite associations. Here, we employ an untargeted functional metabolomics screening strategy to uncover low-affinity interactions between an entire metabolome and a kinase. We first utilize high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC)-guided fractionation to separate a whole-metabolome extract into multiple fixed-time fractions. A metabolite fraction library (mFL) of one-dimensional (1D) proton (1H) NMR spectra is then generated from these fractions. After adding the protein to the same fractions, saturation transfer difference (STD) NMR is then performed on each to detect weak protein-metabolite interactions and develop an STD library. Using the binding resonances from the STD library as a guide, the identity of the binding ligand can be determined. We demonstrate this strategy using frutosamine-3-kinase (FN3K) to identify and validate both known and novel binders. This workflow serves as a practical and simple way to screen an organism's metabolome for endogenous effector molecules, further strengthening our knowledge of protein-metabolite interactions and the functional metabolome.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质-代谢物相互作用对众多代谢过程至关重要，并且是许多疾病机制的基础。然而，由于蛋白质-代谢物结合的瞬态性质，检测这些相互作用具有挑战性。在这里，我们采用非靶向功能代谢组学筛选策略，揭示整个代谢组与一种激酶之间的低亲和力相互作用。我们首先利用高效液相色谱（HPLC）引导的分级分离，将全代谢组提取物分离为多个固定时间级分。然后从这些级分生成一维（1D）质子（1H）NMR 谱的代谢物级分库（mFL）。将蛋白质加入相同级分后，对每个级分进行饱和转移差谱（STD）NMR，以检测弱蛋白质-代谢物相互作用并构建 STD 库。以 STD 库中的结合共振作为指导，可以确定结合配体的身份。我们使用果糖胺-3-激酶（FN3K）演示该策略，以鉴定并验证已知和新型结合物。该工作流为筛选生物体代谢组中的内源性效应分子提供了一种实用而简单的方法，进一步加强了我们对蛋白质-代谢物相互作用和功能代谢组的认识。

items.title_en: Penalty-Free Constrained Optimization on Dynamic Quantum Circuits via Phase-Protected Tunneling and Closed-Loop Spectral Ratchets
items.title_zh: 通过相位保护隧穿和闭环谱棘轮在动态量子电路上实现无惩罚约束优化
items.abstract_en: Embedding hard operational constraints into an unconstrained Hamiltonian via large penalty multipliers induces quadratic spectral aliasing during phase estimation and increases two-qubit gate depth. This paper proposes a penalty-free, closed-loop dynamic quantum circuit scheme, designated as Zeno-decoupled gauge-ratchet optimization (Z-GRO), for constrained binary optimization without outer-loop training. Reversible feasibility phase operators within symmetric dynamical-decoupling echoes confine evolution to the feasible subspace, while an interaction-correlated commutator gauge operator resolves initial symmetry stall. Directional cooling couples the unpenalized objective Hamiltonian to a reusable ancilla with a zero-two-qubit-gate threshold offset, bypassing echoed tunneling gates on retained branches. A survival-filtered Ramsey controller advances the threshold from a linear-programming bound with automatic overshoot rollback. Exact density-matrix and trajectory simulations on spin-glass and quadratic knapsack ensembles show a single-check discrimination gain above four orders of magnitude, improving ground-state probability by factors of 3.0 to 4.3 over quantum Zeno dynamics and 11.4 to 22.5 over penalized schemes. Z-GRO reduces the spin-glass time-to-solution scaling base to 1.529 (compared to 1.684 for quantum Zeno dynamics and 1.909 to 2.047 for penalized schemes) and lowers 14-qubit knapsack time-to-solution by factors of 2.4 to 14.5. For two-qubit gate error rates between $5 \times 10^{-4}$ and $5 \times 10^{-3}$, Z-GRO achieves 2.9 to 7.0 times the optimal probability of noisy penalized feedback, while majority shielding limits loss to 6.3% at a 5.0% readout bit-flip rate, recording 0/24, 0/25, 0/96, 3/25, and 2/80 overshoots.
items.abstract_zh: 通过大惩罚乘子将硬性操作约束嵌入无约束哈密顿量，会在相位估计期间引起二次谱混叠，并增加双量子比特门深度。本文提出一种无惩罚、闭环的动态量子电路方案，称为 Zeno 解耦规范棘轮优化（Z-GRO），用于无需外环训练的约束二进制优化。对称动力学解耦回波内的可逆可行性相位算子将演化限制在可行子空间内，而与相互作用相关的对易子规范算子解决初始对称性停滞。定向冷却将无惩罚目标哈密顿量耦合到一个可复用的辅助比特，并具有零双量子比特门阈值偏移，从而在保留分支上绕过回波隧穿门。经生存滤波的 Ramsey 控制器从线性规划边界推进阈值，并具有自动过冲回滚。在自旋玻璃和二次背包集合上的精确密度矩阵与轨迹模拟显示，单次检查判别增益超过四个数量级，相较于量子 Zeno 动力学将基态概率提高 3.0 至 4.3 倍，相较于惩罚方案提高 11.4 至 22.5 倍。Z-GRO 将自旋玻璃求解时间缩放基数降低至 1.529（量子 Zeno 动力学为 1.684，惩罚方案为 1.909 至 2.047），并将 14 量子比特背包求解时间降低 2.4 至 14.5 倍。对于 $5 \times 10^{-4}$ 至 $5 \times 10^{-3}$ 的双量子比特门错误率，Z-GRO 达到含噪惩罚反馈最优概率的 2.9 至 7.0 倍；而在 5.0% 读出比特翻转率下，多数屏蔽将损失限制在 6.3%，记录到 0/24、0/25、0/96、3/25 和 2/80 次过冲。
