items.title_en: Spiking Neural Networks Incrementally Track Firing-Rate Networks
items.title_zh: 脉冲神经网络增量跟踪放电率网络
items.abstract_en: Understanding how spiking neural networks (SNNs) efficiently process data streams is key to (i) studying how biological brains conserve energy for lifelong predictions and (ii) enabling efficient continuous AI inference. In this work, we propose a theory on how an SNN incrementally tracks its corresponding firing-rate network, a continuous-valued neural network (ANN). We prove that the output of a discrete SNN continuously tracks the instantaneous ANN output implicitly determined by the SNN input. Based on this principle, we develop LIF-Stream, a conversion framework for efficient SNN inference over unbounded data streams. It enables the converted SNN to reuse its prior activation state and compute only the activation updates between frames, thereby reducing the average number of time steps needed per frame. Specifically, LIF-Stream controls the SNN to continuously track the reference ANN output, which gives a high-accuracy prediction for every frame. Evaluation on three large-scale streaming inference benchmarks with distinct modalities shows that LIF-Stream achieves the best efficiency-accuracy trade-off compared to high-accuracy SNN techniques.
items.abstract_zh: 理解脉冲神经网络（SNN）如何高效处理数据流，是（i）研究生物大脑如何为终身预测节约能量以及（ii）实现高效连续 AI 推理的关键。在本工作中，我们提出一种关于 SNN 如何增量跟踪其对应放电率网络（一种连续值神经网络（ANN））的理论。我们证明，离散 SNN 的输出连续跟踪由 SNN 输入隐式确定的瞬时 ANN 输出。基于这一原理，我们开发了 LIF-Stream，一种用于在无界数据流上进行高效 SNN 推理的转换框架。它使转换后的 SNN 能够复用其先前的激活状态，并且仅计算帧间的激活更新，从而减少每帧所需的平均时间步数。具体而言，LIF-Stream 控制 SNN 连续跟踪参考 ANN 输出，从而为每一帧给出高精度预测。在具有不同模态的三个大规模流式推理基准上的评估表明，与高精度 SNN 技术相比，LIF-Stream 实现了最佳效率-精度权衡。

items.title_en: Typhoon OCR 2: From Thai Document Transcription to Multilingual, Multi-Task OCR
items.title_zh: Typhoon OCR 2：从泰语文档转录到多语言、多任务 OCR
items.abstract_en: Typhoon OCR 1.5 focused on reading Thai documents. However, in real-world workflows, users often need to extract specific information or preserve the structure of an entire page for further processing. Typhoon OCR 2 handles both tasks in a single model, with prompt-driven extraction and structured full-page parsing. Full-page parsing covers Thai, English, and Chinese. We release compact 2B and 0.8B models adapted from open document parsers through supervised fine-tuning on curated Thai and public multilingual data, followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with task rewards and a rule penalizing unfinished responses. Among evaluated open models, Typhoon OCR 2 2B scores highest on Thai MDPBench (80.7 versus 68.9 for Typhoon OCR 1.5) and on ThaiOCRBench (59.91 versus 40.45), which covers recognition, extraction, and document understanding. The 2B model remains close to its base on English olmOCR-bench (84.7 versus 84.4) and on OmniDocBench, which evaluates English and Chinese together (90.97 versus 91.03). On MDPBench, GRPO reduces the mean share of pages with repetition loops for the 2B model from 3.2% to 0.7%, with a smaller and statistically uncertain score gain for the 0.8B model. We release the model weights, Python package, and evaluation suite.
items.abstract_zh: Typhoon OCR 1.5 专注于阅读泰语文档。然而，在真实工作流中，用户常常需要提取特定信息或保留整页结构以便进一步处理。Typhoon OCR 2 在单个模型中处理这两类任务，包括提示驱动的提取和结构化全页解析。全页解析涵盖泰语、英语和中文。我们发布了紧凑的 2B 和 0.8B 模型，这些模型基于开放文档解析器，通过在精选泰语数据和公开多语言数据上进行监督微调，随后使用带任务奖励和惩罚未完成响应规则的组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行适配。在受评估的开放模型中，Typhoon OCR 2 2B 在 Thai MDPBench（80.7 对 Typhoon OCR 1.5 的 68.9）和 ThaiOCRBench（59.91 对 40.45）上得分最高，后者涵盖识别、提取和文档理解。2B 模型在英语 olmOCR-bench 上（84.7 对 84.4）以及在同时评估英语和中文的 OmniDocBench 上（90.97 对 91.03）仍接近其基座模型。在 MDPBench 上，GRPO 将 2B 模型出现重复循环页面的平均占比从 3.2% 降至 0.7%，而 0.8B 模型的分数提升较小且统计上不确定。我们发布模型权重、Python 包和评估套件。

items.title_en: Synthesizing Expressive Human-Object Interactions via Test-time Latent Adaptation
items.title_zh: 通过测试时潜在适配合成富有表现力的人-物交互
items.abstract_en: When interacting with objects of unknown physical properties, humans sometimes probe, over-exert, stagger, and adjust through iterative adaptation instead of succeeding immediately. We argue that this process is an expressive but largely overlooked aspect of human-object interaction in motion synthesis. Both kinematic data-driven methods and physics-based controllers tend to produce flawlessly executed motions: the former lack sufficient data for learning fine-grained adaptation, while the latter use reinforcement learning (RL) and privileged object dynamics to learn robust, deterministic behaviors. We propose ExpHOI (Expressive Human-Object Interaction), a test-time latent adaptation framework built on an RL-trained physics-based control policy. During policy training, we encode diverse object dynamics contexts into a structured latent space. At test time, Advantage-Weighted Regression (AWR) iteratively optimizes the latent code for an object with unknown physical properties. Temporary mismatches between this code and the true object dynamics produce an expressive progression from tentative, error-prone trials to proficient interaction. Adaptation behaviors inevitably come with occasional failures, so a high-level planner is introduced to handle failed cases to maintain full, consistent animations. We demonstrate our framework's effectiveness on a large-object transportation task, where such adaptation is especially pronounced. To train our framework, we introduce a mass-diverse object dataset with rich physical-property annotations. Across carrying and push-pull, our method pairs over 90% success with markedly higher posture diversity, and is rated the most lifelike in our user study on animation liveliness.
items.abstract_zh: 在与物理属性未知的物体交互时，人类有时会通过迭代适配进行试探、过度用力、踉跄和调整，而不是立即成功。我们认为，这一过程是运动合成中人-物交互的一个富有表现力但很大程度上被忽视的方面。运动学数据驱动方法和基于物理的控制器都倾向于产生完美执行的运动：前者缺乏足够数据来学习细粒度适配，而后者使用强化学习（RL）和特权物体动力学来学习稳健的确定性行为。我们提出 ExpHOI（Expressive Human-Object Interaction），一种建立在经 RL 训练的基于物理的控制策略之上的测试时潜在适配框架。在策略训练期间，我们将多样化的物体动力学上下文编码到结构化潜在空间中。在测试时，优势加权回归（AWR）针对具有未知物理属性的物体迭代优化潜在编码。该编码与真实物体动力学之间的暂时不匹配，会产生从试探性、易出错的尝试到熟练交互的富有表现力的进展。适配行为不可避免地伴随偶发失败，因此引入高层规划器来处理失败情形，以保持完整、一致的动画。我们在大型物体运输任务上展示了该框架的有效性，其中这种适配尤为明显。为训练我们的框架，我们引入一个具有丰富物理属性标注的质量多样化物体数据集。在搬运和推拉任务中，我们的方法将超过 90% 的成功率与显著更高的姿态多样性相结合，并在我们关于动画生动性的用户研究中被评为最逼真。

items.title_en: SGAR: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction via Sparse Geometry-Guided Attention
items.title_zh: SGAR：通过稀疏几何引导注意力的前馈三维重建
items.abstract_en: Feed-forward models have been very successful in 3D reconstruction with ad hoc attention designs that relate all view patches densely. However, the cost of this dense global attention grows quadratically with the number of views, preventing the model from applying to larger-scale reconstruction settings. In this paper, we argue that most dense attention computations are unnecessary from a classical structure-from-motion perspective: 3D structures stem from geometrically matching regions in 2D. We bring this principle to learning-based feed-forward reconstruction with our Sparse Geometric Attention Reconstruction (SGAR) method. In SGAR, each patch token attends to only a small set of patch tokens from other views, chosen by a lightweight learned key selection module trained to predict cross-view 3D proximity of tokens. Thus, dense global attention is replaced by much more efficient geometric-similarity-guided sparse attention. SGAR is a general method that can be applied to different feed-forward models by fine-tuning. In our experiments, we show that SGAR is the fastest among both state-of-the-art dense and sparse methods and the most accurate sparse one. It runs up to 12-times faster than dense attention at 1,000 views with stable pose accuracy where existing sparse methods fail, and shows the best performance in reconstructing more complete geometries on the same time budget.
items.abstract_zh: 前馈模型凭借将全部视图块密集关联的专用注意力设计，在三维重建中取得了很大成功。然而，这种密集全局注意力的成本随视图数量呈二次增长，使模型无法应用于更大规模的重建场景。本文从经典运动恢复结构的角度指出，大多数密集注意力计算是不必要的：三维结构源于二维中几何匹配的区域。我们将这一原则引入基于学习的前馈重建，提出稀疏几何注意力重建（SGAR）方法。在 SGAR 中，每个块 token 仅关注来自其他视图的一小组块 token，这些 token 由经过训练以预测 token 跨视图三维邻近性的轻量级学习键选择模块选出。因此，密集全局注意力被更高效的几何相似性引导的稀疏注意力取代。SGAR 是一种通用方法，可通过微调应用于不同的前馈模型。在实验中，我们表明 SGAR 在最先进的密集和稀疏方法中速度最快，并且是稀疏方法中最准确的。在 1,000 个视图下，它以比密集注意力快至多 12 倍的速度运行，并具有稳定的位姿精度，而现有稀疏方法在此失效；在相同时间预算下，它在重建更完整几何方面表现出最佳性能。

items.title_en: Nuclear confinement from matrix stiffness drives epigenomic reprogramming of gingival fibroblasts
items.title_zh: 基质刚度引起的核受限驱动牙龈成纤维细胞的表观基因组重编程
items.abstract_en: Stromal fibroblasts reside in a three-dimensional (3D) extracellular matrix (ECM) that physically confines the cell and its nucleus. Nuclear mechanobiology studies have relied largely on two-dimensional substrates, on which cells spread freely without confinement. Therefore, it remains largely unknown how confinement in 3D stiff tissues regulates the fibroblast epigenome. Healthy human gingiva is characterized by a dense, stiff collagen ECM that undergoes softening in periodontal disease. A reduction in collagen in human gingiva correlated with elevated stromal H3K27 acetylation. In 3D hydrogels with stiffness matched to healthy and diseased gingiva, stiffness-dependent matrix confinement compacted the fibroblast nucleus, folded the nuclear envelope, and maintained low H3K27 acetylation through DNA methyltransferase activity, independently of actomyosin contractility. Stiff-matrix confinement increased DNA methylation at pericentromeric satellite repeats and decreased it at CTCF motifs. A stochastic chromatin model showed that broadening the range of chromatin contacts is sufficient to increase methylation in highly methylated regions and decrease it in less methylated regions, with changes concentrated at methylation-domain boundaries in both the model and the data. Stiff-matrix confinement also reduced CTCF occupancy uniformly across the genome, independent of CTCF expression and local DNA methylation. These changes led to hypomethylation of collagen gene promoter sequences, whereas hypermethylation of the MAP3K14 promoter attenuated non-canonical NF-{kappa}B inflammatory signaling. These findings establish stiffness-dependent 3D confinement as a physical regulator of the stromal epigenome and inflammatory states and motivate new mechanotherapies that restore tissue stiffness to resolve stromal cell states in chronic inflammatory diseases.
items.abstract_zh: 基质成纤维细胞位于三维（3D）细胞外基质（ECM）中，该基质在物理上限制细胞及其细胞核。核机械生物学研究很大程度上依赖二维基底，细胞在二维基底上可自由铺展而不受限制。因此，三维硬组织中的受限如何调控成纤维细胞表观基因组仍很大程度上未知。健康人牙龈的特征是致密、坚硬的胶原 ECM，而在牙周病中会发生软化。人牙龈中胶原减少与基质 H3K27 乙酰化升高相关。在刚度匹配健康和病变牙龈的 3D 水凝胶中，刚度依赖的基质受限使成纤维细胞核压缩、核膜折叠，并通过 DNA 甲基转移酶活性维持低 H3K27 乙酰化，且不依赖肌动球蛋白收缩性。硬基质受限增加了着丝粒周围卫星重复序列的 DNA 甲基化，并降低了 CTCF 基序处的 DNA 甲基化。一个随机染色质模型显示，拓宽染色质接触范围足以在高甲基化区域增加甲基化、在低甲基化区域降低甲基化，且模型和数据中的变化均集中在甲基化结构域边界。硬基质受限还以不依赖 CTCF 表达和局部 DNA 甲基化的方式，在全基因组范围内均匀降低 CTCF 占据。这些变化导致胶原基因启动子序列低甲基化，而 MAP3K14 启动子高甲基化减弱了非经典 NF-κB 炎症信号。这些发现确立刚度依赖的 3D 受限是基质表观基因组和炎症状态的物理调节因子，并推动新的机械疗法，通过恢复组织刚度来解决慢性炎症疾病中的基质细胞状态。

items.title_en: Quantum control of an electrically levitated nanoparticle with a trapped ion
items.title_zh: 利用囚禁离子对电悬浮纳米颗粒进行量子控制
items.abstract_en: Quantum control of levitated nanoparticles offers a route towards macroscopic quantum states. Here we propose a novel way to achieve it for a nanoparticle levitated electrically in a linear Paul trap together with a single ion, a system recently realized experimentally. By suitably engineering the trap's AC potential, one can parametrically modulate the ion-nanoparticle distance and thus the Coulomb coupling to enable a resonant interaction. For realistic parameters, we calculate that this enables sympathetic cooling of the nanoparticle to its motional ground state by a single, continuously laser-cooled ion. Additional AC drives enable the preparation of squeezed nanoparticle states and of ion-nanoparticle entanglement. Moreover, non-Gaussian states such as Fock and cat states, prepared in the ion with standard trapped-ion techniques, can be transferred to the nanoparticle with high fidelities. We provide complete protocols for each of these states, including all known decoherence sources. Our results establish electrically trapped ion-nanoparticle systems as a platform for quantum control of levitated matter.
items.abstract_zh: 对悬浮纳米颗粒的量子控制为实现宏观量子态提供了一条途径。本文提出一种新方法：在将纳米颗粒电悬浮于线性 Paul 阱中并与单个离子共存的系统中实现量子控制，该系统最近已在实验上实现。通过适当设计阱的交流电势，可以参数化调制离子-纳米颗粒距离，从而调制库仑耦合以实现共振相互作用。对于现实参数，我们计算得出，这可通过单个连续激光冷却的离子将纳米颗粒协同冷却至其运动基态。额外的交流驱动可实现纳米颗粒压缩态的制备以及离子-纳米颗粒纠缠。此外，利用标准囚禁离子技术在离子中制备的非高斯态（如 Fock 态和猫态）可以高保真度转移至纳米颗粒。我们为每种态提供了完整协议，包括所有已知退相干源。我们的结果确立电囚禁离子-纳米颗粒系统作为悬浮物质量子控制的平台。

items.title_en: PepDeTech: Anonymous Occupancy Monitoring on a Battery-Powered 2.3k-Zone dToF LiDAR Node with On-Chip Processing and Bluetooth LE Reporting
items.title_zh: PepDeTech：在具备片上处理与低功耗蓝牙上报的电池供电 2.3k 区 dToF LiDAR 节点上的匿名占用监测
items.abstract_en: As populations grow, society is increasingly required to shift towards systems of shared resources, which allow space, energy and time to be optimised. Facilitating this transition depends on data: how many people are present, when and where. From such information, schedules can be organised more efficiently and resources allocated where they matter. At the same time, privacy concerns and energy consumption limit deployment: cameras are frequently unacceptable, while simpler sensors miss people and cannot provide the full picture. This paper presents PepDeTech, a compact, battery-powered occupancy node that combines a 54 x 42-zone direct Time-of-Flight (dToF) Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) (VL53L9CX) with a Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) System on Chip (SoC). Three deterministic algorithms, background subtraction, motion history and a track lifecycle, run on-chip and count the people simultaneously, providing real-time occupancy monitoring. No trained model is involved, and setup takes less than a minute. Over three scenarios, background subtraction reaches a per-frame +-1-person accuracy of 83.6 % (mean absolute error (MAE) 0.70 persons), tested with up to five people present. At a 30 s interval the node draws only 3.1 mW, lasting 60 d on a 1200 mA h cell. Several weeks of deployment on a single charge make the node usable as a survey instrument for facility management: a room can be characterised for a measurement campaign without cabling, network provisioning or a camera, and the resulting occupancy record is what ventilation, lighting, cleaning and space-allocation decisions are argued from, ultimately resulting in more efficient resource allocation.
items.abstract_zh: 随着人口增长，社会越来越需要转向共享资源系统，以优化空间、能源和时间。促进这一转变依赖于数据：有多少人存在、何时存在以及在哪里存在。基于这些信息，可以更高效地组织日程，并将资源分配到重要之处。同时，隐私问题和能耗限制了部署：摄像头常常不可接受，而更简单的传感器会漏检人员且无法提供完整图景。本文提出 PepDeTech，一种紧凑的电池供电占用监测节点，将 54 x 42 区直接飞行时间（dToF）激光探测与测距（LiDAR）（VL53L9CX）与低功耗蓝牙（BLE）片上系统（SoC）相结合。三种确定性算法——背景减除、运动历史和轨迹生命周期——在片上运行并同时计数人员，提供实时占用监测。不涉及训练模型，设置耗时不到一分钟。在三个场景中，背景减除在最多五人存在时达到每帧 ±1 人的 83.6% 准确率（平均绝对误差（MAE）0.70 人）。在 30 秒间隔下，该节点仅消耗 3.1 mW，在 1200 mA h 电池上可持续 60 天。单次充电可部署数周，使该节点可用作设施管理的调查工具：无需布线、网络配置或摄像头，即可为测量活动表征房间，而所得的占用记录正是通风、照明、清洁和空间分配决策的依据，最终实现更高效的资源分配。

items.title_en: Efficient Natural Language to Temporal Logic Translation for Real-Time Physical AI
items.title_zh: 面向实时物理 AI 的高效自然语言到时序逻辑翻译
items.abstract_en: Robots can be controlled to perform tasks with guaranteed correctness when the task instructions are stated in a formal language. Large language models (LLMs) have been widely used to allow users to provide such instructions in natural language (NL), by translating NL into formal language. When deploying such translators on a robot, however, we face limited computing and energy resources, while offloading computation or data to the cloud may be infeasible or undesirable. Yet an LLM is a general-purpose text generator, whereas a formula in a fixed formal language fragment follows a well-defined syntax. We therefore ask whether text generation is needed at all. For the formal language of linear temporal logic (LTL), we show that this translation can instead be broken down into answering a set of questions with pre-defined answers. We then construct a System-One model, a recent class of NL-based classifier, to provide such answers and enable us to translate a natural language instruction into an LTL instruction. On three benchmarks, our translator matches or exceeds the accuracy of the best local LLMs available, at up to one order of magnitude lower runtime and energy consumption. We show that it generalizes to unseen atomic propositions and temporal patterns.
items.abstract_zh: 当任务指令以形式语言表述时，机器人可以被控制以执行具有正确性保证的任务。大语言模型（LLM）已被广泛用于让用户以自然语言（NL）提供此类指令，方法是将 NL 翻译为形式语言。然而，在机器人上部署此类翻译器时，我们面临有限的计算和能源资源，而将计算或数据卸载到云端可能不可行或不可取。此外，LLM 是通用文本生成器，而固定形式语言片段中的公式遵循明确定义的语法。因此，我们追问是否根本需要文本生成。对于线性时序逻辑（LTL）这一形式语言，我们表明这种翻译可以分解为回答一组具有预定义答案的问题。然后，我们构建 System-One 模型——一类近期基于 NL 的分类器——来提供此类答案，并使我们能够将自然语言指令翻译为 LTL 指令。在三个基准上，我们的翻译器达到或超过现有最佳本地 LLM 的准确率，同时运行时间和能耗最多低一个数量级。我们表明它可以泛化到未见过的原子命题和时序模式。

items.title_en: Joint Optimization of Fleet Size, Localization Infrastructure, and Trajectories for Multi-AUV Persistent Monitoring
items.title_zh: 面向多 AUV 持续监测的舰队规模、定位基础设施与轨迹联合优化
items.abstract_en: Persistent monitoring of large-scale subsea infrastructure, such as offshore wind farm foundations, export cables, and inspection corridors, remains a fundamental challenge for autonomous underwater systems. The problem is not solely spatial coverage, but rather temporal coverage: ensuring that all relevant regions of interest are revisited within bounded time intervals under limited sensing, navigation uncertainty, and constrained vehicle resources. We compare three classes of trajectory strategies: (1) deterministic lane-based coverage (lawnmower patterns), (2) stochastic exploration (biased random walk with boundary constraints), and (3) coordinated partition-based strategies (Voronoi tessellation). Rather than seeking a universally superior method, we evaluate how varying levels of localization accuracy impact temporal coverage across two distinct operational profiles: persistent monitoring of the entire operational workspace versus targeted inspection of critical infrastructure. We present a simulation-based, quantitatively grounded study of temporal coverage in multi-AUV persistent monitoring, disentangling three interacting design dimensions: (i) trajectory generation strategy, (ii) fleet size, and (iii) localization accuracy provided by fixed acoustic beacon infrastructure. We introduce a cost-aware evaluation framework combining fleet size, number of beacons, and mission energy expenditure into a unified cost function. Results demonstrate that beyond a certain accuracy threshold, improvements in localization yield diminishing returns compared to coordinated trajectory design, an effect often obscured in integrated navigation-planning approaches. Coordinated-partition trajectories enable a reduced fleet size to achieve superior temporal coverage at a 39-46% lower overall life-cycle cost than rigid deterministic paths unoptimized for the localization infrastructure.
items.abstract_zh: 对大规模海底基础设施（如海上风电场基础、输出电缆和检查走廊）的持续监测，仍是自主水下系统的一项基本挑战。问题不仅是空间覆盖，更是时间覆盖：在有限感知、导航不确定性和受限载具资源下，确保所有相关感兴趣区域在有界时间间隔内被重新访问。我们比较三类轨迹策略：（1）确定性车道式覆盖（割草机模式），（2）随机探索（带边界约束的偏置随机游走），以及（3）协调分区式策略（Voronoi 划分）。我们不寻求普遍优越的方法，而是评估在不同定位精度水平下，对两种不同操作模式的时间覆盖影响：对整个操作工作空间的持续监测与对关键基础设施的定向检查。我们提出一项基于仿真的、定量有据的多 AUV 持续监测时间覆盖研究，厘清三个相互作用的设计维度：（i）轨迹生成策略，（ii）舰队规模，以及（iii）固定声学信标基础设施提供的定位精度。我们引入一个成本感知评估框架，将舰队规模、信标数量和任务能耗结合为统一成本函数。结果表明，超过某一精度阈值后，与协调轨迹设计相比，定位改进带来的收益递减，这种效应在集成导航-规划方法中常被掩盖。与未针对定位基础设施优化的刚性确定性路径相比，协调分区轨迹使缩减的舰队规模能够实现更优的时间覆盖，且总体全生命周期成本低 39-46%。

items.title_en: Non-penetrating World Models
items.title_zh: 非穿透世界模型
items.abstract_en: We study a new problem of preventing object penetration in interactive video world models. To understand how existing models handle this, we introduce NoPeBench, a benchmark that evaluates how world models respond to physical obstacles. Our evaluation reveals that none of the open-source models can reliably prevent such failures. Surprisingly, however, these models already encode the information needed to predict such violations. We find that the hidden states of diffusion transformers (DiTs) can predict whether a candidate action will penetrate an obstacle. Building on this, we introduce NoPeWorld, a lightweight framework that detects and prevents penetration. Specifically, we train a small prediction head on top of a frozen DiT's hidden states to read out if a candidate action is safe or not. Unsafe actions are then replaced with safe ones that best preserve the original intent. Despite its simplicity, NoPeWorld substantially reduces the physical violation rate, averaged over six video world models, from 74% to 16%. Remarkably, our method shows zero-shot generalization to open-domain imagery, third-person viewpoints, and moving obstacles. We publicly release our code, the NoPeBench benchmark, and model weights. Project Page: https://nopeworld.github.io .
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个防止交互式视频世界模型中物体穿透的新问题。为理解现有模型如何处理该问题，我们提出 NoPeBench，一个评估世界模型如何响应物理障碍的基准。我们的评估表明，没有任何开源模型能够可靠地防止此类失败。然而令人意外的是，这些模型已经编码了预测此类违规所需的信息。我们发现扩散变换器（DiTs）的隐藏状态可以预测候选动作是否会穿透障碍物。基于此，我们提出 NoPeWorld，一个检测并防止穿透的轻量级框架。具体而言，我们在冻结的 DiT 隐藏状态之上训练一个小型预测头，以读出候选动作是否安全。然后，将不安全动作替换为最能保留原始意图的安全动作。尽管方法简单，NoPeWorld 在六个视频世界模型上平均将物理违规率从 74% 大幅降至 16%。值得注意的是，我们的方法展现出对开放域图像、第三人称视角和移动障碍物的零样本泛化能力。我们公开代码、NoPeBench 基准和模型权重。项目页面：https://nopeworld.github.io 。

items.title_en: The Barcode Inference Pipeline (BIP): From Sequencer Output to DNA Barcodes
items.title_zh: 条形码推断流程（BIP）：从测序仪输出到 DNA 条形码
items.abstract_en: DNA barcoding involves the recovery of a DNA sequence for a target gene region from its source specimen. This process becomes complex when multiple sequences are recovered from a specimen. This diversity can reflect methodological artifacts (e.g., chimeras, PCR errors, sequencing errors, tag jumps) and real template diversity in the DNA extract (e.g., contamination, endosymbionts, nuclear-mitochondrial pseudogenes (NUMTs), parasites). To support the analysis of sequence data from millions of specimens annually, the Centre for Biodiversity Genomics (CBG) has developed BIP, the Barcode Inference Pipeline. Compatible with all major sequencing platforms, BIP processes fastq files and returns both target DNA barcodes and non-target sequences (NTS). BIP implements filtration, demultiplexing, primer trimming, read denoising, chimera scanning, sequence error correction, operational taxonomic unit (OTU) delineation, OTU taxonomy assignment, and selection of the target barcode. When analysis examines the cytochrome c oxidase 1 (COI) barcode region, BIP assigns each OTU to a Barcode Index Number (BIN) when there is a match. BIP also returns summary files, including a taxonomic assignment for each OTU based on a DNA barcode reference library. We describe BIP's flexibility and structure before demonstrating its functionality by analyzing COI sequence data generated from both nanopore and Illumina platforms, as well as rbcLa and ITS2 data generated from plants, and 18S data generated from arthropods. Because it disambiguates target and non-target sequences, BIP outperforms an alternative pipeline package, ONTbarcoder. To ease access, installation, and functionality, BIP is provided as a Docker container and is also available in the Galaxy toolshed.
items.abstract_zh: DNA 条形码涉及从源标本中恢复目标基因区域的 DNA 序列。当一个标本中恢复出多条序列时，该过程会变得复杂。这种多样性可能反映方法学假象（例如嵌合体、PCR 错误、测序错误、标签跳跃）以及 DNA 提取物中真实的模板多样性（例如污染、内共生体、核线粒体假基因（NUMTs）、寄生虫）。为支持每年分析来自数百万标本的序列数据，生物多样性基因组学中心（CBG）开发了 BIP，即条形码推断流程。BIP 兼容所有主要测序平台，处理 fastq 文件并返回目标 DNA 条形码和非目标序列（NTS）。BIP 实现了过滤、解复用、引物修剪、读段去噪、嵌合体扫描、序列错误校正、操作分类单元（OTU）划分、OTU 分类学分配以及目标条形码选择。当分析检查细胞色素 c 氧化酶 1（COI）条形码区域时，若有匹配，BIP 会将每个 OTU 分配到一个条形码索引号（BIN）。BIP 还返回摘要文件，其中包括基于 DNA 条形码参考库为每个 OTU 给出的分类学分配。我们描述了 BIP 的灵活性和结构，然后通过分析由纳米孔和 Illumina 平台生成的 COI 序列数据，以及来自植物的 rbcLa 和 ITS2 数据、来自节肢动物的 18S 数据，来展示其功能。由于能够区分目标序列和非目标序列，BIP 优于另一种流程软件包 ONTbarcoder。为便于访问、安装和使用，BIP 以 Docker 容器形式提供，也可在 Galaxy toolshed 中获取。

items.title_en: Forbidden T-symmetry breaking in time-dependent non-Hermitian systems with gain and loss
items.title_zh: 含增益与损耗的时间依赖非厄米系统中被禁止的 T 对称性破缺
items.abstract_en: Parity-time ($PT$) symmetry has attracted significant interest in photonics and related fields in recent years. With sufficiently weak gain and loss, these systems typically exhibit entirely real energy levels, with all corresponding wave functions remaining $PT$ symmetric. As the strength of gain and loss increases, complex-conjugate energy levels are expected to emerge, signaling the onset of $PT$ symmetry breaking. Similar properties can be found in non-Hermitian systems with other antilinear symmetries as well, where parity is replaced by another operator such as rotation ($R$) or simply the identity operator, resulting in $RT$-symmetric and $T$-symmetric non-Hermitian systems. In this work, we demonstrate that this typical scenario of non-Hermitian symmetry breaking in a finite Hilbert space is forbidden in a class of time-dependent systems with gain and loss and $T$ symmetry: the system remains in its $T$-symmetric phase as we increase the strength of gain and loss, even when the spatial distribution of gain and loss is random. Furthermore, this behavior is also independent of the duration or period of the temporal modulation. In contrast, this forbidden non-Hermitian symmetry breaking does not occur when the same systems are modified to display $PT$ symmetry instead. Our findings highlight contrasting behaviors in time-dependent and time-independent non-Hermitian systems, creating new possibilities and opportunities for future investigations.
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，宇称-时间（PT）对称性在光子学及相关领域引起了显著兴趣。在增益和损耗足够弱时，这些系统通常表现出完全实数的能级，所有相应的波函数保持 PT 对称。随着增益和损耗强度增加，预期会出现复共轭能级，标志着 PT 对称性破缺的开始。在其他反线性对称性的非厄米系统中也可以发现类似性质，其中宇称被另一个算符（如旋转（R））或简单地被单位算符替代，从而产生 RT 对称和 T 对称的非厄米系统。在本工作中，我们证明：在一类具有增益和损耗且具有 T 对称性的时间依赖系统中，有限希尔伯特空间中这种典型的非厄米对称性破缺情形是被禁止的：随着我们增加增益和损耗的强度，系统仍处于其 T 对称相，即使增益和损耗的空间分布是随机的。此外，这种行为也不依赖于时间调制的持续时间或周期。相比之下，当同一系统被修改为改为显示 PT 对称性时，这种被禁止的非厄米对称性破缺不会发生。我们的发现突出了时间依赖与时间无关非厄米系统中的对比行为，为未来研究创造了新的可能性和机会。

items.title_en: Structural Agreement Indicates Prediction Accuracy For Protein-Ligand Co-Folding
items.title_zh: 结构一致性指示蛋白质-配体共折叠的预测准确性
items.abstract_en: Co-folding models predict the structures of proteins and their bound ligands, but their accuracy varies across targets. Their usefulness therefore depends on knowing which predictions a user can trust. Confidence scores are intended to guide that choice. However, across seven co-folding models, we show that confidence-based selection offers little improvement over choosing a prediction at random. For approximately three-quarters of structures, predictions are either exclusively correct or incorrect, leaving no opportunity for ranking to change the outcome. Moreover, high confidence does not reliably discriminate correct top-ranked predictions from incorrect ones. We find that structural agreement among predictions is a more accurate measure of likely success than current confidence scores. We capture this with the Concentration of Repeated Ensembles (CORE) Score, which combines cluster tightness with ensemble support. CORE Score discriminates top-1 success and oracle success, achieving mean ROC AUCs of 0.866 and 0.838, compared to 0.757 and 0.759 for ipTM. CORE Score also outperforms training set similarity measures, including ligand Tanimoto, protein sequence, and Runs N' Poses similarity, despite requiring no experimental ligand pose. Structural agreement is therefore a practical indicator of reliability and a baseline for evaluating future confidence estimators, without requiring an additional trained uncertainty estimator.
items.abstract_zh: 共折叠模型预测蛋白质及其结合配体的结构，但其准确性因靶标而异。因此，它们的实用性取决于知道哪些预测可供用户信任。置信度分数旨在指导这一选择。然而，在七个共折叠模型中，我们表明基于置信度的选择相比随机选择预测几乎没有改进。对于大约四分之三的结构，预测要么完全正确，要么不正确，没有机会通过排序改变结果。此外，高置信度不能可靠地区分正确的排名第一预测和不正确的预测。我们发现，预测之间的结构一致性比当前置信度分数更准确地衡量可能成功。我们用重复集成集中度（CORE）分数来刻画这一点，该分数结合了聚类紧密度与集成支持度。CORE 分数区分 top-1 成功和 oracle 成功，平均 ROC AUC 分别为 0.866 和 0.838，而 ipTM 为 0.757 和 0.759。CORE 分数也优于训练集相似性度量，包括配体 Tanimoto、蛋白质序列和 Runs N' Poses 相似性，尽管不需要实验配体构象。因此，结构一致性是可靠性的实用指标，也是评估未来置信度估计器的基线，且不需要额外训练的不确定性估计器。

items.title_en: ORBIT: Offset-based Activation Steering for Cross-lingual Multimodal Fact Verification
items.title_zh: ORBIT：基于偏移的激活引导用于跨语言多模态事实核查
items.abstract_en: Multimodal fact verification faces a fundamental accessibility bottleneck: while large proprietary models exhibit cross-lingual robustness, small vision-language models suffer a severe, disproportionate accuracy collapse on low-resource languages. Closing this gap traditionally requires prohibitive scale or extensive language-specific fine-tuning. In this work, we propose Offset Recovery via Bilingual Inference-time Technique (ORBIT), an algorithmic intervention that mitigates this collapse at inference time. ORBIT estimates span-specific offset vectors from parallel claim-evidence instances and applies them to claim and evidence representations, targeting the cross-lingual degradation induced by low-resource evidence. Experiments across 81 configurations reveal that ORBIT substantially recovers both accuracy and F1-score in low-resource settings, exposes calibration offset norms as a diagnostic proxy, and outperforms translation-based and steering baselines.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态事实核查面临一个根本性的可及性瓶颈：大型专有模型表现出跨语言鲁棒性，而小型视觉-语言模型在低资源语言上遭遇严重且不成比例的准确性崩溃。传统上，弥合这一差距需要过大的规模或大量针对特定语言的微调。在本工作中，我们提出通过双语推理时技术的偏移恢复（ORBIT），这是一种在推理时缓解这种崩溃的算法干预。ORBIT 从平行的主张-证据实例中估计片段特定的偏移向量，并将其应用于主张和证据表示，针对由低资源证据引起的跨语言退化。跨 81 种配置的实验表明，ORBIT 在低资源设置中大幅恢复准确性和 F1 分数，揭示校准偏移范数作为诊断代理，并优于基于翻译和激活引导的基线。

items.title_en: Instant-LIVO: Efficient LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry with Compact Geometry and a Bounded Single-Reference-Frame Map
items.title_zh: Instant-LIVO：具有紧凑几何和有界单参考帧地图的高效 LiDAR-惯性-视觉里程计
items.abstract_en: LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry (LIVO) is a fundamental technology for autonomous systems; however, deployment on resource-constrained platforms remains challenging due to physical limitations. This paper presents Instant-LIVO, a tightly coupled, high-speed, real-time LIVO system. The system introduces a compact geometric map based on spatial-hashed OctVox and accelerates local-neighborhood retrieval and plane fitting through cache-assisted heuristic staged K-nearest-neighbor searches. It also employs a bounded single-reference-frame visual map that adaptively updates the reference frame according to the tracking status, while using Schmidt-type uncertainty-aware photometric fusion to maintain the correlation between the reference pose and the current state. The system performs multisensor fusion through a sequential process consisting of IMU prediction, LiDAR geometric correction, and visual photometric correction. It was evaluated on 32 public benchmarks and custom datasets. While maintaining competitive accuracy on both X86 and ARM platforms, Instant-LIVO achieves average processing-speed improvements of approximately 2.3x and 2.1x, respectively, and reduces peak memory usage to approximately 1/20 and 1/13, respectively. The results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing LIO and LIVO baselines in both accuracy and computational efficiency.The implementation is available at: https://github.com/Faker-0714/Instant-LIVO.git.
items.abstract_zh: LiDAR-惯性-视觉里程计（LIVO）是自主系统的一项基础技术；然而，由于物理限制，在资源受限平台上部署仍然具有挑战性。本文提出 Instant-LIVO，一个紧耦合、高速、实时的 LIVO 系统。该系统引入基于空间哈希 OctVox 的紧凑几何地图，并通过缓存辅助的启发式分阶段 K 近邻搜索加速局部邻域检索和平面拟合。它还采用有界单参考帧视觉地图，根据跟踪状态自适应更新参考帧，同时使用施密特型不确定性感知光度融合来保持参考位姿与当前状态之间的相关性。该系统通过由 IMU 预测、LiDAR 几何校正和视觉光度校正组成的顺序过程执行多传感器融合。它在 32 个公开基准和自定义数据集上进行了评估。在 X86 和 ARM 平台上保持有竞争力的准确性的同时，Instant-LIVO 分别实现了约 2.3 倍和 2.1 倍的平均处理速度提升，并将峰值内存使用分别降低到约 1/20 和 1/13。结果表明，所提方法在准确性和计算效率方面均优于现有 LIO 和 LIVO 基线。实现代码见：https://github.com/Faker-0714/Instant-LIVO.git。

items.title_en: Receptor Abundance Alone Underpredicts Red Blood Cell Adhesion in Gaucher Disease
items.title_zh: 仅凭受体丰度会低估戈谢病中的红细胞黏附
items.abstract_en: Red blood cells (RBCs) in Gaucher disease (GD) adhere abnormally to vessel walls and carry more Lutheran/basal cell adhesion molecule (Lu/BCAM), a laminin receptor. Whether receptor abundance sets this adhesion is untested. We simulated RBCs carrying stochastic Lu/BCAM-laminin bonds, calibrated a population on control donors, and predicted GD adhesion from the 1.3-fold receptor rise. On laminin and endothelium the data exceed the prediction 1.6- to 1.7-fold. Matching them requires 2.4- and 4.6-fold more binding-competent receptors, compatible with the estimated 5.7-fold rise in phosphorylated receptors. Neither a stiffer membrane nor higher bond affinity removes the shortfall at high shear stress. In sickle cell disease, given active-receptor counts, the model predicts the fall in adhesion under hydroxyurea within 1.4-fold, while total receptors rise. Adhesion likely follows receptor state more than abundance. Stiffening instead retains cells at a splenic slit.
items.abstract_zh: 戈谢病（GD）中的红细胞（RBC）异常黏附于血管壁，并携带更多 Lutheran/基底细胞黏附分子（Lu/BCAM），一种层粘连蛋白受体。受体丰度是否决定这种黏附尚未经过检验。我们模拟了携带随机 Lu/BCAM-层粘连蛋白键的红细胞，在对照供者上校准了一个群体，并根据受体升高 1.3 倍预测 GD 黏附。在层粘连蛋白和内皮上，数据超出预测 1.6 至 1.7 倍。要使数据匹配，需要多 2.4 倍和 4.6 倍的具有结合能力的受体，这与磷酸化受体估计升高 5.7 倍相符。更硬的膜或更高的键亲和力均不能消除高剪切应力下的差距。在镰状细胞病中，给定活性受体计数，模型对羟基脲治疗下黏附下降的预测误差在 1.4 倍以内，而总受体升高。黏附可能更多取决于受体状态而非丰度。相反，硬化会使细胞滞留在脾裂隙处。

items.title_en: Compensatory Creatine Secretion Protects Against Drug-Induced Liver Injury via Desuccinylation
items.title_zh: 代偿性肌酸分泌通过去琥珀酰化抵御药物性肝损伤
items.abstract_en: ackground and aims: Effective therapeutic interventions for Drug induced liver injury (DILI) remain limited. N-myc downstream regulated gene-1 (NDRG1), a stress-responsive proteins, has an incompletely defined role in acetaminophen-induced liver injury. Method: Wild-type (WT), NDRG1Hep-flox, Hepatocyte-specific NDRG1 conditional knockout mice (NDRG1Hep-KO) were subjected to APAP-induced injury modeling. Liver and blood sample from patient were analyzed. Liver sample of mice subsequently underwent RNA sequencing (RNA-Seq), untargeted metabolomic profiling, single-cell sequencing, succinylation sequencing. For in vitro studies, AML-12 hepatocytes, RAW264.7 macrophages, and bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs), human Monocyte-Derived Macrophages, human hepatocyte organoids were utilized in experiments. Result: NDRG1 was upregulated in mouse and human DILI livers. NDRG1 conditional knockout significantly exacerbates DILI. Mechanistically, NDRG1 inhibited GAMT ubiquitination to enhance creatine production, and hepatocyte?derived creatine attenuated M1 polarization of liver macrophages by suppressing PHB1 succinylation at lysine 128. CXCL2? macrophages were identified as a major subpopulation regulated by NDRG1. Conclusion: Hepatocyte NDRG1 protects against APAP-DILI by driving GAMT-dependent creatine production and PHB1 K128 succinylation-dependent macrophage reprogramming.
items.abstract_zh: 背景与目的：药物性肝损伤（DILI）的有效治疗干预仍然有限。N-myc 下游调节基因-1（NDRG1）是一种应激反应蛋白，其在 APAP 诱导的肝损伤中的作用尚未完全明确。方法：对野生型（WT）、NDRG1Hep-flox、肝细胞特异性 NDRG1 条件性敲除小鼠（NDRG1Hep-KO）进行 APAP 诱导损伤建模。分析患者的肝脏和血液样本。随后对小鼠肝脏样本进行 RNA 测序（RNA-Seq）、非靶向代谢组学分析、单细胞测序、琥珀酰化测序。体外研究使用 AML-12 肝细胞、RAW264.7 巨噬细胞、骨髓来源巨噬细胞（BMDM）、人单核细胞来源巨噬细胞、人肝细胞类器官进行实验。结果：NDRG1 在小鼠和人 DILI 肝脏中上调。NDRG1 条件性敲除显著加重 DILI。机制上，NDRG1 抑制 GAMT 泛素化以增强肌酸生成，肝细胞来源的肌酸通过抑制 PHB1 赖氨酸 128 位点的琥珀酰化来减弱肝脏巨噬细胞的 M1 极化。CXCL2? 巨噬细胞被鉴定为受 NDRG1 调节的主要亚群。结论：肝细胞 NDRG1 通过驱动 GAMT 依赖性肌酸生成和 PHB1 K128 琥珀酰化依赖性巨噬细胞重编程，保护免受 APAP-DILI。

items.title_en: Adaptive-Optics-Aware Uplink and Downlink Analysis of Ground-to-HAPS FSO Links
items.title_zh: 面向地面到高空平台站（HAPS）自由空间光（FSO）链路的自适应光学感知上行与下行分析
items.abstract_en: In this paper, we present an adaptive optics (AO)-aware analytical framework for ground-to- high-altitude platform station (HAPS) free-space optical (FSO) links considering both uplink (UL) and downlink (DL) transmission. The proposed model combines atmospheric attenuation, Exponentiated Weibull (EW) turbulence, Beckmann-type pointing error (PE), and field-of-view (FoV)-limited angle-of-arrival (AOA) loss. Adaptive optics correction (AOC) is incorporated through the number of corrected modes, allowing the impact of partial and stronger wavefront compensation to be directly reflected in the channel statistics. Analytical and numerically tractable expressions are derived for the outage probability (OP), average bit-error rate (BER), and an ergodic achievable-rate lower bound (EALB) optical channel. High signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) approximations are also developed, showing that AOA/FoV blocking introduces irreducible OP and BER floors, while the decaying nonblocked component is governed by the small-channel-gain behavior of the turbulence and PE distributions. Numerical results demonstrate that the DL generally outperforms the UL because of the direction-dependent interaction with near-ground turbulence. The results also show that increasing the number of AOC modes improves OP, BER, and the EALB, although the improvement gradually saturates. The effects of average SNR, HAPS altitude, zenith angle, beam waist, boresight error, and receiver FoV are further investigated to provide practical design insight for AO-assisted ground-to-HAPS FSO systems.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个考虑上行（UL）和下行（DL）传输的自适应光学（AO）感知分析框架，用于地面到高空平台站（HAPS）自由空间光（FSO）链路。所提模型结合了大气衰减、指数化 Weibull（EW）湍流、Beckmann 型指向误差（PE）以及视场（FoV）受限的到达角（AOA）损耗。自适应光学校正（AOC）通过校正模式数纳入，使部分和更强波前补偿的影响直接反映在信道统计中。针对中断概率（OP）、平均误码率（BER）和遍历可达速率下界（EALB）光信道，推导了解析且数值可处理的表达式。还建立了高信噪比（SNR）近似，表明 AOA/FoV 阻塞会引入不可约的 OP 和 BER 下限，而衰减的非阻塞分量由湍流和 PE 分布的小信道增益行为决定。数值结果表明，由于与近地湍流相互作用的的方向依赖性，DL 通常优于 UL。结果还表明，增加 AOC 模式数可改善 OP、BER 和 EALB，但改善逐渐饱和。进一步研究平均 SNR、HAPS 高度、天顶角、束腰、视轴误差和接收机 FoV 的影响，为 AO 辅助地面到 HAPS FSO 系统提供实际设计见解。

items.title_en: 20 GHz Longitudinal Surface Acoustic Wave Resonators in 100-nm X-Cut Lithium Niobate on Silicon Carbide
items.title_zh: 100 nm X 切铌酸锂/碳化硅上的 20 GHz 纵向声表面波谐振器
items.abstract_en: Surface acoustic wave (SAW) resonators above 15~GHz require a fast acoustic mode that retains strong electromechanical coupling ($k^2$). This work reports longitudinal SAW (L-SAW) resonators designed for high $k^2$ in 100-nm X-cut lithium niobate (LN) on 4H silicon carbide (SiC), operating up to 21.7~GHz and reaching a $k^2$ of 8.1\%, a maximum Bode $Q$ of 70, and a figure of merit (FoM) of 5.7 at 20.24~GHz. In this thin-film waveguide, shrinking the wavelength ($λ$) keeps the normalized LN thickness ($h_\mathrm{LN}/λ$) large, sustaining both $k^2$ and acoustic confinement. Conversely, increasing $λ$ from 292 to 471~nm lowers $h_\mathrm{LN}/λ$ from 0.34 to 0.21 and raises the L-SAW phase velocity from 6.32 to 7.05~km/s, within 1.1\% of the 7126-m/s shear-wave velocity of 4H-SiC. As the velocity approaches this limit, more of the acoustic energy spreads into the non-piezoelectric SiC, and $k^2$ falls from its 8.1\% peak at $λ= 322$~nm to 1.7\% at $λ= 471$~nm. No L-SAW resonance is observed for $λ\geq 518$~nm ($h_\mathrm{LN}/λ\leq 0.19$), where the mode becomes leaky. Overall, the FoM stays within 5\% of its maximum for $h_\mathrm{LN}/λ$ between 0.26 to 0.31, defining a design window for L-SAW resonators in thin LN on SiC at K-band and beyond.
items.abstract_zh: 15 GHz 以上的声表面波（SAW）谐振器需要一种快速声学模式，同时保持强机电耦合（k^2）。本工作报道了在 100 nm X 切铌酸锂（LN）/4H 碳化硅（SiC）上为高 k^2 设计的纵向 SAW（L-SAW）谐振器，工作频率高达 21.7 GHz，在 20.24 GHz 时达到 8.1% 的 k^2、最大 Bode Q 为 70、品质因数（FoM）为 5.7。在这种薄膜波导中，缩小波长（λ）可使归一化 LN 厚度（h_LN/λ）保持较大，从而维持 k^2 和声学限制。相反，将 λ 从 292 nm 增加到 471 nm，会使 h_LN/λ 从 0.34 降至 0.21，并将 L-SAW 相速度从 6.32 km/s 提高到 7.05 km/s，与 4H-SiC 的 7126 m/s 剪切波速度相差在 1.1% 以内。当速度接近该极限时，更多声能扩散到非压电 SiC 中，k^2 从 λ = 322 nm 处的 8.1% 峰值降至 λ = 471 nm 处的 1.7%。对于 λ ≥ 518 nm（h_LN/λ ≤ 0.19），未观察到 L-SAW 共振，此时模式变为泄漏模式。总体而言，当 h_LN/λ 在 0.26 至 0.31 之间时，FoM 保持在其最大值的 5% 以内，这为 K 波段及以上的薄膜 LN/SiC L-SAW 谐振器定义了一个设计窗口。

items.title_en: How Far Does Lossless Re-tokenization Move an RLVR Update?
items.title_zh: 无损重分词会使 RLVR 更新偏移多远？
items.abstract_en: Language models assign different probabilities to token sequences that decode to the same string. In reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), a trainer that re-encodes sampled text may train on a different token sequence with the same reward. We ask how far this moves a training update, and whether the movement has a consistent direction. From one checkpoint, we compare updates on the same rollouts, canonical and with selected tokens split into two pieces, against an update on a different batch. On Qwen2.5-0.5B with three-digit addition, splitting about one token in 25 moves the update 0.556 times as far as replacing the batch. The ratio rises with the fraction split in four models and depends on which tokens are split; within a checkpoint, the displacements share a direction across batches. In a tabular model with one table per tokenization and a single sampled string, we prove that whenever two strings below an unsampled prefix differ in probability, only the zero full-gradient step agrees across tokenizations, however it is weighted. In an audit that decodes and re-encodes resampled rollouts, re-encoding touches up to 5.2% of rollouts but at most 0.08% of tokens, far below the split fractions we test. Training on fixed rollouts, the canonical arm finishes ahead in 14 of 18 pre-registered pairs; the interval for the mean accuracy difference includes zero over all pairs and excludes it only under the registered exclusion rule, which favours the canonical arm.
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型对解码为同一字符串的不同词元序列赋予不同概率。在基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，对采样文本重新编码的训练器可能会在同一奖励下训练不同的词元序列。我们研究这会使一次训练更新偏移多远，以及这种偏移是否具有一致方向。从一个检查点出发，我们比较同一批 rollout 上的更新——规范分词以及将选定词元拆分为两个片段——与在不同批次上的更新。在 Qwen2.5-0.5B 上使用三位数加法，拆分约每 25 个词元中的 1 个，使更新的偏移距离达到替换批次的 0.556 倍。该比例在四个模型中随拆分比例上升，并取决于拆分哪些词元；在一个检查点内，不同批次间的位移共享同一方向。在一个表格模型中，每种分词对应一张表，且只采样一个字符串，我们证明：只要未采样前缀之下的两个字符串概率不同，无论权重如何，只有零全梯度步在不同分词间一致。在一项对重采样 rollout 解码并重新编码的审计中，重新编码触及最多 5.2% 的 rollout，但最多触及 0.08% 的词元，远低于我们测试的拆分比例。在固定 rollout 上训练时，规范臂在 18 个预注册配对中的 14 个中最终领先；平均准确率差的区间在所有配对中包含零，仅在注册排除规则下排除零，而该规则有利于规范臂。

items.title_en: AnyBodyCodec: A Shared Native Interface for Body-Model Conversion, Extension, and Humanoid Control
items.title_zh: AnyBodyCodec：用于身体模型转换、扩展和人形控制的共享原生接口
items.abstract_en: Parametric body models expose incompatible pose and shape controls, tying humanoid policies to particular input formats. AnyBodyCodec learns a shared representation through native conversion, then reuses it for new body models and control with its core frozen. Encoders map MHR, SMPL-X, and SOMA to aligned slots; native decoders recover target controls. The 1.090M-parameter converter covers nine routes and reaches 16.801 mm input-reference MPJPE across six cross routes: the 2.887M Transformer bank reaches 16.390 mm and its parameter-matched version 18.866 mm. Three measured routes take 7.43-7.67 ms on an RTX 4090. Adding ANNY shows that comparable conversion accuracy can accompany different action consistency under one frozen controller. Under a matched PPO budget, aligned slots support 60.78% full-action success across three formats. Separate 160-hour training reaches 66.10% source-weighted validation success, and the controller is deployed qualitatively on a physical G1 through three visual front ends. Together, these results establish reuse through both native geometric fidelity and downstream policy compatibility.
items.abstract_zh: 参数化身体模型暴露不兼容的姿态和形状控制，使人形策略绑定于特定输入格式。AnyBodyCodec 通过学习原生转换获得共享表示，然后在其核心冻结的情况下将其复用于新的身体模型和控制。编码器将 MHR、SMPL-X 和 SOMA 映射到对齐槽位；原生解码器恢复目标控制。1.090M 参数的转换器覆盖九条路由，在六条跨路由上达到 16.801 mm 的输入参考 MPJPE：2.887M 的 Transformer 组达到 16.390 mm，其参数匹配版本达到 18.866 mm。三条实测路由在 RTX 4090 上耗时 7.43–7.67 ms。加入 ANNY 表明，在一个冻结控制器下，可比的转换精度可以伴随不同的动作一致性。在匹配的 PPO 预算下，对齐槽位在三种格式上支持 60.78% 的全动作成功率。单独的 160 小时训练达到 66.10% 的源加权验证成功率，并且控制器通过三个视觉前端在物理 G1 上进行定性部署。总之，这些结果通过原生几何保真度和下游策略兼容性两方面确立了复用。

items.title_en: Points, Not Pixels: Keypoints, Masks and Oblique Geometry for Floating-Roof Tank Fill Estimation from Overhead Imagery
items.title_zh: 点而非像素：基于关键点、掩膜与斜视几何的俯视影像浮顶储罐充满度估计
items.abstract_en: The floating roof of an oil storage tank rests on the stored liquid, so its depth below the rim measures how full the tank is. In optical overhead imagery, this depth appears only as the crescent shadow the rim casts on the roof, often a few pixels wide. Thin shadows are difficult to measure at overhead-image resolution, and nadir-based height conversions introduce errors in oblique views. Under a local affine camera, roof depth determines the rim-to-shadow displacement through the sun and camera geometry. We regress the boundaries as sub-pixel keypoints and invert this relation with a closed-form estimator that models oblique views. Available public tank datasets do not label roof position, so we introduce SynTank-25k, 24,987 physically based renders with exact roof, shadow and camera geometry. Using the oblique estimator, the keypoint pipeline reduces fill error by $22\%$ relative to the segmentation baseline on SynTank-25k. On shadows narrower than $6\text{ px}$, its error is also lower than that obtained by converting true binary masks. Our oblique estimator reduces the error of the nadir formula elevenfold at the steepest views. On 6,558 real NAIP tank crops defined by bounding boxes, about half of the fill estimates pass internal consistency checks; NAIP has no fill labels. Data and code will be released.
items.abstract_zh: 浮顶储罐的浮顶浮于储存液体之上，因此其低于罐缘的深度可衡量储罐的充满程度。在光学俯视影像中，该深度仅表现为罐缘投射在浮顶上的月牙形阴影，通常只有几个像素宽。细窄阴影在俯视影像分辨率下难以测量，而基于星下点的高度换算在斜视视角下会引入误差。在局部仿射相机模型下，浮顶深度通过太阳与相机几何决定罐缘到阴影的位移。我们将边界回归为亚像素关键点，并用一个对斜视视角建模的闭式估计器反演该关系。现有公开储罐数据集未标注浮顶位置，因此我们引入 SynTank-25k，包含 24,987 幅基于物理的渲染图，具有精确的浮顶、阴影和相机几何。在 SynTank-25k 上，使用斜视估计器时，关键点流程相对于分割基线将充满度误差降低 $22\%$。对于窄于 $6\text{ px}$ 的阴影，其误差也低于通过转换真实二值掩膜得到的误差。在最陡视角下，我们的斜视估计器将星下点公式的误差降至十一分之一。在由边界框定义的 6,558 个真实 NAIP 储罐裁剪图上，约一半的充满度估计通过内部一致性检查；NAIP 没有充满度标签。数据和代码将发布。

items.title_en: APOBEC3 Activation Drives Epitranscriptomic Remodeling and Clonal Hematopoiesis
items.title_zh: APOBEC3 激活驱动表观转录组重塑与克隆性造血
items.abstract_en: Stress and inflammatory cytokine-inducible APOBEC3 (A3) enzymes promote clonal evolution in many malignancies. We identified A3C overexpression in hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) following spaceflight-associated accelerated aging and in precancer myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPNs). However, the role of A3 in age-associated clonal hematopoiesis (CH) and precancer initiation remains unclear. To investigate the functional hierarchy among A3 enzymes, we performed lentiviral A3B, A3C, A3D, A3F, and A3G overexpression, whole genome, whole transcriptome and single-cell RNA sequencing analyses, and functional HSPC assays. While A3C and A3F induced more C-to-T DNA mutations; A3B, A3C, and A3G deregulated RNA splicing; and all A3 enzymes induced C-to-U RNA edits in HSPCs. In aged HSPCs, A3C overexpression enhanced replating and myeloid lineage skewing in humanized inflammatory niche mouse models typical of CH. Moreover, A3C-induced editing of CH-associated transcripts distinguished MPN from normal HSPCs. Thus, future strategies focused on APOBEC3C inhibition may prevent CH and precancer initiation.
items.abstract_zh: 应激和炎症细胞因子可诱导的 APOBEC3（A3）酶在许多恶性肿瘤中促进克隆演化。我们在太空飞行相关加速衰老后的造血干/祖细胞（HSPC）以及癌前骨髓增殖性肿瘤（MPN）中鉴定到 A3C 过表达。然而，A3 在年龄相关克隆性造血（CH）和癌前起始中的作用仍不清楚。为研究 A3 酶之间的功能层级，我们进行了慢病毒介导的 A3B、A3C、A3D、A3F 和 A3G 过表达、全基因组、全转录组和单细胞 RNA 测序分析，以及功能性 HSPC 实验。其中，A3C 和 A3F 诱导更多 C-to-T DNA 突变；A3B、A3C 和 A3G 使 RNA 剪接失调；所有 A3 酶均在 HSPC 中诱导 C-to-U RNA 编辑。在衰老 HSPC 中，A3C 过表达在人源化炎症微环境小鼠模型中增强了再铺板能力和髓系谱系偏斜，这是 CH 的典型特征。此外，A3C 诱导的 CH 相关转录本编辑可将 MPN 与正常 HSPC 区分开。因此，未来以抑制 APOBEC3C 为重点的策略可能预防 CH 和癌前起始。

items.title_en: Actively stabilized Fabry-Pérot notch filters for correlated photons from cold two-level atoms
items.title_zh: 用于冷二能级原子产生的相关光子的主动稳定法布里-珀罗陷波滤波器
items.abstract_en: We report two actively stabilized Fabry-Pérot cavities operated as reflection-mode notch filters for biphotons generated by spontaneous four-wave mixing in a cold two-level atomic ensemble. In this source, elastic scattering at the excitation frequency increases the single-detector count rates and the accidental-coincidence background, thereby limiting the observed nonclassical correlations. One cavity is placed in each photon-collection mode. An acousto-optic modulator frequency-dithers an auxiliary field, and synchronous demodulation of the transmitted power provides the locking discriminator. Light resonant with the auxiliary field is transmitted, whereas the detuned components are reflected toward the photon detectors. By tuning the auxiliary field to the same frequency as the excitation field, we filter these components and direct a larger portion of the quantum-correlated sidebands to the detection. The cavities have linewidths of approximately 2 MHz and remain locked for longer than a typical correlation acquisition. The measured Cauchy-Schwarz parameter exceeds unity in both configurations, with a higher central value with filtering ($\overline{R} = 4.15 \pm 0.93$) than without ($\overline{R} = 2.33 \pm 0.20$). This architecture provides actively stabilized rejection of a narrow spectral interval, simultaneously, for two fields detected in different directions. Filter performance could be further improved by adjusting the cavity linewidth to better match the spectral width of the central component and by reducing losses in the filters.
items.abstract_zh: 我们报道了两个主动稳定的法布里-珀罗腔，将其用作反射模式陷波滤波器，用于冷二能级原子系综中自发四波混频产生的双光子。在该光源中，激发频率处的弹性散射增加了单探测器计数率和偶然符合背景，从而限制了观测到的非经典关联。每个光子收集模式中放置一个腔。声光调制器对辅助光场进行频率抖动，对透射功率进行同步解调可提供锁定鉴频信号。与辅助场共振的光被透射，而失谐分量被反射向光子探测器。通过将辅助场调谐到与激发场相同的频率，我们滤除这些分量，并将更大比例的量子相关边带引导至探测端。这些腔的线宽约为 2 MHz，并能在长于典型关联采集的时间内保持锁定。在两种配置下测得的 Cauchy-Schwarz 参数均超过 1，且带滤波时的中心值（$\overline{R} = 4.15 \pm 0.93$）高于不带滤波时（$\overline{R} = 2.33 \pm 0.20$）。该架构可对沿不同方向探测的两个场同时实现窄光谱区间的主动稳定抑制。通过调整腔线宽以更好地匹配中心分量的光谱宽度，并降低滤波器损耗，滤波性能可进一步提高。

items.title_en: Optimal Linear Regression Without a Variance
items.title_zh: 无方差条件下的最优线性回归
items.abstract_en: We study high-probability linear regression in the infinite variance regime, wherecthe regression noise has only a finite conditional $α$-moment $ν$ for some unknown $α\in(1,2)$, and the covariates may only have finite moments up to a given order (e.g., 4th moment). We give a black-box reduction that converts finite-variance regression procedures into weak-moment procedures. The reduction is based on empirical residual pruning and is agnostic to the moment exponent, the noise scale, the covariance, and the design moment. Under a finite fourth-moment condition on the covariates, any finite-variance subroutine attaining the sub-Gaussian rate yields the following when the number of samples $n$ is above a suitably defined threshold: Without knowing $α$ or $ν$, we have with probability at least $1-δ$ that $ \|\widehatθ-θ^*\|_Σ \lesssim_α ν^{1/α} \big(\frac{d+\log(1/δ)}{n}\big)^{\frac{α-1}α}, $ where $d$ is the dimension, $Σ$ is the covariate covariance matrix, and $\|v\|_Σ:=(v^\topΣv)^{1/2}$. We further prove a matching minimax lower bound that holds under the same conditions. The reduction is computationally efficient whenever the finite-variance subroutine is. We also obtain a distribution-free prediction guarantee under a bounded raw $α$-moment assumption on the response, and give an analogous $α$-agnostic reduction for mean estimation.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究无限方差情形下的高概率线性回归，其中回归噪声仅具有有限的条件 $α$-矩 $ν$，$α\in(1,2)$ 未知，且协变量可能仅具有直到给定阶数（例如四阶矩）的有限矩。我们给出一种黑盒归约，将有限方差回归流程转化为弱矩流程。该归约基于经验残差剪枝，并且对矩指数、噪声尺度、协方差和设计矩均不敏感。在协变量满足有限四阶矩条件下，当样本数 $n$ 高于适当定义的阈值时，任何达到次高斯速率的有限方差子程序可给出如下结果：在不知道 $α$ 或 $ν$ 的情况下，以至少 $1-δ$ 的概率有 $ \|\widehatθ-θ^*\|_Σ \lesssim_α ν^{1/α} \big(\frac{d+\log(1/δ)}{n}\big)^{\frac{α-1}α}, $ 其中 $d$ 为维数，$Σ$ 为协变量协方差矩阵，且 $\|v\|_Σ:=(v^\topΣv)^{1/2}$。我们进一步证明在相同条件下成立的匹配极小极大下界。只要有限方差子程序计算高效，该归约也计算高效。我们还在响应变量具有有界原始 $α$-矩假设下获得无分布预测保证，并给出用于均值估计的类似 $α$-不可知归约。

items.title_en: Modeling Attributional Style at Scale: A Dataset and Analysis for Psychological Attribution Assessment and Reframing
items.title_zh: 大规模建模归因风格：面向心理归因评估与重构的数据集与分析
items.abstract_en: According to the reformulated Learned Helplessness theory, repeated exposure to uncontrollable negative events can foster a depressogenic attributional style, increasing susceptibility to depression yet remaining a tractable target for cognitive therapy. Computational research on attributional cognition, however, is hampered by the lack of large-scale datasets and robust evaluation protocols. In this work, we introduce the Attributional Style Transfer Dataset (ASTD) along with dedicated evaluation metrics, the first benchmark designed to model, assess, and reframe attributional explanations at scale. Constructed via a Prevent-Filter-Validate pipeline that integrates LLM-based generation with specialist validation, ASTD contains 42,000 real-world events paired with psychologically grounded attributions spanning seven styles. Using this dataset, we address two key challenges: (1) scalable assessment of attributional style via both supervised classifiers and zero/few-shot LLMs; and (2) attributional reframing and evaluation, where we propose automatic evaluation metrics to quantify psychological validity. Furthermore, we leverage our proposed metrics to construct a preference dataset, fine-tuning LLMs with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and achieving substantial gains in reframing quality. Together, our dataset, metrics, and methodology offer a new paradigm for understanding and modeling attributional style, with direct implications for scalable and adaptive mental health interventions. Code and data: https://github.com/qzhou711/ASTD
items.abstract_zh: 根据重构的习得性无助理论，反复暴露于不可控负性事件会促成抑郁性归因风格，增加抑郁易感性，但它仍是认知治疗可处理的目标。然而，归因认知的计算研究受限于缺乏大规模数据集和稳健的评估协议。在本工作中，我们引入归因风格迁移数据集（ASTD）及专用评估指标，这是首个旨在大规模建模、评估和重构归因解释的基准。ASTD 通过集成基于 LLM 的生成与专家验证的 Prevent-Filter-Validate 流程构建，包含 42,000 个真实世界事件，并配以涵盖七种风格的、具有心理学依据的归因。使用该数据集，我们应对两个关键挑战：（1）通过监督分类器和零/少样本 LLM 对归因风格进行可扩展评估；（2）归因重构与评估，其中我们提出自动评估指标以量化心理有效性。此外，我们利用所提出的指标构建偏好数据集，使用直接偏好优化（DPO）微调 LLM，并在重构质量上取得显著提升。总之，我们的数据集、指标和方法为理解和建模归因风格提供了新范式，并对可扩展和自适应心理健康干预具有直接意义。代码和数据：https://github.com/qzhou711/ASTD

items.title_en: Beyond Future Views: Exploring Future-State World Models for Vision-Language Navigation
items.title_zh: 超越未来视图：探索用于视觉语言导航的未来状态世界模型
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language Navigation(VLN) requires an embodied agent to follow language instructions through unseen 3D environments, where the target spaces often lie beyond the current observation. Navigation world models address this challenge by predicting future views either as pixels or latent representations, providing valuable look-ahead information for action decision. Both paradigms define the future primarily through what the agent may observe, raising a fundamental question: is predicting future views the ultimate form to represent the future for VLN? Cognitive studies show that the human hippocampus prospectively represents both future goals and intervening locations along planned routes. Inspired by this predictive-map view, we organize the navigation-relevant future around goal-directed spatial states and route structure. We instantiate this perspective with two complementary abstractions: a short-horizon waypoint that specifies the next local state to reach, and a mid-horizon corridor that captures the spatial support of the upcoming route. Based on this design, we propose FS-Nav, a future-state world modeling framework that predicts waypoint-corridor states from spatial memory and language instructions, and communicates them to a VLM navigator through top-down and first-person interfaces. Experiments on standard VLN benchmarks demonstrate that FS-Nav achieves state-of-the-art performance. This highlights navigation-relevant future-state modeling as a promising direction for representing the future in VLN.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言导航（VLN）要求具身智能体在未见过的 3D 环境中遵循语言指令，而目标空间通常位于当前观测之外。导航世界模型通过将未来视图预测为像素或潜在表示来应对这一挑战，为动作决策提供有价值的预见信息。两种范式主要都通过智能体可能观察到什么来定义未来，这引出一个基本问题：预测未来视图是否是 VLN 中表示未来的最终形式？认知研究表明，人类海马体前瞻性地表示未来目标以及规划路线上的中间位置。受这种预测地图观点启发，我们围绕目标导向的空间状态和路线结构来组织与导航相关的未来。我们用两个互补的抽象来实例化这一视角：指定下一个要到达的局部状态的短时域路点，以及捕捉即将到来的路线空间支撑的中时域走廊。基于这一设计，我们提出 FS-Nav，一种未来状态世界建模框架，它从空间记忆和语言指令预测路点-走廊状态，并通过俯视和第一人称接口将其传达给 VLM 导航器。在标准 VLN 基准上的实验表明，FS-Nav 达到了最先进性能。这凸显了与导航相关的未来状态建模作为 VLN 中表示未来的一个有前景方向。

items.title_en: Cecilia: Towards Layout-Inclusive Optical Music Recognition
items.title_zh: Cecilia：迈向包含布局信息的光学音乐识别
items.abstract_en: Reconstructing an editable music score requires musical events, sung text and the instructions that organise them on the page. Existing recognition targets often omit part of this information, while direct MusicXML prediction repeats substantial structural markup. We introduce Cecilia, a compact representation of canonicalised MusicXML that retains musical content, lyric attachments and layout instructions. Cecilia-OMR predicts this representation through metadata and measure-bounded music segments from shared visual memory. A learned count head determines the number of output segments. Across paired complete scores under a common tokeniser, the ratio of mean MusicXML to Cecilia sequence lengths is 27.73. Cecilia-OMR outperforms Legato 2 on Camera String Quartets and both Lieder conditions, with a four-condition OpenScore macro normalised edit distance of 0.2232 against 0.2998. Separate evaluations of lyrics, notation trees and rendered layout reveal complementary aspects of reconstruction and quantify the contribution of layout instructions. Training-stage, reward and candidate-selection studies further examine how recognition changes across model adaptation and decoding.
items.abstract_zh: 重建可编辑乐谱需要音乐事件、歌词文本以及将它们组织在页面上的指令。现有识别目标常常遗漏其中部分信息，而直接预测 MusicXML 会重复大量结构标记。我们提出 Cecilia，一种规范化 MusicXML 的紧凑表示，保留音乐内容、歌词挂接和布局指令。Cecilia-OMR 通过元数据和来自共享视觉记忆的、按小节划分的音乐片段来预测该表示。一个学习得到的计数头决定输出片段的数量。在共同分词器下，对于成对完整乐谱，MusicXML 与 Cecilia 序列长度的平均比值为 27.73。Cecilia-OMR 在 Camera String Quartets 和两种 Lieder 条件下均优于 Legato 2，四项条件 OpenScore 宏归一化编辑距离为 0.2232，对比为 0.2998。对歌词、记谱树和渲染布局的单独评估揭示了重建的互补方面，并量化了布局指令的贡献。训练阶段、奖励和候选选择研究进一步考察识别如何随模型适配和解码而变化。

items.title_en: Sucrose Non-fermenting Related Kinase (SNRK) Deficiency-Mediated Osteogenic Differentiation in Vascular Smooth Muscle Cells Exacerbates Vascular Calcification
items.title_zh: 蔗糖非发酵相关激酶（SNRK）缺陷介导的血管平滑肌细胞成骨分化加剧血管钙化
items.abstract_en: Background: The differentiation of vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMCs) into an osteogenic phenotype is a critical step in vascular calcification progression. Sucrose non-fermenting related kinase (SNRK), a member of the AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) family, has been implicated in diverse cellular functions and pathological conditions. However, whether SNRK is involved in VSMC osteogenic differentiation and calcification remains undefined. Methods: Three mouse models were used to evaluate the contributions of SNRK in vascular calcification: Myh11-CreERT2-driven VSMC-specific SNRK knockout in C57BL/6J mice subjected to vitamin D3 overload or adenine diet, and Apoe-/- mice with VSMC (Myh11-CreERT2)-, endothelial cell (Cdh5-Cre)-, or macrophage (LysM-Cre)-specific SNRK knockout on a chronic western diet. The in vitro calcification was modeled by treating primary mouse aortic VSMCs and human aortic VSMCs (HASMCs) with phosphate (Pi). Results: Cross-species transcriptomic analyses reveal reduced SNRK expression in murine vascular calcification and human calcified plaques. Human femoral artery samples from the elderly individuals with calcification exhibited reduced SNRK protein levels compared to non-calcified samples. In patients with chronic kidney disease, leukocyte levels of SNRK antisense RNA 1 (SNRK-AS1) were positively correlated with thoracic artery calcification Agatston scores. In parallel, decreased SNRK expression was observed in aortic arteries from three mouse models of calcification and in VSMCs treated with phosphate. Notably, VSMC-specific deletion of SNRK exacerbated calcific lesions, accompanied by upregulation of both runt-related transcription factor 2 (RUNX2) and msh homeobox 2 (MSX2). Conversely, SNRK deletion in either endothelial cells or macrophages had no impact on vascular calcification. Further, overexpression of SNRK in VSMCs, achieved via intravenous injection of an adeno-associated virus (AAV) ligated with VSMC Tagln promoter encoding Snrk, significantly attenuated vascular calcification along with reduced expression of osteogenic markers. Further interactome analysis demonstrated that SNRK directly binds to {beta}-Catenin, a critical regulator of vascular calcification, through the amino acid sequence 270-765. Mechanistically, SNRK facilitated the interaction between {beta}-Catenin and cullin 1/{beta}-TrCP E3 ubiquitin ligase complex, promoting ubiquitin-proteasome-mediated degradation of {beta}-Catenin and subsequently reducing the expression of osteogenic markers in VSMCs. Conclusions: We conclude that SNRK safeguards against vascular calcification by preventing {beta}-Catenin/RUNX2/MSX2-mediated VSMC osteogenic differentiation.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：血管平滑肌细胞（VSMCs）向成骨表型分化是血管钙化进展的关键步骤。蔗糖非发酵相关激酶（SNRK）是 AMP 活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）家族成员，已被牵涉于多种细胞功能和病理状态。然而，SNRK 是否参与 VSMC 成骨分化和钙化仍不明确。方法：使用三种小鼠模型评估 SNRK 在血管钙化中的作用：在维生素 D3 超载或腺嘌呤饮食处理的 C57BL/6J 小鼠中，以 Myh11-CreERT2 驱动 VSMC 特异性 SNRK 敲除；以及在慢性西方饮食下的 Apoe-/- 小鼠中，分别进行 VSMC（Myh11-CreERT2）、内皮细胞（Cdh5-Cre）或巨噬细胞（LysM-Cre）特异性 SNRK 敲除。体外钙化通过用磷酸盐（Pi）处理原代小鼠主动脉 VSMCs 和人主动脉 VSMCs（HASMCs）建模。结果：跨物种转录组分析显示，在小鼠血管钙化和人钙化斑块中 SNRK 表达降低。与未钙化样本相比，伴有钙化的老年个体的人股动脉样本表现出 SNRK 蛋白水平降低。在慢性肾脏病患者中，白细胞中 SNRK 反义 RNA 1（SNRK-AS1）水平与胸动脉钙化 Agatston 评分正相关。同时，在三种钙化小鼠模型的主动脉以及经磷酸盐处理的 VSMCs 中观察到 SNRK 表达降低。值得注意的是，VSMC 特异性缺失 SNRK 加剧钙化病变，并伴随 Runt 相关转录因子 2（RUNX2）和 msh 同源盒 2（MSX2）上调。相反，内皮细胞或巨噬细胞中的 SNRK 缺失对血管钙化没有影响。此外，通过静脉注射与编码 Snrk 的 VSMC Tagln 启动子连接的腺相关病毒（AAV）实现的 VSMCs 中 SNRK 过表达，显著减轻血管钙化，并降低成骨标志物表达。进一步的相互作用组分析表明，SNRK 通过氨基酸序列 270-765 直接结合 {beta}-Catenin，后者是血管钙化的关键调控因子。机制上，SNRK 促进 {beta}-Catenin 与 cullin 1/{beta}-TrCP E3 泛素连接酶复合物之间的相互作用，促进泛素-蛋白酶体介导的 {beta}-Catenin 降解，并随后降低 VSMCs 中成骨标志物的表达。结论：我们得出结论，SNRK 通过阻止 {beta}-Catenin/RUNX2/MSX2 介导的 VSMC 成骨分化来抵御血管钙化。

items.title_en: Emergent Fourfold Symmetry in Polarization Images: Local Origin and Diffractive Breakdown
items.title_zh: 偏振图像中涌现的四重对称性：局域起源与衍射破坏
items.abstract_en: A polarization image can gain or lose rotational symmetry with no change in material symmetry. In axisymmetric anisotropic systems, covariance restricts the field to azimuthal orders $m=0,\pm2$, guaranteeing twofold but not fourfold symmetry; pointwise unitarity adds fourfold symmetry, which diffraction can destroy. Holographic Jones fields of liquid-crystal torons show propagation shifts the twofold--fourfold balance; for the same director, a marching-wave model qualitatively reproduces the twofold morphology missed by a local model. This establishes a symmetry hierarchy for polarization imaging.
items.abstract_zh: 偏振图像可以在材料对称性不变的情况下获得或失去旋转对称性。在轴对称各向异性系统中，协变性将场限制在方位角阶数 $m=0,\pm2$，保证二重对称但不保证四重对称；逐点酉性增加四重对称，而衍射可将其破坏。液晶 toron 的全息琼斯场表明，传播会改变二重—四重对称的平衡；对于同一指向矢，行进波模型定性地再现了局域模型遗漏的二重形貌。这为偏振成像建立了一个对称性层级。

items.title_en: Topology Hub Optimal Transport: Eliminating Long Context Dilution at Flash Speed
items.title_zh: 拓扑枢纽最优传输：以 Flash 速度消除长上下文稀释
items.abstract_en: Long-context models use sparse or structured attention to avoid quadratic cost, yet retrieving a small set of relevant facts embedded among hundreds of thousands of distractors degrades as normalization mass disperses with length. Hub-and-spoke optimal transport (OT) replaces the dense $L \times L$ matrix with a linear-size graph over local windows and $K$ shared hubs balanced by Sinkhorn scaling. Building on block-wise tail refinement and fixed-support transport topology (arXiv:2605.08123, arXiv:2609.07954), we introduce Topology Hub Optimal Transport (THOT): (1) bounded-support capacity gating via simplex sparsemax ($O(L\log L)$) or sorting-free token-local thresholded ReLU ($O(L)$), driving excess distractor mass to zero; (2) a three-sweep $1+2$ annealed row-closed Sinkhorn schedule that damps bipartite residuals; (3) an exact rank-$(D+2R+1)$ One-Reference-Tile adjoint in batched split-factor Triton kernels (BF16 Tensor Cores, FP32 potentials); and (4) a chunked exclusive-prefix causal variant with verified zero future leakage. On NVIDIA L4, sparsemax THOT trained at $L=128$ reaches 97.40% zero-shot recall of fixed bindings at $L=262{,}144$ under pure task loss ($α=0$) and 98.83% at $α=0.05$ (matched by $O(L)$ thresholded ReLU at $α=0.05$, vs. 80.60% at $α=0$), while softmax-gated hub OT drops to 3.52%. In bidirectional operator microbenchmarks, our kernel runs forward+VJP in 100.1 ms at $H=8, D=64, L=262\mathrm{K}$ (2.2x faster with 4.0x smaller compiler temporaries than latent softmax) and 1.34 ms vs. 4.37 ms for cuDNN FlashAttention at $L=4{,}096$; multi-layer LM runs use the unfused path. Zero-shot WikiText-103 multi-needle retrieval hits 100.00% (128/128 queries at $L=65\mathrm{K}$) vs. 0.78% for short-trained RoPE FlashAttention, and compact 4-layer WikiText-4K runs show modest causal and masked LM gains.
items.abstract_zh: 长上下文模型使用稀疏或结构化注意力来避免二次成本，但当归一化质量随长度分散时，从数十万干扰项中检索少量相关事实会退化。枢纽-辐条最优传输（OT）用基于局部窗口和由 Sinkhorn 缩放平衡的 $K$ 个共享枢纽的线性规模图替换稠密 $L \times L$ 矩阵。基于分块尾部精化和固定支撑传输拓扑（arXiv:2605.08123、arXiv:2609.07954），我们引入拓扑枢纽最优传输（THOT）：（1）通过单纯形 sparsemax（$O(L\log L)$）或免排序的 token 局部阈值化 ReLU（$O(L)$）进行有界支撑容量门控，将多余干扰项质量驱动至零；（2）三遍 $1+2$ 退火行闭 Sinkhorn 调度，抑制二分残差；（3）在批量 split-factor Triton 内核（BF16 Tensor Cores，FP32 potentials）中实现精确秩-$(D+2R+1)$ One-Reference-Tile 伴随；（4）分块独占前缀因果变体，并验证零未来泄漏。在 NVIDIA L4 上，在 $L=128$ 训练的 sparsemax THOT 在纯任务损失（$α=0$）下于 $L=262{,}144$ 达到 97.40% 的固定绑定零样本召回率，在 $α=0.05$ 下达到 98.83%（$O(L)$ 阈值化 ReLU 在 $α=0.05$ 下达到相当水平，而 $α=0$ 下为 80.60%），而 softmax 门控枢纽 OT 降至 3.52%。在双向算子微基准中，我们的内核在 $H=8, D=64, L=262\mathrm{K}$ 时以 100.1 ms 运行前向+VJP（相比潜在 softmax 快 2.2 倍，编译器临时量小 4.0 倍），在 $L=4{,}096$ 时为 1.34 ms，而 cuDNN FlashAttention 为 4.37 ms；多层语言模型运行使用未融合路径。零样本 WikiText-103 多针检索达到 100.00%（$L=65\mathrm{K}$ 时 128/128 查询），而短训练 RoPE FlashAttention 为 0.78%，紧凑 4 层 WikiText-4K 运行显示出适度的因果和掩码语言模型增益。

items.title_en: DRVEXO-4B-Unified: Design and Evaluation of a Modular Speech-Vision System
items.title_zh: DRVEXO-4B-Unified：模块化语音-视觉系统的设计与评估
items.abstract_en: We present DRVEXO-4B-Unified, a modular multimodal assistant built around a 4B language backbone. A self-contained checkpoint combines text, image, and speech inputs with reference-conditioned speech output and structured interaction. A temporal residual connector adapts acoustic sequences to the language interface; explicit text boundaries support incremental speech synthesis; and three task-conditioned scoring heads rank supplied action candidates alongside generative tool calls. These interfaces connect conversation to application-defined choices while leaving action authorization to the application. The system obtains 74.22% on all 900 MMMU validation questions, exceeding the published validation scores of Gemma 3 4B IT and InternVL3.5-4B without test-time scaling. Strict prompt-level IFEval accuracy is 82.26% and MATH-500 accuracy is 89.40%, above the original Qwen3-4B non-thinking report's 81.2% and 84.8%, respectively. On NVIDIA GB10, the model achieves a speech-synthesis first-chunk latency of 390 ms. For concurrent text generation, a growth-aware admission policy completes a 128-answer batch at 594.41 output tokens/s, including filling and draining, without preemptions. We plan to release the model weights and accompanying code under Apache License 2.0, retaining applicable third-party terms.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 DRVEXO-4B-Unified，一个围绕 4B 语言骨干构建的模块化多模态助手。一个自包含检查点将文本、图像和语音输入与参考条件语音输出及结构化交互相结合。时间残差连接器将声学序列适配到语言接口；显式文本边界支持增量语音合成；三个任务条件评分头对提供的动作候选与生成式工具调用一起排序。这些接口将对话连接到应用定义的选项，同时将动作授权留给应用。该系统在全部 900 个 MMMU 验证问题上获得 74.22%，在无测试时扩展的情况下超过 Gemma 3 4B IT 和 InternVL3.5-4B 已发表的验证分数。严格提示级 IFEval 准确率为 82.26%，MATH-500 准确率为 89.40%，分别高于原始 Qwen3-4B 非思考报告的 81.2% 和 84.8%。在 NVIDIA GB10 上，该模型的语音合成首块延迟为 390 ms。对于并发文本生成，增长感知准入策略在包含填充和排空的情况下，以 594.41 输出 token/s 完成 128 个答案的批次，且无抢占。我们计划在 Apache License 2.0 下发布模型权重和配套代码，并保留适用的第三方条款。

items.title_en: PACE-WM: Parallel World Modeling with Action History for Visual Planning
items.title_zh: PACE-WM：面向视觉规划的带动作历史的并行世界建模
items.abstract_en: JEPA-style world models support visual planning by predicting future representations conditioned on future actions. However, similar observations can conceal different motion states, making temporal context essential for interpreting future action effects. We propose PACE-WM, a parallel world model that uses executed-action history to contextualize future prediction and planning. Specifically, PACE-WM maintains a recurrent memory of executed actions and uses this memory to condition a causal Transformer. PACE-WM predicts multiple future representations in parallel without recursive predicted-state feedback within each prediction window. We further introduce Reference-Anchored Minimum Progress (RAMP) for action selection during planning. RAMP scores candidate actions by their predicted goal improvement along direct and split paths relative to a shared reference. Across four visual planning tasks, PACE-WM with RAMP achieves an average success rate of $98\%$ and plans approximately $7$-$9\times$ faster than autoregressive LeWM under matched CEM settings. We also construct four controlled benchmarks to evaluate PACE-WM's capabilities in motion disambiguation, goal-relative motion, and goal adaptation. Project page is available at https://github.com/LHS180/PACE-WM.
items.abstract_zh: JEPA 风格的世界模型通过预测以未来动作为条件的未来表示来支持视觉规划。然而，相似的观测可能掩盖不同的运动状态，使时间上下文对于解释未来动作效果至关重要。我们提出 PACE-WM，一种使用已执行动作历史来为未来预测和规划提供上下文的并行世界模型。具体而言，PACE-WM 维护已执行动作的循环记忆，并使用该记忆对因果 Transformer 进行条件化。PACE-WM 并行预测多个未来表示，在每个预测窗口内没有递归的预测状态反馈。我们进一步引入参考锚定最小进展（RAMP）用于规划过程中的动作选择。RAMP 根据候选动作相对于共享参考在直接路径和拆分路径上的预测目标改进来评分。在四个视觉规划任务中，在匹配的 CEM 设置下，采用 RAMP 的 PACE-WM 达到平均 98% 的成功率，规划速度约为自回归 LeWM 的 7–9 倍。我们还构建了四个受控基准，以评估 PACE-WM 在运动消歧、目标相对运动和目标准应方面的能力。项目页面见 https://github.com/LHS180/PACE-WM。

items.title_en: AURA: AUdio-dRiven streaming Avatar
items.title_zh: AURA：音频驱动的流式虚拟化身
items.abstract_en: Current audio-driven video diffusion models can synthesize realistic talking-head videos but generally require dozens of diffusion denoising steps over multi-second video chunks, making them unsuitable for streaming applications such as voice assistants and virtual avatars, where low-latency and online causal generation are required properties. AURA generates video chunk by chunk with a rolling KV cache, requiring only the audio of the current chunk to start generating, rather than a multi-second audio look-ahead like bidirectional models. It comes in two sizes: AURA 1.3B streams 576p video in real time on a single GPU (20.7 fps for a 16 Hz playback rate), making it suited to interactive avatar applications, and AURA 5B streams 720p video at 9.7 fps. Our two-stage distillation pipeline first aligns the causal student with the teacher, by training it to match the teacher's trajectories with fewer diffusion steps and a chunk-wise sliding window causal attention mask, then applies Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) with backward simulation to close the remaining quality gap. On standard talking-head benchmarks, AURA 1.3B runs 23x faster than its own bidirectional teacher and reaches a quality comparable to TalkVerse at a lower resolution, and AURA 5B matches its TalkVerse teacher at 720p while running 17x faster. To support reproducibility and further research on streaming avatar generation, we release the weights of both models along with a dataset of 30K synthetic videos and their precomputed teacher trajectories.
items.abstract_zh: 当前音频驱动的视频扩散模型能够合成逼真的说话头视频，但通常需要对多秒视频块执行数十个扩散去噪步骤，使其不适合语音助手和虚拟化身等流式应用，而这些应用要求低延迟和在线因果生成。AURA 利用滚动 KV 缓存逐块生成视频，只需当前块的音频即可开始生成，而不像双向模型那样需要多秒音频前瞻。它有两种规模：AURA 1.3B 在单块 GPU 上实时流式生成 576p 视频（16 Hz 播放速率下为 20.7 fps），适合交互式化身应用；AURA 5B 以 9.7 fps 流式生成 720p 视频。我们的两阶段蒸馏流水线首先使因果学生模型与教师模型对齐，通过训练学生模型以更少的扩散步骤和块级滑动窗口因果注意力掩码来匹配教师的轨迹，然后应用带有反向模拟的分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）来缩小剩余的质量差距。在标准说话头基准上，AURA 1.3B 的运行速度比其自身的双向教师模型快 23 倍，并在较低分辨率下达到与 TalkVerse 相当的质量；AURA 5B 在 720p 下达到与其 TalkVerse 教师模型相当的质量，同时运行速度快 17 倍。为支持可复现性和流式化身生成的进一步研究，我们发布了两个模型的权重，以及包含 3 万段合成视频及其预计算教师轨迹的数据集。

items.title_en: Classical visual illusions in vision-language models under an instruction ladder
items.title_zh: 指令阶梯下视觉-语言模型中的经典视错觉
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) often name the "illusory" answer when shown a classical visual illusion, but it is unclear whether that answer comes from the picture or from knowledge about famous figures. We drew 300 new stimuli of 25 classical illusions in three conditions--the illusion, the illusion with its inducing elements reversed, and a control with the inducing elements removed--and asked about each image at eight rungs of an instruction ladder that runs from a false fact, through a neutral question and an instruction to report the physical truth, to telling the model the name of the illusion and finally the true answer. Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5, with thinking off and on, gave 460,800 answers. When asked for the physical fact, all four settings almost never gave the illusion answer, and they resolved real 10% differences in the same displays. When asked how the picture looks, the illusion answers returned, and they did not vanish after the true answer was stated. Two measures that cancel position preferences and recognition of the figure suggest that much of this depends on the stimulus: among side answers, Sonnet with thinking chose the illusion side in 85% of cases after being told the truth (95% CI 74--96%), with 16 of the 25 illusions showing a stimulus-driven effect. Yet for five figures--the Fraser spiral, Kanizsa triangle, Pinna--Brelstaff rings, Ouchi pattern and, for Haiku, the rotating snakes--the models gave the illusion answer to the control images as well, which suggests that they answered from the figure rather than from the effect. A false fact was mostly followed on control images but not on illusion images. The stimuli, prompts, all responses and the code are released for testing further models; the Python code that draws the stimuli is parametric and can generate new illusion images for other studies with models or human observers.
items.abstract_zh: 我们绘制了 25 种经典视错觉的 300 个新刺激，分为三种条件——错觉本身、诱导元素反转的错觉，以及移除诱导元素的对照——并在一个八级指令阶梯的每一级对每张图像提问，该阶梯从虚假事实开始，经过中性问题和要求报告物理真实的指令，到告诉模型错觉的名称，最后给出真实答案。Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 Claude Haiku 5.5 在关闭和开启思考模式下共给出 460,800 个答案。当被要求给出物理事实时，所有四种设置几乎从不给出错觉答案，并且它们能分辨同一显示中真实的 10% 差异。当被问及图片看起来如何时，错觉答案重新出现，并且在陈述真实答案后并未消失。两个消除位置偏好和图形识别影响的测量表明，这在很大程度上取决于刺激：在侧边答案中，开启思考的 Sonnet 在被告知真相后仍有 85% 的情况选择错觉侧（95% CI 74–96%），25 种错觉中有 16 种表现出刺激驱动的效应。然而，对于五个图形——Fraser 螺旋、Kanizsa 三角形、Pinna–Brelstaff 环、Ouchi 图案，以及对于 Haiku 而言的旋转蛇——模型对对照图像也给出了错觉答案，这表明它们是根据图形而非错觉效应作答。虚假事实在对照图像上大多被遵循，但在错觉图像上则不然。刺激、提示、所有回答和代码均已发布，用于测试更多模型；绘制刺激的 Python 代码是参数化的，可为使用模型或人类观察者的其他研究生成新的错觉图像。

items.title_en: Intelligent Imaging of Thermal Transport in Nanostructures
items.title_zh: 纳米结构中热输运的智能成像
items.abstract_en: The ability to measure thermal properties and visualize heat transport processes with high spatial resolution is becoming increasingly important for materials discovery, next-generation electronics, and advanced manufacturing. As critical dimensions and architectures of novel materials and high performance electronics shrink and become more heterogeneous, thermal transport is no longer governed by bulk material properties alone, but by local variations in microstructure, such as interfaces and defects, while the operating conditions can also play a role. With the development of non-contact pump-probe thermoreflectance techniques, specific heat, thermal conductivity, and interface conductance can be mapped either through wide-field thermos-reflectance images or by scanning technique. However, key challenges remain such as the balance between imaging throughput and measurement accuracy, the extraction of multiple parameters with high confidence, and non-intrusive subsurface characterization, etc. This Review highlights recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI)-assistance in high-throughput data processing, visualizing interfacial thermal transport, and nonintrusive subsurface analysis, and offers outlooks for future research directions such as spectral mapping of heat carriers, three-dimensional property mapping, and AI-agentic experimental designs. We anticipate this Review will motivate future efforts in combining AI with experimental techniques to achieve unprecedented capabilities for thermal characterization of nanoscale materials and device characterization, facilitating materials discovery and electronics revolution.
items.abstract_zh: 以高空间分辨率测量热性质并可视化热输运过程的能力，对于材料发现、下一代电子器件和先进制造正变得越来越重要。随着新型材料和高性能电子器件的关键尺寸与架构不断缩小并变得更加异质，热输运不再仅由体材料性质决定，还受到微观结构局部变化（如界面和缺陷）的影响，而工作条件也可能发挥作用。随着非接触泵浦-探测热反射技术的发展，比热、热导率和界面热导可以通过宽场热反射图像或扫描技术进行映射。然而，关键挑战仍然存在，例如成像通量与测量精度之间的平衡、高置信度地提取多个参数，以及非侵入式亚表面表征等。本综述重点介绍人工智能（AI）辅助在高通量数据处理、界面热输运可视化和非侵入式亚表面分析方面的最新进展，并展望未来研究方向，如热载流子光谱映射、三维性质映射和 AI 智能体实验设计。我们期望本综述将推动未来将 AI 与实验技术相结合的努力，以实现纳米材料热表征和器件表征的前所未有能力，促进材料发现和电子学变革。

items.title_en: Search From the Start: Search-Native Pretraining for Language Models
items.title_zh: 从开始就搜索：面向语言模型的搜索原生预训练
items.abstract_en: Modern language models (LMs) are increasingly deployed with access to search tools at inference. Yet pretraining remains predominantly focused on predicting static text, with search capabilities typically introduced during post-training. We propose Search-Native Pretraining as a practical route to teach search capability during pretraining from ordinary text corpora. Specifically, we augment pretraining corpus at scale with web-search queries and retrieve web response using a local index. Training on this augmented corpus teaches models to generate search calls and incorporate retrieved evidence during language modeling. Across Wikipedia and DCLM-Edu corpora and 360M to 3.3B parameter scales, search-pretrained models ("QueryLM") show improved performance on knowledge-intensive tasks and higher steerability toward the retrieved evidence. Crucially, their advantage persists after supervised fine-tuning of both search-pretrained and conventionally pretrained models, indicating that the tested post-training procedures do not fully recover the capabilities developed during pretraining. Throughout our experiments, we find that a 1.4B QueryLM consistently beats or matches the performance of a FLOP-matched 3.3B baseline model across all knowledge intensive tasks. These results establish search-pretraining as a practical way to develop foundational search capabilities during pretraining. We release the training artifacts, including model checkpoints and data.
items.abstract_zh: 现代语言模型（LM）在推理时越来越多地被部署为可访问搜索工具。然而，预训练仍主要集中于预测静态文本，搜索能力通常在训练后阶段引入。我们提出搜索原生预训练，作为一种从普通文本语料库在预训练期间教授搜索能力的实用途径。具体而言，我们大规模地用网络搜索查询增强预训练语料，并使用本地索引检索网络响应。在这个增强语料上训练，使模型学会生成搜索调用，并在语言建模过程中整合检索到的证据。在 Wikipedia 和 DCLM-Edu 语料库以及 3.6 亿到 33 亿参数规模上，经搜索预训练的模型（“QueryLM”）在知识密集型任务上表现出更好的性能，并且对检索到的证据具有更高的可引导性。关键的是，在对搜索预训练模型和传统预训练模型都进行监督微调后，它们的优势仍然存在，这表明所测试的训练后流程并不能完全恢复预训练期间形成的能力。在我们的整个实验中，我们发现一个 1.4B 的 QueryLM 在所有知识密集型任务上始终优于或匹敌一个 FLOP 匹配的 3.3B 基线模型。这些结果确立了搜索预训练作为一种在预训练期间发展基础搜索能力的实用方法。我们发布了训练产物，包括模型检查点和数据。

items.title_en: From Acting to Learning: Experience Selection toward Continually Learning Agents
items.title_zh: 从行动到学习：面向持续学习智能体的经验选择
items.abstract_en: Successful agent interactions provide training data, but success alone does not determine which records a student should learn from. We examine experience selection for a 4B language agent as a component of continual agent learning. Nine selectors are compared across two fixed experience pools, eight initialization seeds, and two sampling seeds, yielding 288 trained students. Each student is evaluated on 128 development task groups with a common executor. With equal global selection freedom, 256 distinct contents, and 768 training presentations, optimizer-aware gradient selection reaches 81.45\% and 73.19\% success in the two pools. Its gains over global random selection are 8.25 and 5.96 percentage points; gains over global high-NLL selection are 4.10 and 4.05 points. All eight initialization-level contrasts are positive against both baselines in each pool. Relaxing coverage constraints improves gradient selection but reduces random-selection performance, showing that the ranking rule and selection space must be considered together. A separately frozen replication on 128 reserved task groups is complete; its equal-source gradient-minus-random and gradient-minus-high-NLL differences are +7.03 and +5.03 points, respectively.
items.abstract_zh: 成功的智能体交互提供训练数据，但仅凭成功并不能决定学生模型应该从哪些记录中学习。我们将针对一个 4B 语言智能体的经验选择作为持续智能体学习的一个组成部分进行研究。在两个固定经验池、八个初始化种子和两个采样种子上比较了九种选择器，得到 288 个训练过的学生模型。每个学生模型在 128 个开发任务组上使用一个共同执行器进行评估。在相同的全局选择自由度、256 个不同内容和 768 次训练呈现下，优化器感知的梯度选择在两个池中分别达到 81.45% 和 73.19% 的成功率。其相对于全局随机选择的增益分别为 8.25 和 5.96 个百分点；相对于全局高 NLL 选择的增益分别为 4.10 和 4.05 个百分点。在每个池中，所有八个初始化级别的对比相对于两个基线均为正。放宽覆盖约束可改善梯度选择，但会降低随机选择性能，表明排序规则和选择空间必须一起考虑。在 128 个保留任务组上单独冻结的重复实验已完成；其等来源的“梯度减随机”和“梯度减高 NLL”差异分别为 +7.03 和 +5.03 个百分点。
